title: 中外合作大学唯一！宁诺三门课程入选第二批国家级一流本科课程
content:
Please scroll down for the English version -Three UNNC modules recognised as National Level First-Class Modules.
宁波诺丁汉大学《戏剧概论》、《过程工程项目》、《设计、制造及项目》三门课程成功入选第二批国家级一流本科课程！
今天（4月20日），随着教育部网站相关认定结果公示结束，宁诺人文社科学院和理工学院的三门全英文课程跻身国家级一流本科课程榜单。截至目前，宁波诺丁汉大学已有五门课程入选，加上此前学校财务管理专业被评为国家级一流本科专业建设点，宁诺已成为唯一一所同时拥有国家级一流本科课程和一流本科专业建设点的中外合作大学。

《戏剧概论》
  全球剧目，创作改编
该课程是宁诺人文社科学院英语专业的大二专业课程，旨在帮助学生理解戏剧如何作为一种表演媒介，在共享空间中将信息呈现给其他人。这门课程包含了对莎士比亚的《仲夏夜之梦》和中国戏剧《驴子》等经典剧目的赏析，还涉及对现实主义戏剧《玩偶之家》等特殊类别剧目的学习，培养学生识别和分析构成戏剧表演的各种因素的能力。
除此之外，课程还培养学生创作能力，鼓励学生制定导演计划改编戏剧并将其付诸实践。在学习过程中，学生们将一些动画剧本、电影和中国传奇故事改编为戏剧并表演。硬软件支持上，学生的表演练习在专业的排练室进行，由经验丰富的剧院从业者作为指导老师，同时指导学生使用学校的摄影和录像资源。
课程由教育与英语语言文学系Derek Irwin博士担任课程负责人。Derek Irwin博士已有六年教授该课程的经验，“我结合了英国诺丁汉大学和诺丁汉大学马来西亚校区的先进做法，不断创新。我很高兴现在课程的受欢迎程度稳步增长，还有越来越多的同学参与到课外戏剧活动中。”据悉，近年来，此课程不断发展，扩展了更多的全球剧目供学生们学习。


《过程工程项目》和《设计、制造及项目》
  理论实践，融会贯通
“过程工程项目”是理工学院面向化学工程与工艺专业的大三学生开设的必修课程。课程将引导学生加深对化工过程中稳态及非稳态现象背后所蕴含的一系列物理化学知识的理解，最终达到能够通过融会贯通，将理论应用于化工过程设计与操作的水平。
课程团队的主要成员由课程负责人胡笛博士和化学与环境工程系副主任Cheng Heng Pang教授组成，团队所有成员均持有英国高等教育学会副会士（Associate Fellow）证书。
值得一提的是，由该团队提出的“体验式学习理念在工程教学中的应用”通过了英国高等教育学会评审。课程通过组织工厂参观与利用专业模拟软件，让学生对车间试车与运行操作进行亲身体验，充分发挥学生学习主观能动性，进而强化其对相关概念与知识的理解与应用，将抽象化概念具象化。
理工学院另一获评的国家级课程是针对材料成型及控制工程专业的大三学生设计的专业课程，该课程也尤为重视理论联系实践。例如，课程团队在近年的教学中引入了“两栖车辆” 项目。在项目中，学生需要设计和制造一种微型车辆，用指定的运行能量，携带有效载荷，可在陆地和水上或水中运行。课程团队将项目设计过程与每周的授课联系在一起，以便学生把知识付诸实践。学生还将管理预算并与淘宝供应商做成本和技术谈判，还可以将复杂的3D 打印等流程外包。这一项目有助于他们完成期末项目，加深对设计工程职业的理解。
“设计、制造及项目”课程的师资队伍力量十分强大，由Adam Rushworth博士、Kok-Hoong Wong博士、赖乃滎博士和任勇博士组成。课程负责人Adam Rushworth博士已有十多年教学经验，并且广受学生的好评。“课程十分生动有趣，讲师讲的很系统，平易近人又十分友好。我很愿意一次一次参考这些课程内容来完成我的学习，对我十分有帮助。”来自材料成型及控制工程专业的学生这样评价说。







宁诺课程以小班化教学、合作式学习为特点，通过一系列任务引导学生自主学习，并将所学知识进行创新性的实践应用，培养学生团队协作、自主探索、综合考量与决策的能力。

Three UNNC modules recognised as National Level First-Class Modules
20 April: Three English teaching modules offered by the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) -  "Introduction to drama", "Process Engineering Project" and "Design, Manufacture and Project" - have been successfully selected by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China as the second batch of National Level First Class Undergraduate Modules. So far, UNNC has had five National Level First Class Undergraduate Modules. Following on from the Finance, Accounting and Management BSc (Hons) being awarded National Level First Class Courses previously, UNNC has become the first and only Sino-foreign University to have both national first-level programmes and modules.
“Introduction to drama” is a compulsory module for second-year students of English Language and Literature in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences. It aims to help students understand how drama functions as a medium of performance to present information to others in a shared space. The module includes an analysis of classic plays such as Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream and the Chinese drama The Donkey, as well as the study of special categories of drama such as realist plays like A Doll's House to develop students' ability to identify and analyse the various factors that constitute a dramatic performance.
In addition, the module also aims to develop students' creativity, encourage them to develop directorial plans to adapt and put theatrical performances into practice. During the learning process, students adapt some animated scripts, movies, and Chinese legends into drama and perform them. Students' performance practice takes place in professional rehearsal rooms, and are guided by experienced theatre practitioners, who also instruct students in the use of the school's photography and video resources.
The module is convened by Dr Derek Irwin from the School of Education and English, who has been teaching the module for six years. "I combine the advanced practices of the University of Nottingham and the University of Nottingham Malaysia Campus, and keep innovating. I am pleased to see the increasing popularity of the module and that more and more students are participating in drama activities outside of the classroom," he said. In recent years, the module has expanded to include more plays from around the world for students to study.
The “Process Engineering Project” is a compulsory module of the Faculty of Science and Engineering offered to year three Chemical Engineering students. The module guides students to deepen their understanding of the series of physical and chemical knowledge behind steady-state and non-steady-state phenomena in chemical processes, and to ultimately achieve the level of being able to apply theory to the design and operation of chemical processes through integration.
The teaching team includes Dr Di Hu, the module convener, and Professor Cheng Heng Pang, Deputy Director of the Department of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, both have been awarded the Associate Fellowship of the Higher Education Academy in the UK.
It is worth mentioning that the idea of "experiential learning in engineering education" proposed by the team has passed the evaluation of the Higher Education Academy in the UK. Through organising factory visits, and utilising professional simulation software, the module allows students to experience testing and operation in the industry first-hand, encouraging students to take an active role in their own learning process, thereby strengthening their understanding and the application of relevant concepts and knowledge.
The other recognised module, “Design, Manufacture and Project”, is a professional module designed for year three students of Mechanical Engineering, and also emphasises the practical application of theory. For example, the module introduced the "amphibious vehicle" project to teaching over the past few years. In this project, students are required to design and manufacture a miniature vehicle that can operate on land and water or underwater, carrying a specified load with a designated amount of energy. The project design process is integrated into the weekly lectures to help students apply their knowledge. The project helps them complete their final projects and deepen their understanding of the profession.
The teaching team for the module consists of experts and scholars from different countries and regions. The module is convened by Dr Adam Rushworth, Assistant Professor in Materials and Manufacturing, who has over ten years of teaching experience and is highly regarded by students. "The module is very attractive and interesting. The teaching is systematic, approachable, and very friendly. These lectures are also very helpful," said a student of Mechanical Engineering.
UNNC emphasises small-class teaching and collaborative learning. By assigning various tasks, it helps students to develop active learning habits and skills, apply their knowledge in practical and innovative ways, improve capabilities in teamwork, independent and critical thinking, and decision making.

title: 理工满天星 | 听理工学子来谈谈科研实习对于本科生来说到底意味着什么
content:
Vol.2
科研实习专题
理工学院优秀毕业生
FoSE 2023 graduates' study experience sharing


引言   
Introduction
提到科研，许多人也许会有望尘莫及的刻板印象，也有很多本科生对科研有着很多疑问。本科生做科研有什么用呢？本科生真的能找到很有含金量的科研吗？
优秀的科研经历不仅可以为学生未来的职业发展打下坚实基础，还可以拓宽在学术界和产业界的联系。本文将分享一些理工学院优秀毕业生的科研经历，帮助更多学生了解如何在大学期间开展有意义的科研项目。
右滑查看更多
Many people have a misconception of research, that it is tedious and taxing. There will be a lot of undergraduates who are curious about research and wondering: "What good is it for undergraduates to do research? Can students really find valuable scientific research?” A good research experience not only helps students build a strong foundation for their future professional development, but they can also broaden their understanding of the discipline. In order to help more students understand how to find and do a research project at university, we invited some final year students to share their research experiences with the Faculty of Science and Engineering.

李卓尔

材料成型及控制工程（4+0）
湖北省襄阳市第五中学
密歇根大学安娜堡分校机械工程博士，全额奖学金
University of Michigan, Ann Arbor：PhD in Mechanical Engineering, with full scholarship

我从大学一开始就很坚定以后想走科研的方向，于是很早开始积累科研经历，感谢理工学院提供的本科生科研实习项目，使我很幸运地尝试了很多感兴趣的课题。在申请密歇根大学直博项目的时候，我收到了两个教授的面试邀请，其中一个教授做的是可持续发展方向的研究，而且想把可持续与复合材料结合起来，而我正好在学校的复合材料研究团队有过科研实习，也有可持续领域的研究经验，所以我就成为了非常合适的人选。
因此，我相信本科期间做科研需要兼顾深度和广度，一方面是有助于找到自己真正的兴趣所在，另一方面是现在很多课题都是交叉学科的，多一些不同的经历可以相辅相成，在以后选择升研方向的时候凭借不同的经历可以有多一些选择。


From the very beginning of my university career, I was committed to pursuing research. Thanks to the Faculty Undergraduate Research Placement project, I had the chance to try many different research topics. When I applied to the PhD programmes at the University of Michigan, I received interview invitations from two professors. One of them was conducting interdisciplinary research on sustainable development and composite materials. I happened to become the most suitable candidate because I had research experience in both areas. 
Therefore, I think consider both the quality and quantity of research projects. On the one hand, you need to try more projects to identify your actual passions. On the other hand, many research areas are interdisciplinary indeed and a greater variety of perspectives are required. In the future, you can explore more choices for further study.

许之吟

航空航天工程（4+0）
浙江省宁波市效实中学
剑桥大学能源技术哲学硕士
杜克大学机械工程与材料科学硕士
帝国理工学院高级航空工程硕士
密歇根大学安娜堡分校机械工程硕士
加州大学伯克利分校机械工程硕士
宾夕法尼亚大学机械工程及应用力学硕士
University of Cambridge: MPhil in Energy Technologies
Duke University: Mechanical Engineering and Material Science – M.S. program 
Imperial College London: MSc in Advanced Aeronautical Engineering
University of Michigan, Ann Arbor: Mechanical Engineering 
University of California, Berkeley: Mechanical Engineering in Control of Robotic and Autonomous Systems (MEng)
University of Pennsylvania: Mechanical Engineering and Applied Mechanics, MSE program

大二暑研中参与了李灏楠老师的科研实习，这是我参与过的时间跨度最长、任务最多的科研了，也给我留下了很深的印象。我一共参与了三、四个课题，印象最深的课题是关于高速龙门机床设计优化的一个实际生产项目。组里的老师带我们见识了很多从未接触过的知识，我们自己也在这基础上不断探索。一开始是不断通过对原始结构的优化来达到减重并增加强度的目的。但无论怎么尝试，效果都不够好。老师提出了一种用蜂窝结构重新设计机床底座的想法，我们进行了调整并试验，取得了不错的结果。之后，我们收集、整理了仿真的结果，完成专利申请书初稿的工作。每个阶段对于我来说都是全新的体验，但在老师和小组成员的支持下，每个任务都能顺利完成。在这些科研中，我收获的不仅仅是能力上的提升，视野上的开阔，最重要的还有心态的调整。有了这些科研的经验，现在面对停滞不前的科研以及其它任务的进度，我会拥有比之前更良好的心态去面对。

I took part in Dr Haonan Li's research project in my second summer at University. This project left me with the most lasting impression because it was the longest internship and I, in total, had done almost 4 individual projects. The design optimisation of high-speed gantry machine tools was the most amazing project I worked on. I learned a lot from the academic staff and I was inspired to keep exploring the field. We completed many works and the outcomes turned out to be very good. In the end, we finished the report and submitted a patent application. Every step during the research was new for me, but with the help of the instructors and other group members, each activity was successfully completed. I obtained not only a better understanding of the world and a broader perspective, but also, and maybe most crucially, a shift in my mentality. I now have a better mindset when facing stagnation during research.

王子铭

电气与电子工程（2+2）
北京师范大学第二附属中学
剑桥大学工程学博士
牛津大学工程学博士，全额奖学金
牛津大学风能和海洋能源系统和结构博士
University of Cambridge: PhD in Engineering
University of Oxford: DPhil in Engineering Science, with full scholarship
University of Oxford: DPhil Wind and Marine Energy Systems and Structures EPSRC CDT

大三的暑假，我在宁诺Jim Greer教授的推荐下，有幸参与了剑桥大学的安进学者暑研项目，这个项目给予了理工背景的本科学生接触前沿生命科学以及生物工程方面研究的机会。在这个项目中，我参与到了放射组学研究组中。在两个月的项目里，我主要研究了冠状动脉CT信息提取与后续处理。这些处理方法以及最后的组学结果也会在学术会议和期刊上发表。
这次暑研的经历让我更加坚定了申请读博的想法。工程学的魅力就在于将理论变成实际解决问题的方法。因此不要惧怕未知的领域，在研究中每个人都会遇到很多问题，但无需害怕，充分利用身边的各种资源，跨出自己的舒适区，这样会发现不一样的世界。

With the support from Professor Jim Greer, I took part in the University of Cambridge's Amgen Scholars Program, which was an undergraduate summer research program in science and biotechnology. I was enrolled in the Radiomics research group and focused mostly on studying information extraction and subsequent processing of coronary artery CT. Both the final omics results and the processing techniques were published in academic journals and conferences.
This summer research experience strengthened my resolve to pursue a PhD in the near future. Engineering's beauty is in translating theory into workable solutions. So, don't be terrified of exploring uncharted territory. Everyone will experience difficulties while conducting research. Utilize all the resources available to you and venture outside your comfort zone to learn about a new world.


朱浚哲

统计学（2+2）
浙江省宁波市柴桥中学
牛津大学数学建模与科学计算理学硕士
牛津大学统计科学理学硕士
剑桥大学数学统计硕士
University of Oxford: MSc in Mathematical Modelling and Scientific Computing
University of Oxford: MSc in Statistical Science
University of Cambridge: MASt in Mathematical Statistics

2022年，我参加了英国诺丁汉大学暑期研究实习，和教授合作完成了由英国工程和自然科学研究委员会资助的基于贝叶斯计算的流行病参数估计项目研究。
这个项目让我对科研研究有了全面的认识。首先，项目的开始需要和导师一起沟通研究主要目标和内容，让研究的内容和我们自身的兴趣以及未来深入学习的方向契合。其次，如何合理运用科学、数理方法去解决问题，需要靠我们大量阅读文献以及及时与导师的沟通。只有更加深刻的理解项目内容，才能使研究更有效率的进行。当然，有自己的想法也可以和导师交流，大胆尝试，毕竟研究也是一种试错的过程。对挑战的渴望似乎是我骨子里的一种执着。我想去做我自己喜欢的事情，选择一个更难更有挑战力的方向，这才是生活独特魅力之所在。

I worked with professors to complete the Bayesian calculation-based epidemic estimating project research, which was supported by the UK Engineering and Natural Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), at the University of Nottingham in 2022.
I now have a thorough understanding of research. Firstly, it is important to have close communication with supervisors to align your interests and research topics. After setting up a research topic, we need to read many papers to find appropriate methodology and have a deep understanding of the topic. Of course, you are welcome to discuss your ideas with your supervisors. After all, conducting research involves trial and error. I like doing challenging things. I believe that’s the charm of life. 

刘汐榕

材料成型及控制工程（4+0）
甘肃省兰州一中
帝国理工学院先进复合材料科学、技术和工程应用学硕士
加州大学伯克利分校机械工程硕士
宾夕法尼亚大学机械工程及应用力学硕士
哥伦比亚大学机械工程硕士
杜克大学机械工程与材料科学硕士
密歇根大学安娜堡分校机械工程硕士
Imperial College London：Composites: The science, Technology and Engineering Application of Advanced Composites
University of California, Berkeley：Mechanical Engineering in Control of Robotic and Autonomous Systems (MEng)
University of Pennsylvania：Mechanical Engineering and Applied Mechanics, MSE program
Columbia University:Mechanical Engineering (MS)
Duke University：Meng Mechanical Engineering
University of Michigan, Ann Arbor：MSE Mechanical Engineering

大三的暑期，我在一个宁诺学长的推荐下，有幸加入了中国科学院自动化所智能机器人系统研究部实习，主要参与了水下仿生机器人的项目研究，在项目中主要负责参与设计优化了机器人水下流畅感知装置，在实习中收获了很多课外软件应用技能的提升，也学习了很多编程和机械设计的内容，弥补了一些我编程方向的短板，也让我学习到了一个项目从初期设计，到落地实验装配最后安装的整体过程。此外在导师和师兄的介绍下，我还系统的学习了机器人方向的专业知识。除此之外我还结识了一些在国内顶尖高校的导师和师兄师姐，让我受益颇多，也更加坚定了我读研和读博的想法。

I had the privilege of working as an intern for the Institute of Automation's Intelligent Robot System, at the Chinese Academy of Sciences during the summer of my third year. I primarily took part in the research project for underwater bionic robots. I've made significant progress in my extracurricular software application skills, and I've also learned a lot about programming and mechanical design, which have helped me to improve my programming and have also given me the opportunity to learn how to complete a project from the initial design to the installation of the experimental assembly. I also systematically gained professional expertise in the field of robotics, under the guidance of my mentor and seniors. I got to know many researchers in top universities and I also confirmed my decision to continue my research journey. 

尹卓

化学（2+2）
上海市川沙中学 
牛津大学计算理论化学理学硕士
剑桥大学科学计算哲学硕士
帝国理工学院软电子材料研究型硕士
University of Oxford: MSc in Theoretical and Computational Chemistry
University of Cambridge: MPhil in Scientific Computing
Imperial College London: MRes in Soft Electronic Materials

在英国诺丁汉大学，我参加了化学系长达8周的暑期科研项目，并收获了约1万5千人民币的科研奖学金。在该项目中我跟随导师用程序模拟来研究化学反应的机理，在这个项目中我学到了很多前端科研的知识和方法，对我将来的研究做了很好的铺垫。同时在宁诺也有很多暑期科研实习项目，有很多不同的项目和导师可以选择，可以根据自己喜欢的兴趣选择导师，如果有自己的想法想自主研究的话，老师也会给与很多帮助。

I took part in an 8-week summer research project in the Department of Chemistry at the University of Nottingham, UK, and was awarded a research scholarship of roughly 15,000 RMB. I used simulation to study the mechanisms underlying chemical processes. I gained a lot of knowledge and experience in front-tier scientific research techniques through this project, which set the road for my further studies. There are many summer research internships in the Faculty of Science and Engineering – so you can pick a project you are interested in. 

胡世越

化学工程（2+2）
浙江省宁波中学
剑桥大学高级化学工程哲学硕士
帝国理工学院高级化学工程理学硕士
University of Cambridge: MPhil in Advanced Chemical Engineering
Imperial College London: MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering

2022年夏天，我参加了英国诺丁汉大学夏季工程研究实习项目，在可持续发展技术组工作。我的项目主要是在新型菌株中生产透明质酸。在这两个月里，我对菌株进行基因工程方面的工作，并利用可持续原料进行发酵。在项目结束时，我的菌株被证明能够生产透明质酸并且顺利结题。
我非常喜欢这个项目，因为这是我第一次设计菌种和进行发酵。这个项目对我来说，一切都是全新的。因此我必须在进入实验室之前进行大量的自学，以便为项目做好准备。这段科研项目带给了我很多方面的提升，当我面对一项难题时，我不会束手无策，而是拥有了迎难而上的勇气和信心。

Through the Nottingham Summer Engineering Research Program (NSERP), I had the opportunity to work at the Sustainable Process Technologies Group in the summer of 2022. I was chosen for this very exclusive programme based on my academic performance and my enthusiasm. My research focused on the generation of hyaluronic acid (HA) in novel bacterial strains that are initially unable to do generate HA in the first instance. I performed fermentation using sustainable feedstocks and genetic engineering to the strain throughout the course of two months. My strain was shown to be capable of producing HA at the conclusion of the project. Since it was the first time I had created a strain and carried out a fermentation, I truly loved the experiment. I had to do a lot of self-learning before visiting the lab because this was all new to me, and in order to be ready for the assignment. As a result, this endeavour has helped me in a lot of ways. I now have the fortitude to face challenges head-on and the confidence to not feel helpless when faced with them.
优秀的科研经历不仅可以提高我们的学术水平，增强竞争力，掌握更多的技能，在科研中我们也能收获到很多的乐趣，拓宽视野。希望理工学子可以把握住校内外的实习、实践机会，多参与科研活动，勇于创新探索，不断挑战自我！在接下来的系列文章中，我们将继续深入报道更多优秀毕业生在校期间的学习和生活经历，分享他们的感受和故事，希望大家持续关注我们的文章！
Good research experiences can help us advance academically, master more skills, expand our horizons and become more competitive. We hope that more students can be motivated and inspired to engage in research projects and keep exploring their science and engineering disciplines. We will continue to report on the education and experiences of more graduates in upcoming articles, so stay tuned.

宁波诺丁汉大学创建于 2004 年，是中国第一所经教育部批准引进世界一流大学并具有独立法人资格、独立校园的中外合作大学。大学目前有 9000 多名学生，来自世界上70多个国家和地区。

title: 宁波诺丁汉大学入围泰晤士高等教育亚洲大奖年度最佳招生活动榜单
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC shortlisted for the “Student Recruitment Campaign of the Year” award in Times Higher Education Awards Asia.

日前，由国际权威机构泰晤士高等教育（Times Higher Education，简称THE）颁布的2023年泰晤士高等教育亚洲大奖（THE Awards Asia 2023）揭晓了入围名单，作为中国大陆地区入围的5所高校之一，宁波诺丁汉大学凭借着创新的招生策略及其丰硕的成果入选“年度最佳招生活动”榜单。2022年，宁诺因在数字化教学策略上取得的突出成果入围了该奖项的“年度教学策略奖”榜单。


一直以来，泰晤士高等教育大奖（THE Awards）用以表彰高等院校在各个方面所取得的杰出成就，被业界誉为“高等教育界的奥斯卡”。泰晤士高等教育亚洲大奖是其针对亚洲地区高校专门设立的奖项，此次评选收到了亚洲16个国家和地区多所高校的近700份申报。THE首席全球事务官Phil Baty特别谈到，今年的申报数量创历史新高，这意味着对最终入围高校的标准和要求也更高。
主办方表示，随着多元化发展以及来自业内的竞争压力，招生工作需要更具个性、灵活性和创新性。宁诺所入围的“年度最佳招生活动”榜单旨在表彰通过创新的市场宣传有效助力招生工作的开展和提升。
据学校市场及传媒执行总监、招生委员会主席楼月（Phoebe Lou）介绍，面对大环境给招生带来的影响，2021/2022学年是学校优化招生策略、迎难而上的破局之年。在学校执行校长尼克·迈尔斯（Nick Miles）教授的领导和大力支持之下，宁诺招生团队从上至下充分调动学校各方资源，通过全面细致的调研深入了解市场动向，进一步打造宁诺的品牌力，并依托更具影响力的品牌形象大胆地进行招生宣传的数字化转型，拓展和深耕多维度的招生渠道，加强与教育界意见领袖的合作，从而主动应对疫情带来的不确定性，在2021-2022年度赢得了招生质量和数量的双提升。



在新的招生策略的指引下，学校的招生工作延伸到了全球120多个国家和地区，宣传活动覆盖超300余所学校。目前，在校的9000余名学生来自70多个国家和地区，形成了一个国际化、多元化的学生群体。

楼月表示，招生工作对大学至关重要，是实现学校战略目标的先决条件之一。
“我们始终致力于打造一个具有全球影响力的校园，持续助力学生追逐内心的梦想。学校将继续深耕国内外市场，招揽全球范围内最具潜力的优秀学子，通过高质量教学为他们赋能，让学生在无限可能的未来中充分释放自己的潜能，最终成为照亮世界的光。”
UNNC shortlisted for the “Student Recruitment Campaign of the Year” award in Times Higher Education Awards Asia
Times Higher Education (THE) recently published its shortlist for the THE Asia Awards 2023. The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) was successfully shortlisted for its innovative student recruitment strategies for the “Student Recruitment Campaign of the Year” award. In 2022, UNNC was shortlisted for the “Teaching and Learning Strategy of the Year” award for its unique and innovative digital teaching and learning strategies.
Widely known as the “Oscars of Higher Education”, the THE Awards have a prestigious reputation in the UK higher education sector. Phil Baty, Chief Global Affairs Officer of THE, mentioned that the record number of entrants for THE Awards Asia this year indicated an even higher standard of the participants and the finalists.
Mixed with diversity and fierce competition, student recruitment requires more flexibility, innovation, and customisation, according to THE. “Student Recruitment Campaign of the Year” recognises the innovative marketing campaigns that have helped to enhance, expand and improve student recruitment. Phoebe Lou, Executive Director of Marketing and Communications and Chair of the Student Recruitment Committee at UNNC, has illustrated that the 2021-22 academic year was a breakthrough for UNNC in optimising its recruitment strategies and overcoming the hardships. With the support of Professor Nick Miles OBE, UNNC Provost, the UNNC student recruitment team has fully utilised all of the available resources, conducted thorough market research to enhance UNNC’s brand strength, and boldly carried out a digital transformation of student recruitment based on a more powerful brand of UNNC. The team successfully expanded and deepened multi-dimensional recruitment channels, strengthened its cooperation with key opinion leaders in higher education, and proactively managed the ambiguity brought about by the pandemic and improved enrolment quality and quantity.
Led by a new recruitment strategy, the student recruitment activities of UNNC have been extended to over 120 countries and regions, covering over 300 schools. Currently, over 9,000 students from more than 70 countries and regions are studying at the university, forming an international and diversified student community.
Ms. Lou has emphasised that student recruitment is essential for all universities and is one of the prerequisites for a university to achieve its strategic goals. “UNNC has always been committed to creating a campus with a global reach that continuously supports students to pursue their dreams. Therefore, the university will persist in exploring the domestic and international markets to recruit the most talented students from around the world, empower them with high-quality teaching, enable them to fully release their potential in the future, and ultimately become the light that illuminates the world.”

content:
郑

声
明

我校近期收到学生及家长举报，网上谣传以“家长具有统招本科以上学历的高中学生可以免试进入统招批次”，甚至以
“保录宁波诺丁汉大学”等招生途径骗取学生及家长钱财。

宁波诺丁汉大学对此再次郑重声明：我校从未以授权或其他形式与任何社会培训机构或个人开展关于任何招生的“保录项目”，请广大学生及家长注意甄别，切勿轻信任何第三方的所谓承诺，避免上当受骗。

title: 《诺学说》栏目即将上线！遇见名师，预见未来
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - Nottinghorizon: A new way to showcase your future possibilities!
教育的本质是一棵树摇动另一棵树，一朵云推动另一朵云，一个灵魂召唤另一个灵魂。老师并不是生产知识的机器，而是灵魂的向导。教育的根本并不是自上而下的灌输，而是走进学生的内心。
一个优秀的老师是世界观的向导
带你看见不一样的世界
是兴趣的火炬手
在学生心中传递热爱的火种
更是知识的播种人
让求知的快乐在更多人心中开花结果
诺学说
秉承着“无边界”大学的宗旨
以知识分享、视野开拓、智慧启迪为目标
宁波诺丁汉大学视频栏目
《诺学说Nottinghorizon》

  正式启动！

来自世界各地、不同学术领域的教授专家将陆续在栏目中与大家见面。他们将用别开生面、浅显易懂的方式解锁学术象牙塔里的专业知识点，从不同视角和维度探讨热门话题，以激发更多人的学术热情，引领大家迈入未来世界的大门。

让我们来提前遇见自己的学术领路人吧！
/////    
剧透！即将与大家见面的老师有：
Title多到写不下、横跨政商学三界的金融学教授
担任麻省理工VR期刊主编的国际传播学跨界教授
会N种语言的资深语言教育教授
玩转工业和医疗机器人的帅气机械工程专家
……
第一期



第一期率先登场的是机械工程专家、材料与制造助理教授Adam Rushworth，他本科毕业于牛津大学、硕博毕业于英国诺丁汉大学，是工业和医疗机器人方面的专家，参与过许多高端制造业领域的设计项目，包括劳斯莱斯航空引擎的机械电子检测系统研发。
更多专家学者也将紧随其后闪亮登场，赶快来各位老师的先行预告吧！


各位教授专家将会陆续在宁波诺丁汉大学B站、抖音、微信视频号与大家见面，赶紧follow住，千万不要错过这场知识盛宴~
B站
抖音
视频号

那么，你期待哪位老师呢？
对什么话题最感兴趣呢？
快去跟朋友们分享吧！
Nottinghorizon: A new way to showcase your future possibilities!
“The essence of education means that one tree shakes another tree, one cloud pushes another cloud, and one soul awakens another soul,” said Karl Jaspers, a German-Swiss philosopher.
An excellent teacher guides students to view the world rather than tells them about it, passes on their passion and encourages students to explore.
Holding to the vision of constructing a university without borders, the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) is to launch the video programme, “Nottinghorizon”, to share knowledge with a wider audience and make international teaching and research resources more accessible.
The programme invites multiple inspiring UNNC scholars and experts to introduce and present the basics of their fields in a fun way to lay a brief foundation of the subjects, ignite the potential academic interests of the viewers and showcase future facing programmes. Let’s follow their steps to explore the vast ocean of knowledge!
Dr Adam Rushworth, Assistant Professor in Materials and Manufacturing, will appear in the first episode to introduce mechanical engineering. He obtained his undergraduate degree from the University of Oxford and his postgraduate and doctoral degrees from the University of Nottingham, and is an expert in robotics. Dr Rushworth has also participated in multiple projects in advanced manufacturing, including project “REINER” with Rolls Royce.
Who will be the next scholar to share? Check the trailer above for further information!
Please subscribe to the UNNC official account on Bilibili, Douyin, and WeChat for the upcoming episodes.
Share this post to your Moments and the first three people to collect 20 likes will get a collection of recommended books and signature bookmarks!
Number 4-8, 9-18 and 19-38 will get a UNNC limited edition of travel kit, a UNNC diary book, and a pair of rPET UNNC lucky socks, respectively.

title: 宁波诺丁汉大学11人入选2022“中国高被引学者”，来自三大学院
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - 11 UNNC academics ranked in Highly Cited Chinese Researchers list. 
近日，全球性信息分析公司爱思唯尔发布了2022“中国高被引学者”榜单。榜单以全球领先的引文与索引数据库Scopus作为统计来源，评选出5216名各学科最具全球影响力的中国学者。宁波诺丁汉大学11位学者入选，共涉及7个学科，涵盖商学院、人文与社科学院和理工学院。
■ 其中，工商管理学科表现最为亮眼，有4位学者上榜。管理科学与工程紧随其后，有2位学者上榜。入选该学科榜单的张毓隆教授作为引用量最高的学者之一，已是连续八年“霸榜”。
此外，宁诺在应用经济学、理论经济学、教育学、材料科学与工程、计算机科学与技术这5个学科各有一名学者入选。冯安伟教授入选的教育学领域全国仅提名16人，而材料科学与工程的“高被引学者”朱光教授为今年首次入榜。
近年来，宁诺学者的全球影响力已在多个榜单中得到印证。去年，由美国斯坦福大学发布的2022年度“全球前2%顶尖科学家名单”，宁诺有11位学者入围“终身科学影响力排行榜”，15名学者入围“年度科学影响力排行榜”，上榜学者数量创学校历史新高。学科范围涵盖信息系统、人工智能、工商管理、纳米技术、应用物理学、材料学、电子工程和工业工程等多个领域。

高水平人才是高校推进教学科研水平、提升科技创新发展的重要力量。一直以来，宁波诺丁汉大学依托英国诺丁汉大学的优质科教资源，面向全球引进顶尖人才，以多个高能级的产学研平台赋能前沿的科学研究，解决全球性的挑战。
上榜2022“中国高被引学者”的运营管理学教授陈庆佳带领团队发明的专利技术破解了3D打印模型知识产权保护的难题，可推动3D打印技术的进一步发展与应用。纳米材料和设备首席教授朱光团队联合中科院宁波材料技术与工程研究所设计的超稳定、可拉伸电极，可应用于全天候心电监测、智能人机交互系统等方面，助力可穿戴健康监护系统等技术的持续发展。
还有更多宁诺的杰出学者在坚持科研创新的同时，也引领着宁诺学子探索新知，推动了教学与学科建设。在去年发布的2022软科世界一流学科排名榜单上，宁波诺丁汉大学工商管理、管理学、机械工程和电力电子工程4门学科荣登软科世界一流学科榜单，彰显宁诺在相关学科领域内的学术水平和科研质量位居国内高校第一梯队，处于全球领先水平。其中，工商管理和管理学更是连续三年上榜，排名领跑合作类办学机构。
未来，宁波诺丁汉大学将继续以“集全球智慧，解决地方难题”为己任，不断加强国际引才、留才、育才，带动各学科教学与科研实力的提升，服务地方战略发展，为全球性的挑战提供解决方案。
11 UNNC academics ranked in Highly Cited Chinese Researchers list
Recently, world-leading academic publishing company Elsevier officially released the 2022 “Highly Cited Chinese Researchers” list. Based on Elsevier's citation and index database Scopus as a statistical source, the list includes the 5216 most influential Chinese scholars worldwide of various disciplines. 11 academics, from three faculties and seven disciplines, from the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) were listed in the ranking. 
In the discipline of Business Administration, four UNNC academics were listed as “Highly Cited Chinese Researchers”, followed by Management Science and Engineering, with two reaching the rankings. In the discipline of Management Science and Engineering, Professor Alain Chong has been rated as one of the Most Cited Researchers in China for the eighth year running.
In addition, UNNC has five scholars recognised in Theoretical Economics, Applied Economics, Pedagogy, Materials Science, and Computer Science and Technology. Professor Anwei Feng is among only 16 scholars nominated in the field of Pedagogy nationwide, and material scientist Professor Guang Zhu, made the list for the first time.
Over the past few years, UNNC scholars have consistently demonstrated their high academic standards and commitment to world-class research. According to the 2022 version of “World’s Top 2% Scientists” ranking list released by Stanford University, 11 UNNC academics appeared in the career-long database and 15 members of staff in the single year database, setting a new record in the university’s history. Their research covered a variety of capabilities including Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Business and Management, Nanoscience, Applied Physics, Material Sciences, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, and Operations Research.
High-level talent is essential for universities to advance teaching and research and enhance science and technology innovation development. Based on the high-quality scientific and educational resources of the University of Nottingham, UNNC has been introducing top talents from around the globe, empowering cutting-edge scientific research, and solving global challenges.
Professor Hing Kai Chan, Professor of Operations Management listed as one of the “Highly Cited Chinese Researchers”, gained the patent “Digital watermarking method for 3D printing models", which solves the problem of intellectual property protection for 3D printing models. Professor Guang Zhu, Professor in Nanomaterials and Devices, led a research team to successfully design ultra-stable and stretchable electrodes that contribute to the continued development of wearable health monitoring devices.
The university’s academic excellence contributes to pioneering research and drives discipline construction. UNNC has four subjects listed in the 2022 Shanghai Ranking’s Global Ranking of Academic Subjects – Management, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering – indicating that the university’s research capability and research quality are in the first tier among domestic and international universities. Among them, Management and Business Administration have been listed in the ranking for the past three years.
With the responsibility of “introducing global wisdom to solve local problems”, UNNC will continue in the future to introduce international talent, cultivate talent, and support talented academics in pushing the boundaries of knowledge, serving local strategic development, and delivering world-leading research to solve today’s global challenges.

近日，宁波诺丁汉大学公布2023年博士生奖学金政策。学费减免、生活补贴，丰厚奖学金令人瞩目。在已经公布的全额奖学金中，包括学院奖学金、博士生联合培养奖学金、综合类奖学金及诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院奖学金，对应的研究项目多达70个。
与此同时，宁波诺丁汉大学与中科院、浙江大学、深圳大学等国内超一流院所联合开展博士培养。博士生联合培养奖学金也是宁诺的一大亮点，以我校与中国科学院上海药物研究所的联培项目为例，该项目包含抗生物膜肽的发现和生物合成、针对病毒蛋白酶的药物发现等8个可选择的课题，参与研究的博士生可以获得来自宁波诺丁汉大学和中国科学院上海药物研究所双方多位教授共同的倾力指导，提高研究能力和综合素质，培养创新思维与国际化视野。

        在宁诺完成本科和博士学习的“精英博士后” 徐宇尧近日被中国科学院城市环境研究所聘用。他说，“我很幸运与宁波诺丁汉大学的缘分从本科延续到博士，期间得到了宁诺导师们以及中科院城市环境研究所多位研究员乃至院士的帮助，使我最终完成了博士期间的第一篇文章，并成功发表在了中科院一区的期刊上，使我的科研生涯走向正轨。”徐宇尧代表着宁诺博士毕业生们，他们的未来有着无限可能。

刘明昊
硕士毕业于伦敦大学学院
中国科学院上海高等研究院与宁波诺丁汉大学联合培养博士生
研究方向为多孔材料及电化学储能技术

在宁波诺丁汉大学，这个具有国际化的教学环境，让我的博士学习生活和国外硕士经历有着更好的衔接，也让我在研究方面发挥更多主观能动性。同时上海高等研究院让我有机会接触到最前沿的科研项目和研究方向，其优秀的师资力量和科研条件，十分具有吸引力。此外，三年联合培养期间，也可以申请到英国诺丁汉大学交流，与国外实验室开展更深入的交流合作。
2021至今，我以第一作者/共同第一作者发表SCI论文8篇。在导师的指导、团队的合作和努力下，开发了一种具有氧化还原活性单元的卟啉基有机共价框架，实现了OER及ORR双功能高效电催化。
此外在过去两年的博士学习生活中，我最大的收获是科研能力的提升，包含了解决问题的能力、实操经验的积累及对研究领域的了解。首先是解决问题的能力，在科研路上，经常会遇到很多难题，导师会引导我用专业的科学思维来面对问题，并留给我足够的空间去独立思考。其次是实操经验的积累，在导师及同门师兄的带领下，我很快可以独自设计实验流程，进行实验操作。最后，通过联合培养及学术会议，我接触到了很多行业大牛，对自己的研究领域有了更加深刻的了解，明确自己未来的研究方向及发展目标。
高研院与诺丁汉带给我更多的是科研和文化领域细水长流的浸润和影响。无论是科研思维的建立与培养，抑或是专业知识的学习与积累，高研院-宁诺联合培养博士项目都为我今后的科研生涯夯实了坚实的基础。






张凌云，中国科学院上海高等研究院与宁波诺丁汉大学的联合培养博士，研究方向为CCUS技术的低碳潜力研究与全生命周期技术经济环境评价。2020年9月以全额奖学金入学宁波诺丁汉大学（UNNC），2020年9月至2021年7月在UNNC学习，2021年8月至2022年9月于中国科学院上海高等研究院参与科研课题研究，2022年10月至今于英国诺丁汉大学交换学习。
“
       作为联合培养博士，强大的导师团队对我个人的发展和课题研究层层赋能，——两名UNNC导师，一名上海高研院导师，一名英国诺丁汉的导师。在享受双重优秀师资的同时，可以深刻感悟到UNNC国际化的校园氛围。
在学期间，我一直抱着严谨求实的学习态度。在读期间，已发表SCI 论文3篇，在投4篇，参加国际会议3次。
同时我也积极参加志愿活动，丰富第二课堂，UNNC的博雅教育更是让我受益匪浅。在我看来，学习是一场孤独又漫长的旅程，科研的道路不会一帆风顺，我们要以乐观务实的心态去对待生命中的每一天，脚踏实地的走好每一步。高研院-宁诺联合培养博士生项目助力我们选择成为我们想成为的人，逐梦前行，不负青春！

title: 博士招生 | Pick你的2023宁诺博士生联合培养奖学金，4月即将关闭申请
content:
Funding Opportunities
博士生联合培养奖学金
部分奖学金4月15日即将关闭申请，丰厚奖学金等待有科研梦想的学子....
近日，宁波诺丁汉大学公布2023年博士生奖学金政策。学费减免、生活补贴，丰厚奖学金令人瞩目。在已经公布的全额奖学金中，包括学院奖学金、博士生联合培养奖学金、综合类奖学金及诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院奖学金，对应的研究项目多达70个。
与此同时，宁波诺丁汉大学与中科院、浙江大学、深圳大学等国内超一流院所联合开展博士培养。博士生联合培养奖学金也是宁诺的一大亮点，以我校与中国科学院上海药物研究所的联培项目为例，该项目包含抗生物膜肽的发现和生物合成、针对病毒蛋白酶的药物发现等8个可选择的课题，参与研究的博士生可以获得来自宁波诺丁汉大学和中国科学院上海药物研究所双方多位教授共同的倾力指导，提高研究能力和综合素质，培养创新思维与国际化视野。
01

Scholarships at UNNC and SARI, CAS
宁诺与中国科学院上海高等研究院联培奖学金

        在宁诺完成本科和博士学习的“精英博士后” 徐宇尧近日被中国科学院城市环境研究所聘用。他说，“我很幸运与宁波诺丁汉大学的缘分从本科延续到博士，期间得到了宁诺导师们以及中科院城市环境研究所多位研究员乃至院士的帮助，使我最终完成了博士期间的第一篇文章，并成功发表在了中科院一区的期刊上，使我的科研生涯走向正轨。”徐宇尧代表着宁诺博士毕业生们，他们的未来有着无限可能。

刘明昊
硕士毕业于伦敦大学学院
中国科学院上海高等研究院与宁波诺丁汉大学联合培养博士生
研究方向为多孔材料及电化学储能技术

在宁波诺丁汉大学，这个具有国际化的教学环境，让我的博士学习生活和国外硕士经历有着更好的衔接，也让我在研究方面发挥更多主观能动性。同时上海高等研究院让我有机会接触到最前沿的科研项目和研究方向，其优秀的师资力量和科研条件，十分具有吸引力。此外，三年联合培养期间，也可以申请到英国诺丁汉大学交流，与国外实验室开展更深入的交流合作。
2021至今，我以第一作者/共同第一作者发表SCI论文8篇。在导师的指导、团队的合作和努力下，开发了一种具有氧化还原活性单元的卟啉基有机共价框架，实现了OER及ORR双功能高效电催化。
此外在过去两年的博士学习生活中，我最大的收获是科研能力的提升，包含了解决问题的能力、实操经验的积累及对研究领域的了解。首先是解决问题的能力，在科研路上，经常会遇到很多难题，导师会引导我用专业的科学思维来面对问题，并留给我足够的空间去独立思考。其次是实操经验的积累，在导师及同门师兄的带领下，我很快可以独自设计实验流程，进行实验操作。最后，通过联合培养及学术会议，我接触到了很多行业大牛，对自己的研究领域有了更加深刻的了解，明确自己未来的研究方向及发展目标。
高研院与诺丁汉带给我更多的是科研和文化领域细水长流的浸润和影响。无论是科研思维的建立与培养，抑或是专业知识的学习与积累，高研院-宁诺联合培养博士项目都为我今后的科研生涯夯实了坚实的基础。






张凌云，中国科学院上海高等研究院与宁波诺丁汉大学的联合培养博士，研究方向为CCUS技术的低碳潜力研究与全生命周期技术经济环境评价。2020年9月以全额奖学金入学宁波诺丁汉大学（UNNC），2020年9月至2021年7月在UNNC学习，2021年8月至2022年9月于中国科学院上海高等研究院参与科研课题研究，2022年10月至今于英国诺丁汉大学交换学习。
“
       作为联合培养博士，强大的导师团队对我个人的发展和课题研究层层赋能，——两名UNNC导师，一名上海高研院导师，一名英国诺丁汉的导师。在享受双重优秀师资的同时，可以深刻感悟到UNNC国际化的校园氛围。
在学期间，我一直抱着严谨求实的学习态度。在读期间，已发表SCI 论文3篇，在投4篇，参加国际会议3次。
同时我也积极参加志愿活动，丰富第二课堂，UNNC的博雅教育更是让我受益匪浅。在我看来，学习是一场孤独又漫长的旅程，科研的道路不会一帆风顺，我们要以乐观务实的心态去对待生命中的每一天，脚踏实地的走好每一步。高研院-宁诺联合培养博士生项目助力我们选择成为我们想成为的人，逐梦前行，不负青春！

title: 博士招生 | 2023宁波诺丁汉大学联培博士奖学金等你来申请
content:
UNNC Doctoral Training Partnership Scholarships
宁诺联培博士奖学金


 swipe to Chinese👉
UNNC will offer Doctoral Training Partnership (DTP) scholarships, cooperating with first-class universities and institutes, including Ningbo Institute of Industrial Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CNITECH, CAS), Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resource Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGSNRR, CAS), Institute of Urban Environment, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IUE, CAS), Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (SIAT, CAS), and so on. The DTP programmes fields include new materials science, advanced manufacturing, motors and drives, composite materials, energy and the environment, geography, humanities and social sciences. 

       宁波诺丁汉大学博士联合培养项目合作院校包括中国科学院宁波材料技术与工程研究所、中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所、中国科学院城市环境研究所、中国科学院深圳理工大学（筹）等。合作研究领域涵盖新材料科学、先进制造、电机及驱动、复合材料、能源和环境、地理学、人文社会科学等学科。

The following DTP scholarships' application will be closed on 31 March 2023. You are welcomed to apply before the due time!
以下联培博士奖学金将于
2023年3月31日截止，
欢迎大家申请！



In addition to the scholarship, successful candidates also have the opportunity to carry out teaching (after the completion of Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) training) or research assistant duties at UNNC since second year of their PhD programmes.



Doctoral Training Partnership Scholarships at UNNC and CNITECH, CAS

中国科学院宁波材料技术与工程研究所（CNITECH, CAS）成立于2004年4月，是由中国科学院、浙江省、宁波市三方共同出资组建的浙江省首家中科院直属科研机构，是着眼于集技术创新、成果转化、科技服务、人才培育、企业孵化于一体的新型的创新研究机构。下设新材料、先进制造、新能源及生物医学工程四大研究领域，目前全所布局了磁电功能材料与器件、海洋新材料与应用技术、高性能纤维与复合材料、绿色化学与生物基高分子材料、新能源材料与系统技术、光电信息材料与器件、生物医学材料与技术、先进制造技术与装备八大研究方向。

The available PhD scholarship cover
· Tuition Fee
· Monthly stipend (RMB3,500)
· Accommodation at CNITECH for PhD candidate only (accommodation type is based on availability)

崔琪睿
宁波诺丁汉大学与中科院宁波材料所
联合培养博士生

      崔琪睿在崔平教授与杨洪新研究员的共同指导下，提出并证明了具有P4̅m2对称性的单层AX2中存在晶体对称性保护的各向异性DM相互作用，并揭示了该材料体系中存在的诸多新奇铁磁/反铁磁拓扑磁结构。这一类材料可以使基于拓扑磁结构的自旋电子器件具有更简单的结构和更高的运行效率，为构建晶体对称性保护的DM相互作用和拓扑手性磁结构提供了崭新的思路、方法及材料储备。同时，也为开发高性能电子器件做出了贡献。

徐夏薇
@Faculty of Science and Engineering

      作为宁波诺丁汉和宁波材料所联合培养的博士生，我的硕士是在香港科技大学完成，并且正在申请继续攻读博士后，读博士确实没有想象中的那么容易，对科研有很高的要求，但是在宁诺读博的同学大多都是有免学费奖学金和每月补助的，由于我是联合培养的，对不同高校的的体制氛围也有一个很深的了解，宁诺的学术氛围会更加自由，并且有更多的机会去接触到不同的资源。



Doctoral Training Partnership Scholarships at UNNC and IGSNRR, CAS

中国科学院地理科学与资源研究所（IGSNRR, CAS）是国务院学位委员会批准的首批博士、硕士学位授予单位之一。现设有2个一级学科博士研究生培养点：地理学（含自然地理学、人文地理学、地图学与地理信息系统、自然资源学4个二级学科）、生态学；设有环境科学和区域经济学2个二级学科博士研究生培养点。共有在学研究生1019人，在站博士后216人。

Doctoral Training Partnership Scholarships at UNNC and IUE, CAS

中国科学院城市环境研究所（IUE, CAS）是中国科学院下属的事业法人单位，是专门从事城市环境综合研究的国立研究机构，位于美丽的南方海滨城市—厦门市，研究所在宁波设有宁波观测研究站。研究所目前拥有“环境科学与工程”、“生态学”专业一级学科博士、硕士学位授予点、“资源与环境”硕士专业学位授予点以及“环境科学与工程”博士后科研流动站。

我的硕士是在英国南安普顿大学就读，获得了教育学硕士学位，以及Dean's list award，后面因为疫情的原因回到了国内继续攻读博士，并且也获得了宁诺的全额奖学金，而宁诺继承了英国诺丁汉大学的英式教学方法，不像中国的传统教育理念，宁诺更注重我们学生的critical thinking，而且在我们学校的导师和学生有着很平等的交流，我和我的导师的关系也非常好。在生活方面，回到中国最大的感受就是有更多机会与家人朋友团聚，这也大大减少了我的学习压力。



Doctoral Training Partnership Scholarships at UNNC and SIAT, CAS

作为与国际、产业接轨的新型国家科研机构，中国科学院深圳理工大学（筹）（SIAT, CAS）致力于与境内外一流高校建立多形式的教育合作，共同推动高等教育高质量发展。目前，SIAT已与宁波诺丁汉大学签订联合培养协议，双方凭借各自的经验与优势，不断加强人才培养与科研合作，共同培养具有国际视野的拔尖创新人才。

关于宁波诺丁汉大学

宁波诺丁汉大学创建于 2004 年，是中国第一所经教育部批准引进世界一流大学并具有独立法人资格、独立校园的中外合作大学。大学目前有 9000 多名学生，来自世界上70多个国家和地区。

学校已建立商学院、人文与社会科学学院和理工学院三大学院，是全国第一所提供本科、硕士和博士多层次专业教学的中外合作大学。学校致力于培养立足中国、具有国际化视野且能胜任未来的创新型高级人才。

截止至今日，我校已与遍布 44 个国家和地区的近 150 所海外一流院校建立密切交流合作关系。作为国际顶尖研究型大学团体U21的创始成员之一，宁波诺丁汉大学长期致力于为在校生创造丰富的海内外学习机会。

title: 理工满天星 | 听听这13位“牛津剑桥offer”获得者的理工学习体验分享
content:
Vol. 1


理工学院优秀毕业生
FoSE 2023 graduates' study experience sharing



牛
剑
系
列
当春天的微风温柔地吹拂着大地，万物悄然复苏，好消息也随之而至。13位来自宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院的同学在最近陆续收到了来自英国顶尖学府牛津大学和剑桥大学的录取通知书！他们凭借着卓越的学术成绩、优秀的个人素质以及出色的面试表现，在数千名竞争者中脱颖而出，成功地进入了世界顶尖大学的殿堂。让我们一起分享这些喜悦，听听他们的宁诺故事、对于自己所读专业的理解，并期待着他们在未来的学习中收获更多精彩和成就！

Swipe right for the English version
As the spring breeze gently blows across the land and everything comes back to life, so does the good news. Recently, 13 students from the Faculty of Science and Engineering have finally received their offers from the top UK universities, Oxford and Cambridge! With their outstanding academic results, excellent personal qualities, and outstanding interview performances, they have been selected among thousands of competitors and have successfully entered the halls of the world's top universities. Let's share these joys and hear their stories! 





王子铭
电气工程及其自动化（2+2）
北京师范大学第二附属中学
剑桥大学工程学博士
牛津大学工程学博士，全额奖学金
牛津大学风能和海洋能源系统和结构博士

PhD in Engineering, Cambridge
DPhil in Engineering Science, Oxford, wirh full scholarship
DPhil Wind and Marine Energy Systems and Structures EPSRC CDT, Oxford 

大一的时候我参与了学校方程式赛车团队，在那里我体验到了一套完整专业的电机控制系统，这令我对电气工程及其自动化（EEE）专业的兴趣更加深厚。之后在EEE的学习中，专业课程的设置广泛，不仅涉及了纯电子电气领域的知识，更重要的是其强大的跨学科潜力。它是一个覆盖范围很广的专业，未来的方向包括生物医疗、航空航天、软件工程等领域。在每一学年都有关于电子电气在其他工程学领域应用的课程，这些课程可以极大的开阔我们的眼界并给我们以新的想法。
My interest in electronic and electrical engineering was sparked in my first year of college, during the time I joined the university's Formula Racing Team. There, I got to use a full complement of professional motor control systems, which stoked my curiosity in the field. Later, during my study of EEE, the environment of professional courses helped me to realize that EEE has strong interdisciplinary potential that not only requires knowledge of the pure electronic and electrical field. The future directions of this broad-based major include biomedical, aerospace, software engineering, etc. There are classes on applying electronics to different engineering disciplines offered every academic year, which can substantially expand our perspectives and inspire fresh thinking.





朱浚哲
统计学（2+2）
浙江省宁波市柴桥中学
牛津大学数学建模与科学计算理学硕士
牛津大学统计科学理学硕士
剑桥大学数学统计硕士

MSc in Mathematical Modelling and Scientific Computing, Oxford
MSc in Statistical Science, Oxford
MASt in Mathematical Statistics, Cambridge
学习是没有上限的，学习数理更是如此。当我一步步深入学习数理统计方面的知识时，我意识到学习这样的一门专业，有着广泛而且有益的效用。首先，学到的应用数学、概率和统计的基本知识以及关于物理、金融等方面的建模技能，可以为我们之后的学习和工作提供很大程度的支持。其次，在与任课老师的沟通交流中，他们为我提供了指引，这也使我对感兴趣的方面有更深层次的理解，为我之后的研究方向提供了新的可能和选择。最后，学习数学也可以使我们的思维变得更加灵动，看待问题会更加辩证。  
There is no upper limit to learning, and so is learning mathematics and science. As I learned more about mathematical statistics, I became aware of the broad and advantageous effects of this subject. Firstly, our later study and work can be greatly aided by having a solid foundation in applied mathematics, probability, and statistics as well as modeling abilities in the areas of physics, finance, and other topics. Secondly, the professor's help throughout our discussions allowed me to gain a deeper understanding of the topics I was interested in as well as new options and options for the path of my future studies. Finally, learning mathematics can help us think more flexibly and dialectically about issues.





张亦栋
航空航天工程（4+0）
浙江省余姚市姚中书院
剑桥大学能源技术哲学硕士 
帝国理工学院高级航空工程硕士 

MPhil in Energy technologies, Cambridge
MSc Advanced Aeronautical Engineering, Imperial College London

航空航天工程专业比我想象的要更综合和系统性。大学四年中我们既要学习和各类飞行器有关的材料、制造、结构分析、飞行机制、硬件领域知识，还要学习飞行器建模、电气控制、流体模拟等软件知识。在工程设计项目中，我们需要综合运用这些课堂内的知识点和技巧，并且应用于实际项目之中。这种对于知识的梳理和搭建知识框架的技能，对日后的学习工作会非常有益。除了第一课堂外，我也慢慢领悟了许多为人处世的道理。四年的宁诺生活教会我的不止是行于表面的“严于律己，宽以待人”，而是切实地“put yourself in other people’s shoes”，是一种可贵的共情能力。
I was wrong about how comprehensive and systematic the Aerospace Engineering programme is. We learn software skills such as aircraft modelling, electrical control, and fluid simulation over the four years of university in addition to the material science, manufacturing, structural analysis, and flying mechanism. We learn how to apply these concepts and skills in class to real-world tasks in engineering design. The life-long learning skills and self-learning skills will benefit my career development. Along with the curriculum studies, I also learned how to put myself in other people’s shoes. I believe empathy is a valuable quality for me.




王著堃 
电气工程及其自动化（2+2）
辽宁省大连市第十二中学
牛津大学工程科学博士，全额奖学金

DPhil in Engineering Science, Oxford, with full scholarship

宁诺的电气工程及其自动化专业并不像国内大学的电气专业有一个具体方向，而是更倾向于电子电气领域的通识类教育，会让学生在不同的课中接触不同的研究方向，如电力电子、通讯、集成电路、控制、软件、单片机、信号处理等，可以让学生有更多的机会和时间来思考自己未来到底想从事什么方向，自己究竟对什么感兴趣，也降低了试错的成本。
Electrical and Electronic Engineering at UNNC is more geared toward general education in the field of electronics and electrical than electrical majors in local colleges. Students will be exposed to different research directions in different courses, such as power electronics, communication, integrated circuit, control, software, single-chip microcomputer, signal processing, etc. Students may have more time to consider their future goals and genuine interest.





张旖驰 
数学与应用数学（2+2） 
浙江省湖州中学
牛津大学统计科学理学硕士
剑桥大学数据密集型科学哲学硕士

MSc in Statistical Science, Oxford
MPhil in Data Intensive Science, Cambridge

高三时，我来宁诺参加了三位一体招生考试，非常喜欢校园里的学习环境。而且，我遇到的所有人都很热心友好，给我们留下了很好的印象。就读宁诺的数学与应用数学专业之后，我发现数学理论的普适性以及重要性，并且发现在学习了数学之后，未来的选择方向相当之丰富。我觉得最大的收获就是打下了坚实的数学与统计基础。这不仅让我获得了较为理想的成绩，帮助我争取到较好的科研机会，更让我能胜任实习和科研的工作，并且在实践中学习更加进阶的知识。

I visited UNNC and attended TUST exam before the Gaokao and I really liked the learning environment on campus. Every student and staff I met here was warm and welcoming, which left an impression at that time. After getting enrolled in Mathematics with Applied Mathematics programme, I discovered the significance of universality’s mathematical education. I realised that mathematics as a basic science opened a broad career pathway for me. I have laid a strong mathematical and statistical foundation here in the UNNC. I could also gain many internships and research experience to consolidate my knowledge.





尹卓
化学（2+2）
上海市川沙中学
牛津大学计算理论化学理学硕士
剑桥大学科学计算哲学硕士
帝国理工学院软电子材料研究型硕士

MSc in Theoretical and Computational Chemistry, Oxford
MPhil in Scientific Computing, Cambridge
MRes in Soft Electronic Materials, Imperial College London

宁诺有丰富的暑期科研实习机会，化学专业的研究方向包括但不限于有机合成、材料、药物和生物、计算化学、广谱等等。我们可以自由选择感兴趣的研究方向和导师，获得深入了解某个领域的机会，也学到很多课程外的专业知识。这些经历作为申研的材料丰富了我们的学术背景，丰富多彩的社团组织经历也历练了我的各种工作能力。
In addition to organic synthesis, materials, drugs and biology, computational chemistry, broad spectrum, and other areas, UNNC offers a wide range of summer research internship opportunities. We have the freedom to select the research topic and advisor of our choosing, giving us the chance to get extensive professional expertise outside of the classroom and gain a comprehensive understanding of a particular sector. These encounters may also serve as resources for enhancing our background. My diverse working abilities have also been honed through my rich and colorful involvement with community organizations.





张宏峰
化学工程与工艺（4+0）
浙江省温州育英国际实验中学
剑桥大学高级化学工程哲学硕士

MPhil in Advanced Chemical Engineering, Cambridge

宁波诺丁汉大学教学设施先进、学术资源丰富、学习环境优良。在宁诺我参与了丰富的课余生活，学会工作与生活的合理分配。化学工程是理工学院的优势专业之一，有良好的师资和教学设备来支持我们的学习，以提高我们的知识和实践技能。对于学习的考核，除了传统的考试，我们还会有很多的小组作业。在小组合作任务中，我们学会了与人沟通、与人协调，并在小组中发挥重要作用，锻炼了我们将来步入社会时必须掌握的基本能力。
UNNC offers state-of-the-art classroom amenities, abundant learning materials, and a superb learning atmosphere. At UNNC, I took part in extracurricular activities and learned how to balance work and life judiciously. Chemical Engineering is the most popular major at Polytechnic, and it has excellent instructors and instructional resources to help our studies and advance our theoretical and practical expertise. We will have a lot of group coursework in addition to the standard exam for the assessment of learning. To complete the task of group cooperation, we must develop the fundamental skills needed when we eventually join the society. These skills include the ability to communicate and coordinate with others.





姜笑涵
数学与应用数学（4+0）
江苏省无锡市第一中学
剑桥大学人口健康科学哲学硕士

MPhil in Population Health Sciences,  Cambridge

数学是非常有趣的一门学科，构建了理论与实践的桥梁，使看似枯燥的数字与符号变得有趣。在就读数学与应用数学中，我接触到了更广阔的数学领域，比如概率、统计、线性代数等等，并且认识到如何把数学知识运用实际，比如通过建模和数据分析来预测传染病趋势等等。除了课堂学习和科研经历，宁诺丰富的课余活动和社团组织也让我难忘，在活动中我结交到了很多志同道合的朋友，可以一起学习、一起运动。
（上图左一为姜笑涵）
Mathematics is a very interesting subject, which builds a bridge between theory and practice and makes seemingly boring numbers and symbols interesting. In the study of mathematics and applied mathematics, I became familiar with more general areas of mathematics, including probability, statistics, linear algebra, and others. I also became aware of how to use mathematics in real-world applications, such as modeling and data analysis to analyze and forecast the trend of infectious diseases. Along with gaining knowledge and experience in scientific research, UNNC's abundant extracurricular activities and associations also left a lasting impression on me. In the activities, I made many like-minded friends with whom I could study and do sports.





宋一璇
化学工程与工艺（4+0)
河北省石家庄二中实验学校
剑桥大学高级化学工程哲学硕士

MPhil in Advanced Chemical Engineering, Cambridge

在宁诺的学习中，我最大的收获在于学习方式的转变。高中阶段，我很依赖老师对内容的讲解，自我输出能力很弱。而当上了大学之后，逐渐发现了老师讲课不会再去讲具体的解题方法、做题步骤，而是偏向于引导型授课。这让我有了独立思考的能力，对题目有了自己的想法和认知，明白了在学习的过程中没有绝对的错误和正确，只有够不够严谨的思维、够不够安全的设计，我很喜欢这种授课模式，它给了我充分的思考空间，让我体会到了主动学习的快乐。
The adjustment in my learning method has been the most beneficial aspect of my study of UNNC. In high school, I relied on teachers to explain the material because of my poor self-output skills. When I started at the institution, I eventually discovered that the professor tended to direct teaching rather than discuss specific methods and steps to solve difficulties. I can now think for myself, form my own opinions on the subject, and understand that there is no definitive right or wrong when it comes to learning, only careful consideration and safe construction. I enjoy this teaching style a lot since it allows me room to think and helps me understand the joy of active learning.





刘奕欣
材料成型及控制工程（2+2）
河南省郑州市第一中学
剑桥大学微型及纳米技术企业哲学硕士
剑桥大学能源技术哲学硕士
帝国理工学院高级机械工程理学硕士

MPhil in Micro-and Nanotechnology Enterprise, Cambridge
MPhil in Energy Technologies, Cambridge
MSc Advanced Mechanical Engineering, Imperial College London

材料成型及控制工程是一个发展前景非常多元化的专业。本科学习阶段为我们的未来学习打下数学、物理的基础。除了最基础的课程，我们还要学流体、计算机编程控制、工业设计、材料科学、工程管理等等的知识，课程设置很丰富。除了专业课的学习，也有很多自己动手设计制造东西的机会，是一个很有趣的专业。基于本科多样的课程设置，我们在升研时的选择也会有很多，可以选择机器人、能源技术、航空航天、生物医疗、材料科学、汽车制造等等，之后就业的方向也会很广泛。
The field of mechanical engineering offers a variety of career opportunities. Mechanical engineering will build the physics and math foundations for our future during undergraduate study. We also need to learn about fluid, computer programming and control, industrial design, materials science, engineering management, and other topics in addition to the most fundamental courses. In addition to the study of specialist courses, there are also numerous opportunities to design and manufacture things by yourself, which is a highly intriguing major. We will have a wide range of options for postgraduate study based on a variety of undergraduate courses, including robotics, energy technology, aerospace, biomedicine, materials science, automotive, and more. After that, we will have a wide range of employment directions.





胡世越
化学工程与工艺（2+2）
浙江省宁波中学
剑桥大学高级化学工程哲学硕士

MPhil in Advanced Chemical Engineering, Cambridge

从对化工领域几乎一无所知开始，到现在可以与同学一起完成一项完整工程的设计，在实验室内单独完成一项对于微生物基因编辑的研究，这三年的学习获得的知识以及经验让我拥有自信，让我不会面对一项难题束手无策，而是拥有了迎难而上的勇气。 化学工程与工艺专业的课程设置非常注重知行合一，不仅每一个学年的理论课都设有实验以及团体作业，而且每一学年都有单独的一门流程设计项目要求学生们组队，结合所学的知识和国际标准设计工艺流程，大大提升了学生的综合能力。
From being almost ignorant of the chemical industry to now I can complete the main design of a complete project with my classmates and complete research on microbial gene editing alone in the laboratory. With the confidence I've gained from these three years of study and the information and experience I've gained; I can now approach a challenging challenge head-on rather than feeling helpless in the face of it. The combination of theory and practice is highly valued in the Chemical Engineering and Technology program. A separate process design project requires students to form a team and design a process in combination with the knowledge they have learned. International standards are required in each academic year in addition to the experiments and group work that are part of the theoretical courses, greatly enhancing the student’s overall ability.





邬正一
化学工程与工艺（2+2）
浙江省杭州高级中学（钱江校区）
剑桥大学高级化学工程哲学硕士
剑桥大学能源技术哲学硕士
帝国理工学院高级化学工程理学硕士

MPhil in Advanced Chemical Engineering, Cambridge
MPhil in Energy Technologies, Cambridge
MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering, Imperial College London

我们系的系主任Philip Hall教授在我刚进大二的讲座上说的一句话，很好的概括了我对于化工的认识——通过系统的化工学习，人能够具备学习和完成大多数非专业性（如医学/法律）事情的能力。化工的课程内容兼顾了数学、物理、化学、生物工程等专业方向，教学设计中也涵盖了对于经济、项目管理、环境与可持续等方面的考量。系统的化工课程学习有助于培养全面多维的思考方式，有利于灵活机动的解决生活中遇到的各种问题。大四的毕业设计，不仅是对于前几年所学知识的融会贯通和应用，也是对于所感兴趣学科领域的拓展与延伸。更重要的是，在项目团队设计过程中，我们的团队协作和时间管理能力都有所锻炼。

Professor Philip Hall, Head of the Department, had once concluded my understanding of Chemical Engineering that through systematic chemical engineering learning, people can have the ability to learn and complete most non-professional things. The programme equips you with many transferable skills. We learned mathematics, physics, chemistry, biological engineering, economics, project management, the environment and sustainability. Learning chemical engineering in a systematic approach encourages the development of a broad, multifaceted perspective. It increases our capabilities to solve the grand challenges in the fast-changing world. The final year project allows me to review and reflect on everything we have learned in the past three and half years, it also allows me to extend my interested areas. More importantly, my teamwork skills and time management skills have been improved.





陈英捷
化学（2+2）
浙江省宁波市效实中学
剑桥大学化学哲学硕士
帝国理工学院纳米材料研究型硕士

MPhil in Chemistry, Cambridge
MRes Nanomaterials, Imperial College London

我觉得宁诺可能是一个可以实现自我提升的性价比比较高的平台。通过宁诺的学习，我对于研究以及学科有了更深的认识，也获得了专业知识的积累。我还记得当时有一位实验室的助教老师是化工专业的在读博士生，他很耐心的教我们怎么做实验，帮我们解决问题，还给我们看他正在写的论文。后面我也和他保持了比较密切的联系，不管是在技能上还是在后续的专业方向思考上，他都是一位非常好的领路人。

（上图左二为陈英捷同学）
I think UNNC is a relatively cost-effective platform that can realise huge self-improvement. I have a deeper understanding of research and disciplines in the British education system. I still remember that there was a teaching assistant in the laboratory who was a PhD student majoring in chemical engineering. He has left me with the impression as he patiently taught us how to do experiments and how to do research properly. He is a very good mentor and I also keep in close contact with him.



关于未来，关于梦想，我们在宁诺学子的身上看到了无限的可能。这个收获满满的毕业季，印证了他们的热忱，努力和收获。


在接下来的系列文章中，我们将继续深入报道更多优秀毕业生在校期间的学习和生活经历，分享他们的感受和故事。希望大家持续关注我们的文章，共同见证更多充满喜悦和成就的时刻！

We see infinite possibilities in their future and dreams. This rewarding graduation season is a testament to their enthusiasm, hard work and efforts. In the coming series of articles, we will continue to report more in-depth articles on the study and life experiences of our outstanding graduates, sharing their feelings and stories. We hope you will continue to follow our article series and witness more moments of joy and achievement together!

关于宁波诺丁汉大学

宁波诺丁汉大学创建于 2004 年，是中国第一所经教育部批准引进世界一流大学并具有独立法人资格、独立校园的中外合作大学。大学目前有 9000 多名学生，来自世界上70多个国家和地区。

学校已建立商学院、人文与社会科学学院和理工学院三大学院，是全国第一所提供本科、硕士和博士多层次专业教学的中外合作大学。学校致力于培养立足中国、具有国际化视野且能胜任未来的创新型高级人才。

截止至今日，我校已与遍布 44 个国家和地区的近 150 所海外一流院校建立密切交流合作关系。作为国际顶尖研究型大学团体U21的创始成员之一，宁波诺丁汉大学长期致力于为在校生创造丰富的海内外学习机会。

title: 又一枚剑桥offer！宁诺化工学子连连斩获剑桥大学录取通知书
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC Chemical Engineering students win Cambridge offers.
近日，宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院传来喜报，化学工程与工艺专业张宏峰斩获剑桥大学的录取通知书。截至发稿时，化学工程与工艺专业胡世越和宋一璇也拿到了剑桥大学的offer。
这个专业的学生缘何特别受到名校的青睐？  





两段扎实暑研经历获赏识



纵览张宏峰的简历，大三逼近90分的优秀成绩、班级前1%的排名，数次荣获省级和校级奖学金，学术表现可谓杰出。但在张宏峰看来，两段扎实的暑期科研项目经历，让他能够在剑桥面试中侃侃而谈，最终获得面试官的赏识。
大二暑期，张宏峰选择了与个人导师研究领域相关的旋流管输送粉料气动装置研制。该项目旨在帮助工厂节能减耗、降本增效。他解释，传统的风力输送装置多用直管，粉料容易沉积在管壁内，不仅能耗高而且材料损耗较大，这一直以来都是粉体输送不可避免的技术难题。相比之下，他们要研究的项目所设计的涡旋流管能够让粉料均匀分布，解决了沉积问题，使得工厂对连续输送粉料、低磨损低能耗的期待成为现实。

张宏峰表示，在参与设计装置时他能够将课堂学习的工业设计内容成功地应用到实操中，完美实现了理论与实践的统一。

初试科研项目后，张宏峰很快意识到自己在科研方面的热情。大三暑假，他就目光转向了材料，并参加了生物石墨烯材料的设计与开发暑期科研项目。石墨烯因其非凡的特性在材料学、能源、生物医学等方面具有重要的应用前景，是一种未来革命性的材料。然而从矿石中提取石墨烯虽然纯度高，但资源有限。因此研发以天然绿色植物秸秆等为原料的生物质石墨烯，更加符合可持续发展的要求，推动产业绿色转型。
张宏峰在项目组中则主要负责数据的分析与评估。通过计算比较，评估不同方法生产的生物质石墨烯对环境的影响，为未来合成高质量、高收率的石墨烯材料提供方法参考。

正是这两段科研经历，不仅成为他简历上浓墨重彩的一笔，更是帮助张宏峰明晰了自己对职业的期待与规划，让面试官看到了他极强的未来可塑性。




宝藏专业的无限可能性



在宁诺求学的四年时光，张宏峰认为学校独特的教学内容与实践对自己的专业、职业发展有着巨大的影响。在谈到对专业的理解时，他表示：
很多人可能对生化环材有一些误解，觉得毕业之后只能去化工厂，但我在宁诺感受到的截然相反，非常想为我们专业正名。这是一门就业前景非常广泛的学科，可以在医药、生物、材料等领域探索。
数据显示，在英国，化学工程与工艺专业的本科毕业生起薪在所有专业中排名第三，仅次于牙医和医学类专业。一张具有“国际认证”的学位证书，是学生们升学和就业的一块金牌敲门砖。在宁诺化学与环境工程系，往届毕业生的就业去向包括联合国环境署驻北京办事处、摩根史坦利中国、埃克森美孚公司及各级政府环境保护部门。2020届化学与环境工程系的毕业生数据显示 ，选择继续深造的学生中超85%的毕业生进入了全球大学排名前50的大学深造。
在张宏峰看来，学校提供的一系列英式课程内容，是自己在一众竞争者中脱颖而出的一大关键。宁波诺丁汉大学化学工程与工艺专业拥有英国化学工程师协会认证和英国材料、矿物和矿业学会认证，为中国内地唯一获得双认证的高校。张宏峰便是英国化学工程师协会的一名学生会员。
在教学方式上，他提到，宁诺的课程以小班化教学、合作式学习为特点，通过一系列设计任务引导学生自主学习，将所学知识进行创新性的应用，同时注重学生安全与环境可持续意识的培养。在专业师生比在1:8左右的情况下，学生几乎可以获得明星教授的一对一指导。
我的个人导师是Philip，他有很多年的企业工作经验和教学经验，教授过化学与环境工程系大部分现有课程，大家都很喜爱他。我还特别感激他能够帮我模拟面试辅导，模拟之后，我在面试剑桥的时候就没有那么紧张了。
回顾大学四年，张宏峰觉得过得很充实。不仅在学业上收获了满意的结果，而且在学校活动和社团中结交了不少朋友，攀岩社、飞盘社、乒乓球社……作为一名健身爱好者，平日里和朋友一起运动无疑是最放松的快乐时光。

我喜欢在这种自由包容，支持个人多元化个性化发展的环境里求学，我很幸运当时选择了宁诺。

UNNC Chemical Engineering students win Cambridge offers 
 
The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) recently received good news. Hongfeng Zhang, Shiyue Hu and Yixuan Song, all students of Chemical Engineering, have successively received offers from the University of Cambridge.
 
In Hongfeng’s opinion, it was not his exceptional academic performance, ranking in the top 1% or winning provincial scholarships, but his research experience that helped him excel during the Cambridge interview.
 
During the summer vacation in his second year, Hongfeng worked on a project to develop a pneumatic device which conveys powder through a cyclone tube that contributes to solving the traditional problem of high energy consumption and material loss, helping factories save energy and reduce costs. During the process, he successfully integrated theory with actual practice, and soon realised his passion for scientific research.
 
The summer after, Hongfeng participated in the summer research placement programme on design and development of bio-graphene materials. The team aimed to develop biomass graphene from natural green plants to promote the green transformation of the industry to achieve sustainable development. Hongfeng was responsible for the data analysis and evaluation in the team, providing a methodological reference for the future synthesis of high-quality and high-yield graphene materials through computational comparison.
 
This scientific research experience helped Hongfeng to clarify his future plans for his career path. In addition, the university's unique curriculum and practices have had a huge impact on his professional and career development. “UNNC has shown me that Chemical Engineering is a subject with a very wide range of career prospects and can be explored in the fields of medicine, biology, and materials. Personally, I'd prefer to move into finance," said Hongfeng.
 
In the UK, the starting salary of undergraduates studying chemical engineering ranks third among all majors, second only to dentists and medical related majors. A degree certificate with international accreditation substantially enhances students’ competitiveness in further study and employment. At UNNC, previous employment destinations of graduates from the School include the UNEP office in Beijing, Morgan Stanley China, ExxonMobil and environmental protection departments of government at all levels. According to the employability report, more than 85% of Class 2020 students who chose to continue their studies were admitted to world top 50 universities.
 
To Hongfeng, the International education he received at UNNC is the key to making him stand out from others. The undergraduate course in Chemical Engineering at UNNC has dual accreditation from the Institution of Chemical Engineers (UK) and the Institute of Materials, Minerals and Mining (UK). The seminars and cooperative learning mode aim to cultivate active learning skills and encourage innovative application. He appreciates his personal tutor, Dr Philip Hall, who spent extra time in order to help Hongfeng prepare for the interview.
 
Looking back on his four years at UNNC, Hongfeng feels fulfilment with both his academic and personal life. He made friends in university activities and societies such as rock climbing, flying disc sports, and table tennis. "I like the idea of studying in a free and inclusive environment that supports individual development, and I’m glad I chose UNNC."

About UNNC
关于宁波诺丁汉大学

宁波诺丁汉大学创建于 2004 年，是中国第一所经教育部批准引进世界一流大学并具有独立法人资格、独立校园的中外合作大学。大学目前有 9000 多名学生，来自世界上70多个国家和地区。

学校已建立商学院、人文与社会科学学院和理工学院三大学院，是全国第一所提供本科、硕士和博士多层次专业教学的中外合作大学。学校致力于培养立足中国、具有国际化视野且能胜任未来的创新型高级人才。

截止至今日，我校已与遍布 44 个国家和地区的近 150 所海外一流院校建立密切交流合作关系。作为国际顶尖研究型大学团体U21的创始成员之一，宁波诺丁汉大学长期致力于为在校生创造丰富的海内外学习机会。

title: DTP | UNNC-SDU DTP Signing Ceremony 宁波诺丁汉大学携手山东大学联合培养博士研究生
content:
✦✦✦

On 30 March 2023, the signing ceremony of Doctoral Training Partnership (DTP) programme between UNNC and Shandong University (SDU) was held. During the ceremony, Professor Giampaolo Buticchi (Associate Dean for Research & Knowledge Exchange, Faculty of Science and Engineering, UNNC) delivered a welcome speech. Professor Patrick Chau (Vice Provost for Research and Knowledge Exchange, UNNC) and Professor Guoliang Liu (Executive Associate Dean, Graduate School, SDU) signed the agreement on collaborative PhD training in the fields of Transportation Infrastructures, and Green Energy and Resources.

2023年3月30日，宁波诺丁汉大学与山东大学就联合培养博士研究生项目进行了签约仪式。理工学院科研及知识交流副院长姜保罗教授在签约仪式上致欢迎辞。宁波诺丁汉大学科研及知识交流副校长周荫强教授与山东大学研究生院常务副院长刘国亮教授签署了合作协议，双方将在交通工程及绿色能源与资源两个科研领域共同发展创新型博士培养体系，培养具有国际视野的高水平博士人才。

swipe for more 滑动查看更多图片


01
Welcome speech
from Professor Giampaolo Buticchi 

“
It is my great pleasure today to represent the Faculty of Science and Engineering at UNNC in this moment, which represents a milestone in the collaboration between our university and the prestigious Shandong University.

我非常高兴今天能代表宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院欢迎山东大学各位领导和教授们的到来。本次签约仪式代表着宁波诺丁汉大学和著名学府山东大学之间开展合作的一个里程碑。

I believe that it’s a unique opportunity for the future students to carry out research at two institutions, being supervised by excellent academics from both sides, and become ambassadors of both institutions. It is our hope that this will also bring the professors from our institutions closer, further increasing the possibilities for collaborations.

我相信联合培养对于学生来说是一个独特的机会，他们能在两所大学开展研究，获得双方优秀学者的合作指导，并成为两所大学的学生大使。我们希望通过联合培养项目拉近两所大学之间的距离，并进一步加深合作。
”


02
Speech
from Professor Guoliang Liu

“
UNNC focuses on developing the international perspective of students, has a strong international academic atmosphere, and actively engages in international and interdisciplinary research collaboration and academic exchange. The collaboration between our universities reflects this very characteristic.

宁波诺丁汉大学注重学生国际视野的开拓，国际化学术氛围浓厚，积极开展跨国跨界跨学科科研合作和学术交流。此次两校的合作正是这一传统办学风格的体现。

Similarly, at Shandong University, we have always practised the principle of “nurture talent for the world and seek prosperity for the nation”. The in-depth collaboration in joint doctoral training with UNNC will be a positive measure for us to implement Shandong university's strategies and improve the quality of doctoral training in an open and integrated way.

同样地，我们山东大学也一直践行“为天下储人才，为国家图富强”的办学宗旨。与宁诺在博士生培养领域的深度合作将是我们贯彻落实学校发展战略，在开放融汇中提升博士生培养质量的积极举措。

Shandong University and UNNC have established a sincere and mutually beneficial relationship and achieved fruitful results in cultivating high-level talents with an international perspective. At a new starting point with new opportunities, let us start from the mission and vision of both universities, further promote our friendship and cooperation, and together write a new chapter in higher education and talent training!

在过去的时间里，山东大学和宁波诺丁汉大学打造了真诚友好、互利共赢的校际合作典范，在培养具有国际视野的高层次人才方面取得了丰硕成果。站在新的历史起点，面临新的历史机遇，让我们从两校的初心使命和发展愿景出发，赓续友谊，推进合作，在高水平国际化办学、高层次人才联合培养方面共同谱写崭新篇章！
”

03
Fast facts about the university
校所简介

✦ About UNNC ✦
University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) was the first Sino-foreign university to open its doors in China. Established in 2004, with the full approval of the Chinese Ministry of Education, we are run by the University of Nottingham in partnership with Zhejiang Wanli Education Group, a key player in the education sector in China. UNNC was awarded a licence to grant PhDs in December 2008. Now UNNC has 348 PhD graduates and 687 registered PhD students.

宁波诺丁汉大学于2004年经教育部批准成立，是中国第一所具有独立校园、独立法人资格的中外合作大学，也是英国诺丁汉大学全球教育体系的重要成员之一。宁波诺丁汉大学于2008年获教育部批准开展博士研究生教育，目前有687名注册博士生，348名博士生顺利毕业。

The University has earned an excellent reputation after 19 years of growth, and UNNC’s founding was selected as one of the 60 biggest events in ‘New China 60 Year Education’ published by the Ministry of Education. In the 2020 Best Chinese University Ranking released in May 2020 by Shanghai Ranking Consultancy, UNNC was ranked No. 68 in China and the second in Zhejiang.

宁波诺丁汉大学经过十九年办学，树立了良好的社会口碑，学校的创办被载入教育部编制的《奠基中国——新中国教育60 年》的60件大事之一。2020年5月上海软科公布的“中国最好大学排行榜”中，宁波诺丁汉大学位列全国第68位、浙江省第二位。

✦ About SDU ✦
Shandong University, or SDU – under the direct jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education – is a key comprehensive university with a long and honorable history, a broad variety of disciplines, strong academic strength and distinctive characteristics, which has had a great influence both at home and abroad. In 2017, SDU was chosen as one of the first group of China's high-level universities to be listed in the double first-class university programme released by the central government of China.

山东大学是一所历史悠久、学科齐全、实力雄厚、特色鲜明的教育部直属重点综合性大学，在国内外具有重要影响，2017年顺利迈入世界一流大学建设高校（A类）行列。

At present, 18 subjects have been listed in the top one percent of subjects in the Essential Science Indicators (ESI), an index showing the competitiveness of a subject published by the Institute for Scientific Information. In addition, five of the university’s subjects were listed in the top 1‰ in the ESI rankings. SDU has also established cooperation with nearly 200 universities in more than 30 countries or regions. The university currently has four affiliated hospitals and 15 non-subordinate affiliated hospitals. Its full-time student population totals around 67,000 students.

山东大学18个学科的学术影响力和贡献能力进入ESI世界排名前1%，5个学科进入ESI前1‰，与30多个国家和地区的200余所学校签署了校际合作协议。学校现有在校生近7万人，拥有多家直属附属医院。


UNNC is a fast growing hub for excellence in research, innovation and knowledge exchange.
Driven by our collaboration with the Ningbo Government and industry partners, we provide solutions to local challenges through world-class research and innovation.

title: 学生故事丨四年学费全免，李叶耀珍奖学金得主们分享大学学习生活
content:
李叶耀珍奖学金由香港声宝—乐声有限公司主席李达三先生及其夫人叶耀珍女士捐资设立，旨在奖励来宁诺求学的诚实守信、品学兼优、爱国爱乡、勤奋自律，具有创新精神、批判性思维和发展潜能的优秀高考学生。若获奖学生在校学习期间能符合复评条件，总奖学金金额可以覆盖本科阶段的所有学费。近日，基金会采访了三位大四的李叶耀珍奖学金获得者，他们连续通过复评获得全额奖学金，让我们一起看看他们的精彩大学生活！
The Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship was donated by Dr. Li Dak Sum and his wife Mrs. Li Yip Yio Chin. The Scholarship aims to award outstanding Gaokao students who have joined UNNC and show the values of honesty, trustworthiness, patriotism, innovation, diligence, and self-discipline. If the awardees meet the conditions for re-evaluation during their studies, the total scholarship amount will cover all tuition fees during their undergraduate studies. Recently, the Foundation interviewed three fourth year Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship recipients, who are the above-mentioned outstanding students who receive full scholarships every year. Let's take a look at their stories!
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version



李卓尔

材料成型及控制工程专业大四学生

Zhuoer Li

Final year student majoring in Mechanical Engineering
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


李卓尔来自宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院，是材料成型及控制工程专业的一名大四学生。她很早开始就对材料科学很感兴趣，而这个专业也正涵盖了材料学、材料制造、机械设计等各类课程。通过这4年的学习，卓尔对材料的制造和应用有了更全面的认识，积累了相关的科研经验，为未来的学习研究打下坚实基础。她积极参加学院的科研项目实习，其中在先进复合材料组的实习经历令她记忆深刻。她特别感谢复材组刘晓玲老师和从小晔老师给予的悉心指导，让她慢慢积累了很多专业技能，提升了科研的基本素养，改变了她对科研的看法。她觉得，科研更像是具有多面性、需要把握平衡的挑战。虽然科研是个很严肃的过程，但卓尔认为科研也可以是感性的，热情和灵感对科研来讲都很重要。她非常享受这样通过不断学习和积累获得启发的过程。
Zhuoer Li is a senior student majoring in Mechanical Engineering from FoSE. She has been interested in materials science since early on, and her degree covers various courses such as materials science, material manufacturing, mechanical design, etc. Through her studies, Zhuoer has gained a more comprehensive understanding of the manufacture and application of materials, accumulated relevant scientific research experience, and laid a solid foundation for future study and research. Zhuoer actively participated in scientific research projects at UNNC, including her internship in the advanced composites research team. She particularly thanked Dr. Xiaoling Liu and Mr Xiaoye Cong from the advanced composites research team, who gave her many opportunities and meticulous guidance, allowing her to gradually accumulate a lot of professional skills and improve her basic understanding of scientific research. She said scientific research is more like a multi-faceted challenge that needs to be balanced. Although it is a very serious process, Zhuoer believes that scientific research can also be emotional. Enthusiasm and inspiration are both important throughout the procedure. Zhuoer enjoys the process of gaining inspiration through continuous learning and accumulation very much.
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


对于未来，卓尔还在不断的探索过程中。她希望自己在确定未来方向前可以多尝试、多了解，保持好奇心，去做更多有意义的事情。她在领雁计划的导师杨晓钢教授曾说，“作为科研人员，比起一直埋头做自己的课题，其实更需要抬头看看，意识到自己对社会和环境的责任，看看这个社会和环境需要什么，尽自己所能做出改善。”因此，比起当下的各种研究热点，未来她更想做与可持续发展、可持续能源相关的研究。
In terms of the future, Zhuoer is still in the process of exploring. She hopes that she can stay curious, and experience more meaningful moments. Professor Yang Xiaogang, her mentor in the High Flyer Scheme, once said, "As a scientific researcher, instead of burying your head in your own project, you actually need to look up, be aware of your responsibility to the environment and the society, try your best to make some positive changes to the world." As for Zhuoer’s next steps, she now intends to do research related to sustainable development and sustainable energy.
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


获奖感言 | Testimonials
卓尔说：“首先非常感谢李达三先生和叶耀珍女士的捐赠，也衷心感谢学校、理工学院和基金会为学生们提供的支持。这个奖项是我来到这宁诺的契机，让我得以在这个自由、开放、多元、充满活力的平台，享受丰富的学术资源，体验国际化教育，为今后学习打下了坚实的基础。这份殊荣也一直激励着我不断突破自我，追逐我所热爱的，坚持我所相信的。”
Zhuoer Li shared, “First of all, I am very grateful to Dr. Li Dak Sum and Mrs. Li Yip Yio Chin for their donations, and I also sincerely thank the university, the Faculty as well as the Foundation for their support to the students. This scholarship has given me the opportunity to come here, allowing me to enjoy rich academic resources and experience international education on this open, diverse and dynamic platform, which has laid a solid foundation for future study. This honour has always inspired me to constantly improve myself, pursue what I love, and stick to what I believe!”

滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version



李娌

国际商务经济学专业大四学生

Li Li

Final year student majoring in International Business 
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


李娌是宁诺国际商务经济学专业的一名大四学生。大学四年间，她过得充实又有意义，她成绩优异，实践经验丰富，揽获各类奖学金，如国家奖学金、省政府奖学金、校长奖学金等等。初入校园，李娌迅速适应了宁诺的全英文教学环境，在学习过程中不断积累商科的专业知识与技能，培养自己的多元化批判思维，提升自己的理论实践转化能力。大三时，李娌前往英国伯明翰大学交换。在这里，她收获了一段全新的学习体验，思维也得到了进一步的开拓。她提到，交换期间学习的管理学课程使她更深入地了解和理解可持续发展理念。结合以前在能源研究所的实践经历以及教授的建议，她坚定了自己未来在可持续发展和能源环境领域的研究方向。

在宁诺这个开放包容的平台上，李娌积极参与各类实践活动，培养自己的组织能力与领导能力。她鼓励自己多探索，多试错，在实践中丰富自己的阅历，让自己更自信。李娌在课余时间也尝试了不同领域的实习工作，每一次实习都是一份宝贵的体验，让她加深对自己的了解，明确未来的方向。她非常勤奋与自律，能够做好自我规划，朝着目标前行。
Li Li is at UNNC studying International Business Economics. Li has had a meaningful and fulfilling four years here in Ningbo. During university, with her excellent academic performance and abundant social practice experiences, Li has won various scholarships, such as National Scholarship, Zhejiang Provincial Scholarship, President's Scholarship, and more. When she first entered the campus, Li quickly adapted to the brand-new English teaching environment, accumulated professional knowledge and skills and worked on critical thinking. In her third year, Li went to the University of Birmingham on the exchange, where she was immersed in a new learning environment and accelerated her personal development. She mentioned the Management course has given her a deeper understanding of the concept of sustainable development. Combining her previous internship experience in the Energy Research Institute, she has set her sights on her future research direction being in the field of sustainable development and energy environment.

On the topic of the open and inclusive platform of UNNC, Li participated in various activities to cultivate her organisational and leadership abilities. She always encourages herself to explore more and dare to make mistakes, enrich her experience through applied practice, and work on her confidence. Li has also tried many internships in different fields during her spare time. Each internship was a valuable experience for her, allowing her to deepen her own understanding of herself and clarify her future direction. She is very diligent and self-disciplined, able to plan well and work towards her goals.
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


 获奖感言 | Testimonials
李娌分享道，“我十分荣幸可以连续四年获得李叶耀珍奖学金，这既是对我大学四年学业水平的肯定，也一直鼓励着我在不断探索中找到自己的动力和价值。它是我与宁诺的第一道缘分，也是大学生涯中值得纪念的里程碑。未来，我会在热爱的领域继续砥砺前行，带着宁诺、李达三先生与叶耀珍女士的鼓励与期望，为社会做出更多的贡献！”
Li said, “It is a great honour for me to receive the Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship for four consecutive years. This is not only an affirmation of my four-year study, but also an encouragement for me to find my own motivation and value in continuous exploration. It was my first connection with UNNC and a memorable milestone in my university life. In the future, I will continue to forge ahead in the field I love, and make more contributions to society with the encouragement and expectation of UNNC, Dr. Li Dak Sum and Mrs. Li Yip Yio Chin!”
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version




梁舒扬

国际事务关系专业大四学生

Shuyang Liang

Final year student majoring in International studies
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


梁舒扬来自宁诺人文社科学院国际事务关系专业，他学习能力强，有很好的自我规划能力。刚入学时，面对大量的英文文献材料他也有过踌躇，但他很快调整好自己的状态，一点点积累词汇量，慢慢提升阅读速度。在宁诺优异的学习氛围中，在老师的悉心指导下，他的专业水平提升迅速。大三时，舒扬前往荷兰的阿姆斯特丹大学交换，在阿姆斯特丹大学，他与来自世界各地的老师同学们交流。这段宝贵经历不仅开拓了舒扬学业上的视野，同时也丰富了他对自我、他人和社会的认知。在与德国朋友的沟通中，他也坚定了自己未来去德国研习世界文化历史的目标。此外，舒扬对宁波的人文历史非常感兴趣，并立志为保护宁波历史文化遗产做出自己的贡献：他曾前往宁波市天一阁担当志愿讲解员，近距离接触宁波古建筑，深入学习宁波的历史文化；他在校图书馆“数字人文宁波”项目组实习，工作的重点就是把宁波的历史和文化资源进行数字化和信息化。他将所学知识与实际相结合，对人文历史有了全新认识。
Shuyang Liang studies International studies in FHSS. He studies hard and plans his time effectively. During his first year, he momentarily hesitated when receiving a large number of English literature material. However, he quickly adjusted, and accumulated vocabulary and gradually improved his reading ability. Through being immersed in UNNC’s excellent learning atmosphere and the careful guidance of his teachers, his academic ability has rapidly improved. In his third year, Shuyang went to the University of Amsterdam in the Netherlands on exchange, where he shared and experienced new ideas and thoughts with teachers and classmates from all over the world, which not only broadened Shuyang's academic horizons but also enriched his understanding of himself, others and the wider world. Through communication with his German friends, Shuyang was able to determine his future direction of study: world culture and history in Germany. Shuyang is very interested in the humanities and history of Ningbo as well, and makes his own contribution to the protection of Ningbo's historical and cultural heritage. He once went to Ningbo Tianyi Pavilion to serve as a volunteer guide, got close to Ningbo's historical and cultural heritage, and learned in-depth about Ningbo's history and culture. He is currently doing an internship in the "Digital Humanities Ningbo" project team at UNNC Library. The focus of his work is to digitise Ningbo's historical and cultural resources. During the internship, he applied what he learned through practice, and gained a new understanding of social history.
滑动查看英文 Swipe to English version


 获奖感言 | Testimonials
梁舒扬说，“我衷心地感谢李达三先生和叶耀珍女士的慷慨解囊，能连续获得四次李叶耀珍奖学金是我的荣幸。我也非常感谢各位老师和同学，正是他们对我的指点、帮助和鼓励让我走到今天。刚入学时，我肩负着奖学金带给我的使命与责任，对我而言这是压力也是动力。四年间，我努力学习，不断锻炼和提升自己，全面发展。我非常热爱我的专业，在这里，我可以和有趣的老师同学共同谈论世界，探讨人生，探索各种可能。在宁诺的这段旅程是我最珍贵的经验、最宝藏的财富。”
Shuyang Liang shared, “I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to Dr. Li Dak Sum and Mrs. Li Yip Yio Chin for their generous support of us. It is my honour to be awarded the Li Yip Yio Chin Scholarship four times in a row. I would also like to thank all my teachers and classmates for their guidance, help and encouragement, which has brought me to where I am today. When I first joined the university, I shouldered the mission and responsibility brought to me by the scholarship. For me, it was both pressure and motivation. Over the past four years, I have studied hard, constantly exercised and improved myself, and developed in a well-rounded way. I really like my degree, where I can talk about the world, discuss life, and explore various possibilities with nice teachers and classmates. This journey at UNNC is my most precious experience, the most treasured wealth!”

集资集智  立德树人
宁波诺丁汉大学教育发展基金会是经浙江省教育厅与浙江省民政厅批准成立的非公募基金会和慈善组织。2019年12月，基金会被浙江省民政厅授予"5A级社会组织"，这是国家给予基金会的最高等级认证。基金会接受社会各界的捐赠，主要用于教育与科研、人才引进与对外交流、校园设施建设、奖助学金、学生活动、社会公益或与学校教育事业有关的其他项目。基金会愿作为捐赠者与宁波诺丁汉大学的桥梁与纽带，加强信息交流、管好捐赠项目，积极拓展和吸纳社会资源，全面支持和推动宁波诺丁汉大学的长远建设和发展，为我国的科教事业发展做出贡献。
Established in September 2012, the Education Foundation of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China is a private fundraising foundation approved by the Zhejiang Education Bureau and the Zhejiang Civil Affairs Bureau. In December 2019, the Foundation was awarded "5A Social Organisation" by the government, the highest level of its kind. The mission of the Foundation is to gain widespread support from society to promote educational development and public welfare, to promote the long-term development of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China and to accelerate the process of building the University into a high-level Sino-foreign university with distinctive international characteristics.
