title: 50张图片，收藏宁诺绝色秋景 Autumnal Scenes in UNNC
content:
天高云淡
风清气爽
与你携手
走进宁诺的秋
The high sky; the pale clouds 
The light breeze; the clear air 
Together with you
Strolling into UNNC's autumnal world
教学楼间光影斑驳
秋日暖阳透过落地窗
均匀地铺洒在每一个角落
Light and shadow unfold 
amid the teaching spaces
The sun breaches the tall glass frames
Dispersing into every corner
阳光透过树枝
洒在诺丁河上
留下粼粼波光
Sunlight peers through the forest branches
Scattering on Nottingham River
Leaving in its wake glittering waves 
与谁同坐
明月清风与我
各处小景
丰富了校园
温柔了时光
Who shall be with me?
When the bright moon shines 
and the fresh breeze blows
The myriad of scenes 
Enriching our campus
These gentle times
刚结束课堂的同学们
正活跃于大自然间
阳光、草坪、运动、阅读
不负秋日好时光
Students, finish class, make full use of nature
Sunshine, green fields, sports, reading
Amid autumn, spend your time well 
看，一袭白影跃然于眼前
一双翅膀翩然于花丛中
一声“嘎嘎”，一句“喵”
这些校园里的常客
骄傲地展示着它们的永居权
Once a frequent visitor,
Now a permanent resident at UNNC. 
Hey, welcome! 
妖娆了四季的秋天
深邃、静美
如那醉人的红枫
和那缕缕桂花香
Autumn is deep and still
Like the intoxicating maple 
and the sweet-scented osmanthus
华灯初上
星光点点
钟楼敲响了
我的宁诺
我要把你的秋收藏！
Lamp lights flicker
Starlight dots the sky
The bells ring
The amazing autumn collection of UNNC!

title: 校友故事 | 刘奕杨：运气还是实力？博士一年级就提交和发表20篇学术论文的加速人生
content:
还记得那位大学毕业即拥有2年工作经验和30个世界名企Offer的化工男孩刘奕杨吗？
最近浙江日报又报道了这位“爱折腾，不安分”的刘同学，文章中介绍了他的创业团队和他的创业项目。在采访中，奕杨还提到了自己的母校宁波诺丁汉大学是自己人生道路上非常重要的一个环节。

本科毕业才两年，他竟然已经发表/投稿论文20篇，包括第一作者/通讯作者论文11篇。这科研论文产出可谓神速！人生效率超高的奕杨同学不仅提前超额完成了博士阶段的任务，他还和宁诺各个专业的校友们一起创建了一个科技公司。博士期间，奕杨带领他的团队参加了11个国家级和省级的全球赛事，全都取得了名次和奖项，同时他还申请到了省市级双创人才项目补助支持。
宁诺2019届化工专业毕业生刘奕杨同学毕业后的两年仿佛上了加速器，在科研和创业的道路上一路狂奔、一骑绝尘。


高超的学术水平

奕杨从UCL（伦敦大学学院，世界QS排名第8）取得化学过程与工艺硕士学位之后，就无缝衔接地在UCL化学工程专业继续攻读博士。只是博士一年级在读的他，就已经有了如此丰富的学术成果了。（每个学校考核博士毕业的标准不太一样，据小编所知：一般情况下，博士3到4年期间，能在国际学术期刊上发表3篇论文，是一个比较正常的水平。）
奕杨的研究方向是水系锌基电化学储能器件，其低成本、高功率、高安全性等特征特别适合在固定式储能中应用。他的科研成果已经发表在各大国际学术期刊上，其中题为“Rechargeable Aqueous Zn-based Electrochemical Energy Storage Devices ”文章被发表在IF=41.248（影响因子）的Joule期刊上，还被选为当期封面。另一篇文章“Cathode Design for Aqueous Rechargeable Multivalent Ion Batteries: Challenges and Opportunities” 发表在Advanced Functional Material (IF=18.808)期刊，也被选为首页图片，还是一篇高被引文章。


宁诺的培养与关怀
刘奕杨并不是天生爱学术，他曾经也是班级里的“后进生”。谈起UNNC对他的影响和改变，刘奕杨总是感慨万千！尤其是老师们的耐心引导和支持，给了他非常大的鼓励和动力！
他提到UNNC既给了他充分的自由度去创造无限的可能性，也帮助他作出了人生的重大抉择。在进入UNNC的第一年，他因为学校（在当时）没有化学系而感到失望，放弃了自己对化学的梦想，把主要精力都放在行业实习中。在UNNC的前三年中，他在外实习26个月，曾在网易、吉利等7家领域内顶尖企业工作，岗位主要为人力资源、市场营销、产品策划与运营等等。这三年虽然让他积累了多于同龄人的工作经验并让他对未来有了初步的规划。然而，他知道他的性格其实并不适合在职场长期发展，创业也缺少必要的核心技术。因此，他对未来仍然是迷茫的。
不过，由于缺课情况，他被要求参加系里面的学术听证会。但是，系主任Philip Hall博士在会上并没有要求他必须返校念书，而是鼓励他去发现人生更多的可能性：1）如果真的不想上课，只想上班，可以选择退学/休学，以发现未来的人生究竟在哪里；2）也可以选择重返校园，但是他的大三下半年成绩将被视为0分。
因此，奕杨开始考量自己的发展道路。为了和更多业内资深人力资源交流，以确定他未来的路线，他参加了学校2018年的秋季校招。他如愿以偿的和很多企业的高层管理人员进行了面对面的交流，并有幸获得了30家名企的青睐。但是他发现最终适合自己的路可能是重返校园，他重拾对化学的梦想，他想埋头学习一门技术，并希望努力创立一家属于自己的高科技企业。
大四他开始认真学习，为了赶上落下的课程进度，他需要花费比其他同学更多的精力和努力。
“在这一年中，我并没有受到来自师长和同学的歧视，相反我收获了来自他们大量的帮助。例如，理工学院院长吴韬教授的《反应器设计》课程中有大量的公式，对于一般的同学来说也已经很复杂，对于翘课三年的我来说更是挑战巨大。吴院长在课后时间，将我们全班分为多个6人小组，亲自在办公室中为我们一一安排小组补课。”
“又比如在大四一年中，Philip Hall博士一直以“霸道总裁”的方式鼓励着我。据说他现在每年还会给学生说我的故事，以激励后进学生好好学习。”
一个学期后，他获得了专业第一，实现了从均分24到均分86.4的飞跃进步。这段时间的学习也让他对化工产生了更深厚的兴趣，也积累了学科基本的知识背景和学术技能，使得他在UCL的硕士学习阶段也能以84.5的均分获得年级第一。
从宁诺毕业之后，奕杨和宁诺的科研之缘却从未断开，在博士一年级期间就能够成功发表9篇论文的情况并不多见，奕杨向我们公开了自己神速发表论文的秘诀。
“其实我在本科阶段未做过任何科研，然而我在提出来想读博士的想法时，宁诺的老师非但没有质疑我的能力，还给了我非常大的鼓励与支持。”
奕杨说他的科研启蒙是在宁诺毕业时，他去拜访了三位在宁诺期间最了解他的老师，三位老师都在百忙之中抽空从不同角度给他以大量的启发。
吴韬院长从科学家的角度，为他揭示了科研对于产业、社会的重要意义，并一直鼓励他走上读博这一条路。吴韬教授告诉他高校是要走在产业前面的，要开发原创的颠覆性技术去推动社会与产业的变革。
拥有丰富行业工作经验的Philip Hall博士则从一个工程师的角度，告诉他产研结合的重要性和基础的方法论。Philip Hall博士也告诫他不能只关注科学理论，也要关注工程和技术，要建立目的导向的科研思维去挖掘产业的进展和真正的述求。
奕杨也尤其感谢孙勇老师给了他一线的科研指导，手把手教他如何进行学术论文撰写、评审意见回复、论文审稿、项目申请等等。他科研生涯中的大部分第一次都是在孙老师指导下完成的，如第一篇共同/第一/通讯作者论文、第一篇学术会议论文、第一次论文审稿等等。“这些指导并不是我在UNNC期间获得的，而是我在UCL念硕士期间在孙老师远程指导下完成的。孙老师严谨的治学风格也为我日后的科研打下了坚实的基础。”
“
在UNNC的学习还让我领悟到学术研究很多时候靠的不是“经验”，因为“经验”只是一种“术”，这个可以靠时间积累就可以获得。但是做出真正具有突破性的工作需要的是“道”，即研究者本人的性格、思维模式等等。我自己是一个思维非常跳跃的人，经常会有些“天马行空”的想法，对真正具有创新性的工作有着发自心底的崇拜与向往，也愿意为之踏踏实实、刨根究底地去干。因此，我个人认为可能我这一部分的性格对科研可能是有益的。”

宁诺，一个开放，包容，平等的环境，不仅会鼓励每一位同学个性化的发展，给同学们提供全方位的支持和服务，师长、同学更是会建立起终生共同学习、进步的友谊，这种情谊的连结并不会受时间和空间的阻挡，而是会一直延续在宁诺每一位学子的整个学术生涯乃至人生的每一个阶段。



丰富的创业经验
英式教学提倡团队合作，团队合作精神流淌于每一位宁诺人的血液中。奕杨从未忘记自己的初心，成立一家科技创业公司助力制造业和能源产业的转型，他和自己的伙伴们组建了创业团队。团队成员共有15人，其中8人是宁诺各个专业的毕业生。“我很享受和宁诺老伙计一起打天下的感觉。”奕杨自豪的说。
他们的团队还参加了十一个国际赛事，取得了不错的成绩，并且他们的创业公司已经申请到了国内的人才计划和项目资助。
目前奕杨的团队已经拿到了浙江省绍兴市的英才计划，除了项目资助与人才津贴，绍兴还给其390平方米的场地以用于小中试厂房的搭建。他们还通过HICOOL创赛拿到了北京市的项目资助，目前还也在申报深圳市、江苏省苏州市等地的一些人才项目。
奕杨同学也是非常有家国情怀的一位科技企业创始人，谈起自己的创业初心，他并不是为了获得物质或者名誉上的满足。


自身体会与感悟

“
我们认为，要在正确的时间做正确且合适的事。碳中和、能源/制造业转型对于国家乃至世界未来的发展至关重要，而新一代电化学储能器件的研发也已经迫在眉睫。我们的技术是国家产业转型亟需的，是我们这一代年轻人应该去探索和为国家和社会去承担和贡献的。中国从来不缺生意人和科学家，但缺少新生代企业家。而一家科技企业的创始人应当同时兼具生意人和科学家的特质。宁诺开放性的成长环境允许我们不断地试错，让我们在获得知识的同时兼具了全球化视野；也教会了我们，既不能做一个只会埋头学习书呆子，也不能做一个华而不实的投机者。我们团队很年轻，全团队平均年龄26岁，我们在充满朝气的年华怀揣对改变世界的期许和热情。值得一提的是，我们目前正在做的项目，是当年爱迪生花了十多年都无法解决的挑战。”
拥有如此精彩人生的奕杨是真正的时间管理大师，可是他却从来不认为自己的能力有多强、智商有多高，他总谦虚的说自己是运气非常非常好。他认为博士的成就更应该用质量来衡量，而不是数量。
 
“相比于其它博士，我的运气真的是太太太好啦。科研是相对顺利的，我认为运气绝对大于能力，每个阶段都能遇到贵人。当然选择也很重要！我必须要感谢宁诺给予我人生重大的转变！感谢一路同行的校友们，感谢宁诺的老师们，感谢宁诺这所开放和包容的学校挖掘了我的潜力，让我找到了适合自己的道路。

title: 学子故事 | 施嘉怡：去尝试吧，让自己获得更多的选择
content:
施嘉怡
01
  选择数学，因为它会给我带来更多选择
02
  选择尼泊尔支教，领悟不同命运与人生


03
  选择做各种尝试，不忘寻找身心的平衡
学习之余，生活中的施嘉怡喜欢看书，健身。她经常参加学校组织的徒步登山等活动。“亲近大自然，可以让我放松下来，让我从浮躁、焦虑回归平静，最终使我提升效率，进而更好的学习。”学习之余，生活中的施嘉怡喜欢看书，健身。她经常参加学校组织的徒步登山等活动。“亲近大自然，可以让我放松下来，让我从浮躁、焦虑回归平静，最终使我提升效率，进而更好的学习。”



Jiayi Shi: Go ahead and give it a try
Jiayi Shi has been one of the top students in Mathematics with Applied Mathematics since her first year in the UNNC. She is also the recipient of both the Dean's Scholarship and the Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship. This year, she received the National Scholarship for her excellent performance in both curricular and extra-curricular activities.

In addition to studying, her after-school life is also busy and fulfilling. She once held a 100-person speech conference. She actively participated in college students' entrepreneurship competitions and the Mathematical Contest in Modeling. She has devoted herself to scientific research projects during holidays. She also worked as an intern in Ping An Insurance and built automatic forms for the company. In addition, she has also participated in many volunteer services, such as voluntary teacher in the rural area, Chinese enterprise annual conference volunteer, etc. "UNNC is a place of freedom," said Jiayi Shi. "It contains lots of possibilities to try various things.”

Jiayi choose Mathematics with Applied Mathematics because it is a popular major with a wide range of employment choices and compatibility for most industries." Jiayi Shi told us that back to the time when she just finished the Gaokao exam, she faced a big choice in her life. She was not interested in finance and was not clear if she likes computer science. Therefore, choosing mathematics, a basic science would give her more possibilities and opportunities in the future.

As a top student in her major, Jiayi Shi has her way to study efficiently. She would like to take this opportunity to recommend three key points in her learning methods to her fellow students. Firstly, Jiayi is very focused and tries to understand as much knowledge as she can in the class. Secondly, she will make full use of the academic staff’s office hours. When she still have some questions about the knowledge, she would have no doubt turn to the teaching staff, and usually, she could have something more. "After the class when I come to them for help, teachers sometimes add some other knowledge to help us build the knowledge system and have a better understanding of what we learned. Moreover, through the casual talk, my teachers can have a further understanding of me, so that they are more likely to write recommendation letters for me in the future." Finally, she said that there are many learning resources on the internet. She believes that the most important skill she has obtained in the University is the self-learning skill.

UNNC is a global campus where lives students and staff from different countries and cultures. Our students also have opportunities to study and work overseas, experiencing different cultures on-site and broadening their horizons. Jiayi said that her voluntary teaching experience in Nepal is her most impressive memory. She knew very little about this country and its customs before. When she came to Nepal, she found out that local girls do not share the same learning right as the boy. She decided to bring them as much knowledge as she can during her voluntary teaching period and try her best to help those girls.

After the class, Jiayi likes to do some reading and workouts and take a hike on the weekend. She loves nature and she said that she could truly relax and relief in nature. She finds her pace of learning and living. She would also like to suggest other students be bold and give it a try. Remember to seize every opportunity in front of you and it will lead you to success.

content:
对于我们生活的环境，你可曾有过一个彻底的观察？面临极端天气和污染，你曾想过自己可以做些什么？也许你听说过3D打印，但是你真正了解它是如何实现的吗？在本月28日下午的宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院的科普讲座上，你对于化学工程、增材制造和环境科学的所有问题都能得到解答。

11月28日公开课课程安排
#1
14:00-14:40

#2

15:40-16:20

主题：增材制造入门
无论你身处何地，欢迎扫码在线上收看直播科普讲座

扫码进入直播间


本期主讲人






Svenja Hanson 博士
主题：化学工程对于可持续的贡献

英国利兹大学硕士、拉夫堡大学博士
曾在英国诺丁汉大学和诺丁汉马来西亚校区任教
曾任马来西亚校区化学与环境工程系系主任
研究领域包括化石燃料的使用、大气和水污染治理，废弃物管理，环境评测与管理


与化学家相比，化学工程师在塑造社会和影响人们生活方面，起着决定性的作用，因此他们肩负使命和责任也使他们义不容辞。对于化学工程师和环境工程师来说，他们因为掌握生产工艺，了解材料分离的技术，在创建循环经济、助力社会可持续发展中扮演重要的角色。如果你也热爱科学技术，想要为人类的未来生活做出一份贡献，那么化学工程和环境工程专业将是你的不二选择。








Adam Rushworth 博士
主题：增材制造入门

机械工程助理教授，英国高等教育学会会士
英国诺丁汉大学硕士及博士
罗尔斯∙罗伊斯-诺丁汉大学技术中心研究员


在本堂课上，Adam Rushworth博士将介绍增材制造和3D打印的概念，这项技术的广泛应用，以及增材制造中所使用的一些关键技术。








唐郁婷 博士
主题：克服“在环境科学研究中应用实验设计”挑战的方法

环境科学助理教授
美国杜克大学硕士，英国诺丁汉大学博士
曾在英国诺丁汉大学地理系做博士后研究
受到欧盟第七号框架研究资助
研究领域包括环境变迁、土地利用政策


环境科学涵盖了对于人类社会可持续性至关重要的多种学科，例如，污染物对公共健康的影响以及对于极端气候的适应。许多灾难性事件的发生之前，人类可以观察到一些信号，但是人类的预测没办法达到百分百的准确，也没办法采取及时的预防和消除的措施。
在本堂课上，我将解释环境科学研究中应用实验设计的一些挑战，以及相关的应对方法。原则上，我们需要运用逻辑思维来检测观察现象后所产生的直观判断；在规划风险控制时，需要意识到研究结果的不确定性。通过这个方法，可以得到启发，规划一个更具适应性的未来，以实现一个更加宜居、可持续的人类社会。

title: 宁波诺丁汉大学十位学者入选全球前2%顶尖科学家名单
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - 10 UNNC academics among top 2% of scientists in the world.
近日，美国斯坦福大学发布了“全球前2%顶尖科学家名单”。值得骄傲的是，共有十位来自宁波诺丁汉大学的学者在列，创学校历史最好成绩。
他们分别是周荫强（Patrick Chau）教授、张毓隆（Alain Yee Loong Chong）教授、Antony Paulraj教授、陈庆佳（Hing Kai Chan）教授、朱光教授、Nabil Gindy教授（已故）、James C.Greer教授、益小苏教授、Giampaolo Buticchi教授和Michael Galea教授。

周荫强
（Patrick Chau）

（Hing Kai Chan）
朱光

（已故）

该榜单由斯坦福大学的John P.A.Ioannidis教授及其团队发布。榜单基于全球知名数据库爱思唯尔同行评议学术论文索引摘要数据库，依照以下六项标准进行综合评估打分：总引用量；H指数；共同作者修正的Schreiber Hm-index；单独作者；单独或者第一作者；单独、第一或最后作者的文章引用量。最终，根据其 “生涯影响力” 和 “年度影响力” ，从全球近700 万名科学家中遴选出世界排名前2%的科学家。
我校入选学者的学术成果涵盖了多个领域，包括信息系统、工业工程、工商管理、纳米技术、应用物理学、材料学、电子工程和运筹学。
十位在列学者之中，周荫强教授与张毓隆教授在他们的研究领域“信息系统”的排名里名列前茅。在入选的全球17971名科学家中，两人均进入了全球前100名。而在中国范围内，周荫强教授在该领域中的排名全国第一，张毓隆教授位列全国第三。
此外，在工商管理领域，Antony Paulraj教授排名位列全国第五；在工业工程领域，陈庆佳教授位列全国第十一位。
该榜单反映出宁波诺丁汉大学教师团队的学术成果高质多产，总体学术与科研实力位居全国前列。未来，学校将继续凭借独特的优势，整合海内外优质科研资源，结合地方发展需求，积极开展世界领先的各项研究，以解决当今世界面临的诸多全球性挑战。


10 UNNC academics among top 2% of scientists in the world

The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) is proud to acknowledge the recent achievements of 10 UNNC academics who were ranked among the top 2% of scientists in the world by a Stanford-Elsevier report published last month. 
The ranking was prepared by Stanford University and Elsevier BV, a world-leading academic publisher of scientific and technical journals. The list was devised in the Stanford-Elsevier report by analysing peer-reviewed academic papers database of over 100,000 top scientists selected from nearly 7 million scientists around the world. 
The scientists were classified into 22 scientific fields and 176 sub-fields and were then ranked based upon the following criteria: citations, h-index, co-authorship adjusted hm-index, citations to papers in different authorship positions and a composite indicator, including career-long and single year impact. 
UNNC extends our congratulations to all of our staff who were listed in the rankings, including   Patrick Chau, Alain Yee Loong Chong, Antony Paulraj, Hing Kai Chan, Guang Zhu, Nabil Gindy  (deceased), James C. Greer, Xiaosu Yi, Giampaolo Buticchi and Michael Galea. 
They were able to break into the rankings of a number of research fields , such as information systems, industrial engineering, business and management, nanotechnology, applied physics, materials, electric engineering, and operations research. 
Out of the 10 UNNC academics listed in the rankings, Professor Patrick Chau, Vice Provost for Research and Knowledge Exchange, and Professor Alain Yee Loong Chong, Dean of Graduate School and Global Engagement, are both ranked worldwide in the top 100 in the information systems discipline. Within China, they are ranked in 1st place and 3rd place respectively. In the field of Business and Management, Professor Antony Paulraj ranked 5th in China. In the field of industrial engineering, Professor Hing Kai Chan ranked 11th in China. 
These global rankings demonstrate the high academic standards of our staff as well as the university’s influence across multiple disciplines and signify our dedication to producing world-class research. In the future, UNNC will continue to integrate its advantageous research resources at home and abroad and support our talented academics in pushing the boundaries of knowledge and deliver world-leading research to solve today’s global challenges.

title: 今日获批！唯一一家省级航空电气化领域工程研究中心花落宁波诺丁汉大学
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC approved to construct the Engineering Research Centre at provincial level in aviation electrification.
今天，2021年省级工程研究中心名单公布。由宁波诺丁汉大学申报的航空电气化技术浙江省工程研究中心（下文简称“中心”）榜上有名，系唯一一家航空电气化领域获批的研究中心，这是学校科研创新发展以及科研成果工程化推进的又一个重要里程碑。

航空
电气化技术浙江省工程研究中心由宁波诺丁汉大学牵头，宁波韵升电机技术有限公司和诺丁汉（余姚）智能电气化研究院共建。未来该中心致力于打造成世界一流的系统化的航空产业配备的电气化技术工程研究中心，兼具前瞻技术研究、关键技术研发、技术转移和人才培养培训等功能的融合创新平台。

宁波诺丁汉大学于2017年成立航空学院，开展航空领域方面研究，其中在电气化领域拥有一支国际化的高水平研究团队——电力电子、电机与控制团队。该团队以航空电气化为特色,在负责人张何教授的带领下，通过研究积累和技术创新，已取得许多原创性和突破性的科研成果。


据张何介绍，航空电气化领域的研究核心是高可靠性、高功率密度和高效的电驱系统。团队在可靠性条件约束下进一步突破了航空先进电机系统超高功率密度关键设计技术，相关成果应用于中国商飞国产大飞机的起发一体化电机驱动系统；成功为中航工业研制了紧凑型电动静液作动器的伺服系统，在国内首次实现民用飞机舵面控制的高速电液作动器；2021年更获得科技部支持开展多电飞机前沿技术“绿色电滑行”相关研究。

团队同时开展的无人机电驱动系统采用了全球首创高压超高速无感矢量控制无人机动力系统。该项技术成功在本土孵化，产品远销以色列。此外，在重载荷无人机电驱动技术上，团队自主研发的容错控制安全冗余技术，服务于300kg以上量级的多类重载无人机，有效地推进了国产无人机技术和装备水平，经济与社会效益显著。

航空电气化技术浙江省工程研究中心主任由宁波诺丁汉大学教授张何担任。据他介绍，由于世界航空运输业快速发展对环境造成的巨大压力，航空电气化成为全球航空产业发展的重要趋势。下一步中心的主要任务是要力争突破面向工程化的航空电气化关键设计技术、建设航空电气化高端设计工程化以及构建航空电气化关键组部件测试方法体系。

“
从中长期来看，我们希望研发混合动力和全电推进电机等未来全电飞机核心零部件；同时，我们将以工程研究中心为平台，结合浙江省及其周边地区航空制造业对航空电气化技术的前瞻性需求，建设一支世界一流水平的团队，为我国航空产业发展提供技术和人才双引擎。”

据悉，航空电气化技术浙江省工程研究中心建设周期为2021年至2024年。建设完成后，预期中心将提升带动浙江省航空电驱动系统相关企业的技术水平与产品竞争力，从而为浙江省航空产业的创新发展提供重要技术支撑和智力支持，并产生显著的经济社会效益。 

UNNC approved to construct the Engineering Research Centre at provincial level in aviation electrification

12 November: University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) is approved by Zhejiang Science and Technology Bureau to establish Zhejiang Aviation Electrification Technology Engineering Research Centre. It is the only provincial engineering research centre approved in the field of aviation electrification, marking a milestone of University’s research innovation development and the industrialisation of research outcomes.  
The Zhejiang Aviation Electrification Technology Engineering Research Centre (Hereinafter referred to as the Centre) is co-established by Ningbo Yunsheng Motor Technology Co., Ltd and Nottingham Electrification Centre. In the future, the Centre is committed to building a world-class systematic electrification technology engineering research centre, integrating functions including key technology development, knowledge transfers and talent cultivation. 
Led by Professor He Zhang, Director of the Nottingham Electrification Centre and Professor in Electrical Drives at UNNC, the goal of the Centre is to conduct key research on core components of aviation electrification and promote advanced machine drive technology for future transport electrification. 
"Regarding the Centre as a starting platform, we hope to construct a world-class team to make substantial contributions to aviation industry in terms of technology advancement and talent cultivation, combining the forward-looking demands to the aero manufacturing industry in and around Zhejiang Province," said Professor Zhang. 
The Centre is hosted by the School of Aerospace Engineering at UNNC. Founded in 2017, the School conducts research in the field of aviation technology. The School hosts an excellent, international, research team in the field of Electrification, Power Electronics, Machines and Control Research Group. 
According to Professor Zhang, the core research in the field of aviation electrification is the electric drive system with high reliability, high power density and high efficiency. The team has achieved breakthrough in the key technology in developing aviation advanced motor system with ultra-high power density, which is applied to the Starter/Generator system for domestic commercial aircrafts of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China. In May 2021, a frontier Major-Project on “green taxiing” was approved by the Ministry of Science and Technology of China. 
The team has successfully developed high-speed, sensor-less FOC technology for drone propulsion system, and made its first sales of the product to a drone manufacturer in Israel. In the area of heavy-lift drone motor technologies, the fault-tolerant control technology developed independently by the team has been applied to multiclass 300 kg heavy-lift drones, pushing the technology frontier for domestic drones with remarkable economic and social benefits. 
The construction period of the Centre will be finished in 2024. By then the Centre will improve the technology level and the product competitiveness of enterprises in the aero electrical drive industry in Zhejiang, providing crucial technical and intellectual support for the innovation and development of the aviation industry in the Province and generating significant economic and social welfare.

title: 校友故事 | 周明瑞：不断试错之后，他选择了金融之路
content:
Scroll up for English Version

Zhou Mingrui is a graduate of the School of Economics in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences. In 2019, after graduating from UNNC, he successfully entered the Imperial College London and studied the programme of Economics and Strategy for Business. After graduating from the Imperial College London, he first worked in the IT industry, and then shifted to the financial investment industry. In the process of financial analysis and research publication, Zhou Mingrui has achieved extraordinary success within this industry.

High School: Hubei Experimental High School
Postgraduate University: Imperial College London, Economics and Strategy for Business

[From IT to Finance: change under thinking]
After the college entrance examination, Zhou Mingrui, who plans to study abroad in future, chose to study the programme of International Economics and Trade (IET) at UNNC. “I think UNNC is a great platform where I can better develop my academic skills and is more conducive to my future development.” In UNNC, Zhou Mingrui considers himself as an “academic” person. He devoted much time to his studies in 4 years, which also provided him with a more solid foundation for his future applications and work.

After completing his postgraduate studies, Zhou Mingrui initially planned to work in the Internet industry based on his internship experience at Internet companies. However, after a period of experimentation and reflection, Zhou Mingrui found that he was not that suitable for Internet companies. “On the one hand, compared with finance industry, the Internet industry is more uncertain in the later stages of the career. On the other, during the internship, I found that the Internet industry demands higher requirements for people’s soft power and comprehensive capabilities.” Therefore, after a thorough thinking for a period of time, Zhou Mingrui chose the finance industry which is more suitable for him. “I think reflection after a period of experience is essential. In the process of self-reflection, we would find out what we really intend and make adjustments in time.”


[Experience the joy of financial analysis]
As a fixed-income investment manager, Zhou Mingrui's daily work includes doing due diligence and financial analysis of the issuer, bond undertaking, and outputting some analysis of the macro market as well as the future forecasts.

Amongst all these works, what attracted Zhou Mingrui most is the working atmosphere of the brokerage. “I think the brokerage firm is a place where I can really focus on research. In addition, I was originally interested in stock market and funds. This is why I chose to continue the fixed-income investment.” Additionally, the process of doing research has also offered Zhou Mingrui a great sense of achievement. Through theoretical collation and data analysis, the publication of his research findings in weekly newspapers and public magazines is a great achievement for him. This job also allows him to organise his previously scattered knowledge of economics and to gather them together after adding his own thoughts. All these experiences have given him a unique experience.

However, apart from the sense of achievement, this job still has many difficulties. “Fixed-income investment is a brand-new section for me, so I need to spend some time thinking and learning.” Zhou Mingrui believes that when approaching something new, it is important to find out where you need to start, and it is also essential to combine knowledge in books and discuss with seniors.


[Constructing a solid foundation at UNNC and from internships]
In Zhou Mingrui’s views, the future development trend of the financial industry is relatively clear. Specific to the fixed-income investment, Zhou Mingrui believes that this industry is more closely related to the national economy and policies. It also requires more innovation, and generally shows a better trend for the future. However, this considerable prospect also makes the financial industry highly competitive, with labour supply far greater than demand.

Despite the fierce competition, Zhou Mingrui thinks that graduates of the School of Economics in UNNC have some advantages especially in the basic knowledge of the finance industry. “UNNC’s courses related to Monetary and Macro can provide us with a comprehensive understanding of economic indicators as well as economic policies, which are really vital for investment.” Zhou Mingrui also advises us to focus on courses which are closely linked to the investment industry, moreover to think more, to ask more questions and to read more relevant books.

Meanwhile, Zhou Mingrui believes that the accumulation of experience in the investment industry during the study period is equally important for future development. If you can find some internship opportunities in brokerage firms, it will definitely help you in the autumn recruiting process. Our university also offers workshops to share experiences, so you can pay more attention to these workshops and get more opportunities.

For students who intend to enter the financial industry, Zhou Mingrui recommends reading some financial-related magazines and official account essays, like Financial Times, Zeping Macro and Qilin Macro. These magazines and public websites can help to provide a reflection on everyday economic phenomena and behaviours, and provide some valuable frameworks for industry analysis outside of book knowledge, thus deepening your understanding and offering a unique perspective on original economics knowledge.


[To current students]
When talking about suggestions for UNNC stuents, Zhou Mingrui's first thought is to apply theory to practice. “You can try to use the theory learned in lectures to understand economic phenomena in the real life, or use conclusions in predictions of the market.” In addition, Mingrui Zhou believes that students need to define their goals in time. “Whether it is for work or postgraduate studies, you must think clearly about what you want and plan what you need to do at each stage.” It is advised to prepare in advance after you have an aim. “Any attempt has a cost. The earlier you try, the lower cost you pay, and the sooner you can find a job that suits you.”



 周明瑞 ，宁波诺丁汉大学人文社科学院国际经济与贸易专业2019年毕业生。在毕业后成功进入帝国理工学院后的他，从互联网行业转变至金融投资，并朝着这个方向走出了一条独具特色的道路。财务分析、发布研究成果，周明瑞在不断思考下逐渐走出属于自己的金融之路。

高中学校：湖北省实验中学
研究生院校：帝国理工学院，Msc Economics and Strategy for Business 
互联网到金融：      
思考下的转变

高考结束以后，本身有着留学打算的周明瑞选择了来宁波诺丁汉大学的国际经济与贸易专业(IET)读书。“我觉得宁诺是一个很好的平台，在这个平台上我能够更好地培养自己的能力，更有利于自己日后更好的发展。” 在UNNC就读期间，周明瑞坦言自己比较“学术”：“我觉得平时我会将更多的时间投入在学习中，这也为我日后的申研和工作打下了更扎实的基础。”

在毕业后顺利进入帝国理工学院深造后，基于在互联网公司的实习经历，周明瑞一开始打算去互联网行业工作。然而在经历过一段时间的尝试后，周明瑞发觉自己并不适合互联网公司：“一方面，相对于金融行业，互联网行业在职业生涯后期不确定性更强；另一方面，在实习过程中，我发现互联网对工作者的’软实力’和’综合能力’要求更高。”因此，在一段时间的反思后，周明瑞选择了更加适合自己的金融行业。“我认为大家在一段经历之后需要经常进行反思，在反思的过程中找到自己真正想要的东西，并在日后及时作出调整和朝着新的方向努力。”
在英国诺丁汉大学交换时的剑桥之旅

在分析中体会
金融的乐趣

作为华创证券固定收益部的投资经理，周明瑞的日常工作包括做发行人尽调与财务分析、债券承做，并输出一些对于宏观市场现状梳理与未来预测。在这些工作中，最吸引周明瑞的是券商的工作氛围。“我认为券商是一个可以真正踏实下来去做事情和做研究的地方。加之我本身对股市基金比较感兴趣，所以选择了固定收益投资这个方向进行发展。”

除此之外，研究的过程也带给了周明瑞极大的成就感。经过理论整理与数据分析，将自己的研究成果发表在周报和公众号上，这对周明瑞来说是一件非常有成就感的事情。利用自身的工作机会，周明瑞可以将头脑中零散的经济学知识点进行整理、思考，以文字的形式更好地呈现出来。这也给他带来了独特的体验。

不过，除了成就感以外，在工作期间周明瑞依旧要常常面临许多挑战。“固定收益对我来说是一个全新的版块，因此要花一定的时间去思考学习。”周明瑞认为在接触新事物的时候应该弄清楚自己需要从哪几个方面去入手和思考，并结合经典的教学书籍和与前辈的交流，在探讨中去化解这些挑战。
在UNNC和实习中      
打下坚实的基础

在周明瑞看来，金融业的未来发展趋势比较明朗。具体到自己从事的固收，周明瑞认为这个产业跟国家宏观经济以及相关政策的联系会更加紧密，也更需要创新，不过总体来说，未来趋势是明朗的。而这种可观的前景也使金融行业高度“内卷”，使得人才供给远远大于需求。

尽管竞争激烈，周明瑞觉得经济系的毕业生在对于金融行业基础知识方面，还是比较有优势的。“UNNC的货币经济学和宏观经济学的相关课程，能让我们对经济指标与经济政策有一个全面的认识。这些课程的知识对于投资行业的发展都是非常重要的。我建议大家平时在学习过程中多注重与投资行业联系紧密的课程，在此基础上多去思考总结，多去问问题，多去看一些相关书籍。”
在FHSS毕业典礼上与DT Supervisor Dr. Chaoyan Wang的合影

同时，周明瑞认为在学习阶段对投资行业的经验积累对未来的发展也同样重要。如果能够在上大学的期间找到一些券商的实习机会，对企业秋招、甚至之后从事全职帮助很大。学校也会提供相关的workshop，大家也可以多多关注，在这些分享会中去汲取经验、获得更多的机会。

对于想进入金融行业的同学，周明瑞推荐大家去看一些金融相关的杂志和公众号文章，例如学校图书馆的Financial Times杂志，“泽平宏观”和“奇霖宏观”等公众号。这些杂志和公众号有助于建立对日常经济现象与经济行为的思考，或者说，在书本知识外提供一些有价值的行业分析框架，从而加深对原有经济学知识的理解。
在滴滴实习期间收到的温暖小礼物
给学弟学妹们的话

说到对于学弟学妹的建议，周明瑞首先想到的就是将理论运用于实际。“可以试着将课堂教授的理论与现实生活中的经济现象对应，或者将结论性的东西用于对市场的预测中。”此外，周明瑞认为同学们需要反复思考确定自己的目标。“无论是工作还是读研，都要想清楚自己想要什么，并规划自己每个阶段需要做的事。”在此基础上，再提早准备，或者说提前尝试。“试错是有成本的，越早尝试，试错的成本就越低，也能越早找到适合自己的工作，并先人一步开始积累准备。”

title: 校友故事｜许秋盈：直指广告界最年轻一代的经理人
content:
Scroll up for English Version
Qiuying Xu is a graduate of the School of International Communications in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences. In 2019, after graduating from UNNC, she gave up Warwick's offer and chose to go directly to Shanghai to engage herself in the advertising industry, and made rapid progress along this career path. She moved forward step by step, from a small company to a medium-sized company, and now she works in a Global 4A company, which is also one of the TOP 3 advertising companies in the world. Qiuying Xu, who only graduated two years ago, began her advertising career as an ordinary employee and is now an account manager. She is on her way to becoming among the youngest of the current generation of managers in the advertising industry.


[Draw new strength from every exercise]
When asked why she chose the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) after graduating from Tieren High School, Heilongjiang Province, Qiuying Xu said that she felt this Sino-Foreign Joint University can broaden ger horizons, and offer her a better platform and more opportunities, and her experience proved this to be true. During her 4 years study at UNNC, Qiuying participated in many student organizations and clubs, including Enactus, Eloquence and Speech club. She was also the monitor of her administrative class and a peer-mentor. She tried to seek every opportunity, and actively participated in speech contests to exercise her ability of expressing herself. She also remembers participating in various extracurricular activities such as the Colour Run and the Global Fair.

In the academic field, Qiuying Xu thinks the most noteworthy exercise is the student presentation in classes, and this is a special characteristic of the IC programme. She recalls that whether it is a second foreign language class or an IC class, the magic of the presentation is that it is a test to both preparation before class and the students’ ability of being flexible considering the situation. Every time before the presentation, everyone will prepare the ideas they wish to express so that they can share them with teachers and classmates, and then it comes to the Q&A session which she thinks is even more interesting.

"In the Q&A session, we not only think of some special questions in advance to ask others, but also get some new ideas from other students' questions. This is a very helpful skill for me now when I need to communicate with clients in the workplace, or when I need to express my thoughts clearly with others. I think this is a very meaningful skill to acquire in the university."

[Find the direction in constant exploration]
Qiuying Xu is a person who knows exactly what she wants, and her initial direction was found by going through trial and error. During her time in UNNC, she would do internships in almost every vacation, which gave her a broad range of practical experience in industry and the possibility to compare different careers horizontally. She thinks that the theories in the textbooks can help us understand what IC is, but it may not be clear about the branches under a certain industry and what they are actually doing. Through internships, we can go to these positions to learn about the industry and find the jobs that we love and excel at.

Qiuying Xu's internships included planning activities for a TV station, public relations, and digital media advertising positions and marketing. She said, "Every position has its advantages and disadvantages, so what is important is to consider whether the position is suitable for an individual. For example, after doing an internship similar to my current job, I would feel that this job is special for me, and I have a higher level of enthusiasm and love for it, and this strengthens my determination to follow this path. "


[Accomplish the self-transformation in a difficult situation]
Unlike most UNNC graduates who choose to do further studies, Qiuying Xu chose to move straight into her career, which is a path filled with both risks and rewards. When she first joined the new company, she immediately threw herself into the intense and exciting work, which made her fully feel how difficult it is to adapt to the workplace. Qiuying recalled that the difficulty in this shift is shown in the fact that she was sent to the border of Inner Mongolia to participate in the sports car border rally for three weeks in the harsh environment in the second week of her employment. Moreover, her superior left their post shortly after her joining the company, and the pressure for her to communicate with the clients and modify the plan increased all of a sudden.

In the interview, she smiled and said, "After going through all the things that were so difficult for me to overcome at that time, I feel that there is nothing to stop me in the future."

Qiuying Xu is now in the core middle management position of account manager. In this role she can now connect with and communicate the details of projects with international customers calmly, guide new staff to make independent proposals and brainstorm with the team to produce advertising ideas, and lead the team to make a complete project. In a short period of two years, she has participated in advertising projects of several big international brands such as Aston Martin, Estee Lauder and Christian Louboutin lipstick, and accumulated enough experience. Qiuying thinks that her current achievement largely depends on her personality of being good at communicating and accepting new things. She enjoys participating in the process of everyone comes up with new ideas together and how project changes from ideas to reality. She feels full of a sense of accomplishment when the creativity of the team is seen by customers and consumers all over the world.


[To UNNC and schoolmates]
"UNNC is a young, growing and promising university. We as students are growing with the school. We will become better in this open, inclusive, equal and thoughtful environment, and the school will also become better by listening to the voices of its students."

Qiuying Xu appreciates everything that UNNC had brought for her, and she hopes to have the opportunity one day soon to bask in the sun on the lawn in front of the clock tower again!

She also hopes that everyone will spend more time improving themselves, get to know themselves, and think carefully about what kind of life they want.



 许秋盈 ，宁波诺丁汉大学人文社科学院国际传播学毕业生。2019年，她从宁诺毕业后，放弃了华威的offer， 选择了直接到上海从事广告行业，并沿着这条路飞速成长。论公司，她一步一个台阶，从小型公司到中型公司，再到现在就职于Global 4A、全球TOP 的大型广告公司；论职位，她从普通员工一路晋升成为了客户经理。毕业才刚满两年的许秋盈，正向着广告界最年轻一代的经理人的方向不断迈进。


 从每一次锻炼中汲取新的力量
提及当初为什么在从黑龙江省大庆市铁人中学毕业后选择宁波诺丁汉大学（以下简称“宁诺”），许秋盈坦言，当时的她认为这所中外合办大学能让她有更宽阔眼界，更好的平台，更多的机会，事实证明也确实如此。在校期间，许秋盈参加了包括创行、口才与演讲社在内的多个组织与社团，还担任过行政班的班长和朋辈导师。她试图抓住每一次机会，积极参与校内外组织的演讲比赛来锻炼自己的表达能力。课余时间参与的Color Run和全球村等很多活动也都令她印象深刻。

许秋盈在宁诺毕业时与父母在钟楼前合照

在学术方面，许秋盈觉得最值得一提的具有国际传播学课程特色的课堂pre（演讲）。她回忆道，不论是第二外语的课还是传播学的专业课，课堂pre的魔力都在于它兼有可以提前准备的内容和随机应变的部分，每次pre前大家都会准备好自己想在演讲中阐述的观点以便于在课堂上与老师和同学分享，这之后则是更为有趣的问答环节。

“在问答环节中，我们不仅自己提前想一些特别的问题来提问其他同学，同时也在其他同学的提问中重新获取一些新的思考。这对于我现在在职场中与客户进行交流，或者是跟别人表达清楚自己的想法是很有帮助的，我觉得这都是在大学里非常有意义的事情。”



 在不断摸索中找到方向
许秋盈是一个非常了解自己想要什么的人，而她最初的方向则是通过一步步摸索，一次次尝试得来的。她在宁诺期间的几乎每个假期里，都会去做实习，这也使得她拥有了很充分的实践机会和横向对比各个工作的可能。她认为课本上的东西能让我们了解传播学是什么，但对于某个行业底下的分支具体在做什么可能并不太清楚，通过实习能够去到这些可能存在的分支里面，去了解自己擅长并且喜欢的行业和岗位。
 
许秋盈的多份实习包括电视台的活动策划、公关、数字媒体广告岗位和市场实习生等等， 她坦言，“每个岗位都有优势和弊端，重要的是考虑与个人的契合性。比如我当初做到和现在工作相似的实习后就会感受到它的特殊性，有不同于其它工作的热情和热爱，这坚定了我求职继续走这条路。”



 在困境中实现自我转换
与大多数选择继续申研的宁诺学子不同，许秋盈选择的直接就业的这条路风险、意外与收获并存。刚加入新公司的她便马上投入到了紧张而又刺激的工作中去，使她充分感受到了从学生快速转换到职场人士的身份的不适应性。许秋盈回忆道，这种不适应性体现在刚入职的第二周就被派到内蒙古边境在恶劣环境下参与了长达三周的跑车边境拉力赛的项目，又或者是工作不久后上级离职，一个人应对客户和修改方案时的压力剧增与不知所措。


现在的她似乎已经完成了蜕变，同时在心态方面也有了很大的提升。她笑着说，“对于当时的自己很难克服的事情到现在全都挺过来了之后，就觉得后面没有什么事情能让自己更加崩溃了。”

许秋盈现在身处团队的核心中层位置——项目经理的岗位上，她已经能从容地与国际客户对接与沟通项目上的细节，指导新人进行独立的提案和组织内部的头脑风暴产出广告创意并带领团队做出一个完整的作品。在这短短两年时间里，她参与过跑车Aston Martin（阿斯顿·马丁）、雅诗兰黛和christian louboutin（萝卜丁）口红等多个国际大牌的相关广告项目，也积累了足够的经验。许秋盈认为这和她个人善于沟通，喜欢接受新事物的性格是密不可分的，她享受大家一起想新点子，所有东西从想法变成玩法落地的过程，团队的创意能够让客户和全世界的消费者看到这一点更是令她内心充满成就感。



 给母校和学弟学妹们的话
“宁诺是一个年轻、在成长、有无限希望的学校，我们学生和学校在一起成长——我们们在学校这种开放包容，平等有思想的环境下会变得越来越好，而学校也会因为收集我们的声音而变得越来越好。”

许秋盈感谢UNNC带给她的所有，希望有机会还能在钟楼前的草坪上晒太阳！她也希望大家用更多的时间去沉淀自己，去自我复盘，去思考自己想要什么样的生活。

title: 点我 | 从最强大脑001到泰康东路199，海选第一少年的宁诺初体验
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - “Super Brain” contestant starts learning journey at UNNC.


在2018年最强大脑的舞台上，有这样一个少年：14岁参赛，就在10万人中拔得头筹；在聚光灯下比赛，依旧沉着冷静连续获得前三名；与清北、牛剑选手同台，仍能稳步闯进30强。他就是常峻硕，最强大脑舞台上的“智力小巨人”。
今年九月，常峻硕同学作为2021年新生，正式入学宁诺经济学专业，开启了他人生的新篇章。
明星光环？
“不，我只是个普通人”
在常峻硕身上被提及最多的一个标签，是“最强大脑海选第一名”。被问到这个标签会不会成为同学们眼里的光环时，他低头一笑说并没有太多人注意到这件事，不过自己为了通过社团组织的面试，还是把这段经历写了上去。在他眼中，“第一名”并非他急于摆脱的标签，也不是他拿来炫耀的资本。只不过是他少年时参加了一场比赛，恰好拿到了不错的名次，但更重要的是在这其中交到了朋友，也增长了见识。

谈及在《最强大脑》节目中的收获，常峻硕表示除了一些到现在还会联系的朋友之外，更重要的是发掘出了自己对于数独和高难度题目的兴趣。在节目之后，他还参加了很多数独方面的比赛，在全国数独锦标赛中取得了前50名的好成绩。
此外，他是很多高智商俱乐部的会员，同时也是“静宅”高智商俱乐部的出题人，空闲时间思考测试题目已经成为了他的日常生活的一部分。
这样一个“天才少年”最终选择宁诺，常同学说这是基于辅导他多年的数独老师推荐。虽然之前对这所学校未曾了解，但一经了解他就极速被宁诺的自由和独特圈粉了。
开放的学术氛围刚好可以给他自由发展的空间，多样且国际化的选择也十分符合他对于未来的期待。而他坦言选择经济系是顺理成章的事情，“据说经济系的未来前景比较好，而且数学比较难。”

只会读书？
不，他学习娱乐两不误
对于在宁诺的校园生活，采访中常同学说得最多的就是“挺好的”、“很满意”。相比于其他在社团组织与学习中来回奔波的大一同学，他身上似乎更多了几分游刃有余。
由于从初中开始就经常参加一些全球性的比赛或者智商测试，所以全英文的题目对他来说是家常便饭；而号称全校最卷的经济系数学课程，对于数独锦标赛全国前50的他来说更是不成问题。

除了天赋和积累，常同学的这份游刃有余也来自于他的谦逊和自知。虽然大一的学业不算忙碌，但他还是没有选择加入太多的社团组织，问及原因他表示不希望占用自己太多时间，还是想要认真学习。这种少而精的选择反而让他在社团组织中有精力去承担更重要的职责，他作为项目组成员筹备的音乐节以及作为Leader准备的宣讲会都将在不久之后呈现在全校同学面前。
虽然嘴上时常挂着“好好学习”，但这并不意味着他不会娱乐。在课堂之外，学校的I-week（新生周）期间，常峻硕结识了一群可以一起学习、一起玩乐的好朋友。他们会经常凑在一起玩桌游、密室等等属于Z时代的娱乐活动，在他眼中，这群朋友是“在游戏输掉之后会立刻拿起电脑学习”的人。也是这群朋友，让他在宁诺感受到了更多的快乐和归属感。
谈到未来，常同学说他希望大一均分80+，并且还打算再次参加今年的数独锦标赛。至于更远的未来，他觉得现在考虑还太早，“好好学习，专注于眼前的路，一步一步脚踏实地向前走就行了。”
“Super Brain” contestant starts learning journey at UNNC

Junshuo Chang, renowned as the first prize winner of audition in the popular TV show “Super Brain”, started his university life as a year one student of Economics at University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC).
In the 2018 Super Brain, the 14-year-old Junshuo stood out from 100,000 contestants in the audition and managed to steadily reach the top 30 competing with people from top universities such as Cambridge and Oxford. 
When talking about what he gained from this experience, Junshuo shares that it enlightened his interest in Sudoku and solving difficult mathematical problems. He has been among the top 50 of the China Sudoku Championship and is a member of many high IQ clubs. He is also the test author of the Silent House High IQ Society. For Junshuo, mulling over test questions in spare time is a part of his daily life.
According to Junshuo, the reason why he chose UNNC was the recommendation of his Sudoku teacher who had tutored him for years. Although unfamiliar with the university at first, he was immediately attracted by its free and open atmosphere and the British education style after learning about it. Despite his interest in mathematics, he eventually settled on Economics because he looks forward to a career in the area.
So far, Junshuo feels happy and at ease with his university life. Compared with other year one students who may encounter perplexity, he has adapted to the preliminary year effortlessly. Since he has participated in international competitions and IQ tests since junior high school, he has no difficulty accustoming to classes in English, and with brilliant mathematical foundation, he can easily solve the complicated math problems of Economics. 
In addition to talent and accumulation of academic knowledge, the excellence of Junshuo is also derived from his humility and self-awareness. Instead of participating in multiple student associations and organisations like many freshers, he plans to utilise his time and concentrate on study and the specific organisations that he is interested in.
Junshuo also knows the importance of proper relaxation. During induction week, he has been acquainted with friends whom he can both study and have fun with. They often gather together and play games that are popular among generation Z such as board games. It is these friends that give him a sense of belonging at UNNC.
When speaking of the future, Junshuo hopes to score an average of over 80 in the preliminary year and plans to compete in the national Sudoku championship again this year. As for the distant future, Junshuo decides that he will "just study hard, concentrate on the present and be firmly grounded".

title: 走进郑州 | 我校新增四所优质生源基地
content:
11月1日，在河南省教育厅的大力支持下，宁波诺丁汉大学郑州招生座谈会在郑州顺利举行，来自郑州市第一中学、河南省实验中学、郑州市第七中学、郑州市第四十七中学、郑州市第二中学、郑州市第十九中学及郑州中学的校领导及相关部门负责人出席了会议。
      在座谈会上，宁波诺丁汉大学党委副书记、副校长沈伟其教授向大家介绍了宁波诺丁汉大学的发展历史、办学特色、教学模式、师资力量、学校排名、学生出国深造及就业数据等相关情况，希望以共建优质生源基地的契机，与郑州市的优秀高中进一步加强友好交流合作，实现互利共赢。



现场宣讲会照片

      会上，各位校长均表示宁波诺丁汉大学的确是一所极具特色和竞争力的中外合作大学，希望能将更多优秀的学生送到宁波诺丁汉大学学习。在热烈的座谈后，沈校长代表宁波诺丁汉大学与到会的七所高中均达成合作协议，并与郑州市第一中学、郑州市第二中学、郑州市第七中学及郑州市第四十七中学现场签约并授牌。去年，我校已与郑州外国语学校，郑州第十一中学及洛阳理工学院附属中学签订了合作协议，截止目前，河南已有七所高中与我校签订了合作协议，成为我校的优质生源基地。此次座谈会后，我校也会积极落实与到会其他三所高中的合作。

关于宁波诺丁汉大学
宁波诺丁汉大学宣传片

宁波诺丁汉大学创建于 2004 年，是中国第一所经教育部批准引进世界一流大学并具有独立法人资格、独立校园的中外合作大学。大学目前有 8000 多名学生，其中超 7% 的学生来自中国港澳台，以及其他 75 个国家和地区。

学校已建立商学院、人文与社会科学学院和理工学院三大学院，是全国第一所提供本科、硕士和博士多层次专业教学的中外合作大学。




截止至今日，我校已与遍布 30 多个国家和地区的超 100 所海外一流院校建立密切交流合作关系，保证每一位学生都有体验海外学习的机会。

升学就业情况
在选择出国深造的 2020 届本科毕业生中：
86.9% 进入QS世界大学排名前 100
58.8%进入QS世界大学排名前 50
31.1%进入QS世界大学排名前 10

在选择外资及合资企业就职的2020届本科毕业生中：
76.5% 的毕业生在全球 500 强和全球行业龙头企业工作，如：雀巢、可口可乐、联合利华、阿里巴巴、腾讯科技、尼尔森、特斯拉、安永、汇丰银行等。
数据来源：对2020届本科毕业生的离校问卷调查和访问。参考2021QS世界大学排名。

title: 我的大学 | 张津毓：非线性的自我成长之路
content:
MY UNNC STORY


张津毓
Zhang Jinyu
宁波诺丁汉大学金融财务与管理专业2021届毕业生
毕业去向：欧洲工商管理学院（INSEAD）管理学硕士
毕业高中：枣庄实验高中（枣庄三中）

Our interview with Zhang Jinyu took place online as she is now in Fontainebleau, France, for her postgraduate studies. The six-hour time difference did not affect the recall of her four beautiful years at UNNC.

Scroll down for the English version.

与张津毓的采访约在了线上，她已前往法国的枫丹白露开始硕士阶段的深造，六小时的时差，并不影响四年美好点滴的追忆。

聊起第一次与宁诺结缘，津毓说，从高中开始，就产生了出国留学的想法，也是在那时了解到了宁波诺丁汉大学（UNNC，以下简称“宁诺”）。“之所以选择宁诺，因为觉得它的环境氛围很好，充满了可能性。大学四年是价值观塑造的关键时期，我希望在这四年中，深度挖掘自己的潜力，不给自己设限，看到这个世界的多元，而不是成为传统意义上优秀的人。” 满怀着期待，她踏入了宁诺的大门。



学之有道，方能折桂
在宁诺的四年里，张津毓连续三年获得了Head Scholarship（系主任奖学金），这在竞争激烈的FAM（金融财务与管理）专业里属实不易。此外，她还利用课余时间，学习其他知识。提到拿高分的秘诀，津毓坦诚地说道：“在学习方面，我比较强调高效。我比较习惯在短期内百分之百专注，所以我的策略一般会集中精力突击。” 此外，津毓还分享了学习时间分配技巧：一些难度偏大且偏数理的课，如QM(计量方法)和FFMA(财务与管理会计学基础)，需要花费大量精力但收获也很大，我会根据二八法则来分配时间，从而提高成绩。津毓说二八法则不仅用在了每门课的分配上，也用在了她的本科生活中，关于学校课业方面，她个人的想法是保持一个比较上游的成绩，其他的时间用来探索自我和职业规划。“学习绝不仅在书本和课堂上，更在于生活中。”

聊起很多宁诺同学关注的考证问题，津毓表示，通过考证可以获得个人的成长和知识的储备，但这些是难以量化的，而客观地从职业规划和申研的角度来看，考证的作用微乎其微。在她看来，职业规划是一个长期过程，不能因为考个证就把自己框住，而要去选择自己真正擅长并且喜欢的职业。
知一方水土，迎四海宾朋
大一大二期间，张津毓担任了校园大使，接待了上百位来自海内外的教授和国际学生，还有合作公司高层管理人员等。大一暑假，她作为宁诺国际夏校志愿者，全程陪同来自14个国家的25名国际生在华行程安排。同时，她还曾在几项国际峰会（多国总理出席）中担任会务助理。“我很重视国际化，未来希望可以在多个国家生活工作，不想把自己局限在一种文化里，所以本科的国际化机会我都想抓住，都想体验，” 津毓说。校园大使对成员的英语水平有很高的要求，而且待人接物也要得体。“校园大使对我的英语和社交能力是非常大的锻炼，而且我在接待来参观的家长，或者国内外教授这个过程中，也在思索宁诺的核心理念是什么，应该怎么去展示宁诺学子的形象，” 她说道。这份工作不仅局限在校园里，有时津毓也会带着外宾去宁波的景点，介绍当地文化，这需要她首先去了解风土人情，并不停地与人交谈，在不知不觉中锻炼了她的口才。“其实我们学校提供了很多这样的志愿者机会，特别适合大一大二时间相对充裕的学生多参与。” 津毓补充道。


通文达艺，全面发展
回顾本科四年，最让津毓感慨万千的还是彼此陪伴一起奋斗了四年的阿卡贝拉乐团。“一开始纯粹是因为一腔热血，因为太喜欢阿卡贝拉这种音乐形式，而这种音乐形式在国内又很小众，所以很想看看能不能有机会把它做起来。” 初创成员均为2017级学生，在2014级的学长Thomas的帮助下，宁诺第一支阿卡贝拉纯人声乐团X-Cape就此诞生，过去四年里，校内大大小小的舞台，甚至其他高校的晚会，都有X-Cape的身影。

“阿卡对表演者的音准、舞台设备、团队默契等等的要求都非常高，这也是为什么国内玩阿卡的人很少。团队刚成立的时候，我们没有专业的指导、设备、排练场地等，很多东西都要自己慢慢摸索，磨合。但四年发展下来，我们的演出邀约越来越多，成为了宁诺艺术团的附属表演队，有了更多非常厉害的新成员。”

“我觉得发展兴趣爱好对我来说特别重要，尤其是在我特别累的时候，阿卡贝拉就像给我充电一样。和大家在一起唱歌非常开心，每次排练都其乐融融，欢声笑语。” 津毓感触很深的是，她玩阿卡贝拉纯粹是因为喜欢而付出了很多精力，但这个爱好，却让她在INSEAD的面试中给面试官留下了深刻的印象，最终也帮助斩获offer。


多元历练，不惧试错

津毓的实习经历十分多元化：在国内本土咨询公司打cold call(陌生电话)，参与阿姆斯特丹大学在国内的一个战略研究项目，在知名市场调研公司担任市场分析实习生。在不断探索商业世界的过程中，津毓发现并确定了自己对消费领域的热爱。最后凭借出色的商赛成绩和对市场营销的思考进入了知名美妆公司欧莱雅做暑期实习。

“本科阶段的实习，最重要的是发现自己想做的事，或者最起码发现自己不想做的事。个人认为本科期间还是要多做一些尝试，不要因为自己学了这个专业，考了那个证书，在某个行业已经实习过了，不想放弃沉没成本，而去轻易地决定接下来几年甚至几十年的职业方向。”

而被问到参与商赛的收获，张津毓认为，参与商赛是一个非常好的推动自己去了解整个行业各个环节的机会，能展现自己对一个行业的系统性思考，也能锻炼团队合作能力。


桃李不言，下自成蹊

在宁诺学习期间，有很多老师为张津毓提供了很大的帮助。“我大二的personal tutor （个人导师），同时也是我们那时的经济学老师— Peter Anderson，给了我很大的帮助。大二期间，我非常焦虑，不知道自己是不是应该放弃金融和会计的道路，当时他给了我很多建议，也给予我很多认可，并鼓励我追求自己喜欢的方向。我建议学弟学妹们多去找personal tutor(个人导师)聊聊，不论是成长还是学习上的问题，他们都会给你很多有建设性的引导。如果对某门课或者某个方向很感兴趣的话，也建议大家利用office hour(老师接待学生时间），多去和学科老师聊一聊。” 津毓说。她很感恩的还有黄琳老师，在2021欧莱雅Brandstorm商赛期间，她为津毓的团队提供了很多建议和帮助，最后津毓的团队成功入围了全国前二十强（共1500余支参赛队伍）。对于商学院老师们的帮助，津毓心里满是感激。

除了老师，父母更是张津毓发展道路背后最大的支柱，“我父母对我最大的支持就是，不会帮我做决定。不管是选择高中、大学还是未来的生活和职业规划，以及生活中的小事，都会和他们事无巨细地分享，包括这么做的原因，可能的后果等。只要我向他们表达清楚我的想法，他们都会非常支持我，这让我不会去惧怕走一条和别人不一样的道路。” 父母不干涉的态度，让张津毓在一个比较早的年纪就认识到了自己真正想要什么，非常地独立，可以去做好自己的决定，而不是让父母去安排好一切事情。津毓说：“大学就是去试错、去尝试、去多做，不要担心自己比别人跑得慢，因为你永远不知道什么时候会弯道超越。有一句话是，不要总想着局部最优解（即小阶段的胜利），局部最优解未必能达成全局最优解，局部最优解往往只会不可避免地走向平庸，这句话对我非常有帮助。”

“履历只是手段，不是目的。这四年的思考，试错和最终形成的（现阶段的）逻辑自洽和自我和解，是我最感恩的收获。我觉得知道自己想要成为什么样的人，如何在有限的条件里创造出一个有滋味的生活和值得期待的未来，比追求阶段性的成就重要的多得多。”

采访最后，说起在UNNC(宁诺)自己最大的改变是什么，津毓说：“是做自己吧，我从一个比较从众的精致利己主义者变成了一个偏理想主义的人。相比于四年前的自己，从‘由外’变成了‘向内’，从追求外界的认可和可以量化的优秀，变成了追求自己内心的价值追求和对世界的思考。现在的我更加注重自己的成长，体验和未来的可能性。人生不是线性的，希望自己接下来的几年还是能保持对世界的强烈好奇心，dig my potential and possibility, and be limitless(挖掘潜能，创造无极限）。”

My UNNC Story | Zhang Jinyu: The Way of Non-linear Self Growth

Our interview with Zhang Jinyu took place online as she is now in Fontainebleau, France for her postgraduate studies. The six-hour time difference did not affect the recall of her four beautiful years at UNNC.

Talking about her first sense of UNNC, Jinyu said that she had the idea of studying abroad since high school and learnt about the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) at that time: "I chose UNNC because its environment is perfect and full of possibilities. My four years at UNNC was a critical period that moulded my values. I hoped to discover my potential and see the diversity offered by this world, rather than just becoming a good person in a traditional sense." Full of anticipation, she stepped through UNNC's gates.


Be wise in learning and achieve excellence
During her four years in UNNC, Zhang Jinyu won the Head Scholarship for three consecutive years, which was not easy in the competitive Finance Accounting and Management degree programme. In addition, she made full use of her spare time and received high grades in many exams that earned her qualifications. Speaking of the secret of achieving high scores, Jinyu said frankly: "In terms of learning, I attach great importance to effectiveness. I'm used to being 100% focused for a short period." In addition, Jinyu also shared how she organised her time: some challenging and partial mathematical courses, such as QM(Quantitative Methods) and FFMA(Fundamentals of Financial and Management Accounting), requires spending a lot of effort to figure them out, but a lot of progress can be made. It is essential to gauge one's ratio of input-output and organise time according to the 80/20 Rule (also called the Pareto Principle ) to improve average scores. The 80/20 Rule was used in organising times for learning and every aspect of Jinyu's undergraduate life. Her personal goal is to maintain relatively good academic performance while also leaving time to explore herself and make career plans. Jinyu believes that learning not only happens in books and classrooms but also in life.


Talking about the extra qualifications and certificates that many students are concerned about, Jinyu said that obtaining them can help you achieve personal growth and knowledge. But this is subjective. When applying for jobs and postgraduate study, obtaining a certificate has little effect. In her view, career planning is a long-term process. "We should not restrict ourselves to the certificate's or qualification's field, but to choose a career which we will be really good at and like. "

Slide up to read more.

Introduce local culture and receive friends from around the world 
Zhang Jinyu served as a campus ambassador during her freshman and second year, receiving many professors, students and senior management figures from companies home and abroad. As a UNNC International Summer School volunteer, she received 25 international students from 14 countries in her freshman summer vacation. Throughout their time together, she was responsible for all their itineraries in China. At the same time, she also served as a conference assistant at several international summits (attended by premiers from many countries). "I attach great importance to internationalisation, and I hope to be able to live and work in multiple countries in the future. I don't want to limit myself to a single culture. Therefore, I want to seize international working opportunities during my university life," said Jinyu. Campus ambassadors must meet extremely high requirements for English proficiency, and they must be well-mannered when dealing with others." Being a campus ambassador greatly exercised my English and social skills. When receiving visiting parents or foreign professors, I was also thinking about what the core philosophy of UNNC is and how I should demonstrate the image of UNNCers," Jinyu explained. This job was not limited to the campus only. Sometimes Jinyu would take foreign guests to Ningbo's and Hangzhou's scenic spots to introduce local cultures. This required her to understand the local customs before explaining them to people, which exercised her eloquence. "In fact, our university provides many such volunteer opportunities, which are especially suitable for students who have spare time during their freshman and second years," Jinyu added.   

Be versatile and well-rounded. 
Looking back on her four years of undergraduate study, what impressed Jinyu most was the Acapella group that she started and has since flourished for four years. "At the beginning, funding an acapella group was purely out of my passion because I like this form of music very much. But this kind of music was not popular in China, so I wanted to see whether I could do it," said Jinyu. The founding members are all students from the Class of 2017. With the help of Thomas, a Year 4 student from the Class of 2014, X-Cape, the first pure acapella vocal band in UNNC, was born. During the past four years, X-Cape has appeared on various stages of UNNC and even in the activities of other universities.

"Acapella has very high requirements on performers' intonation, stage equipment, teamwork, and so on, which is why there are very few people involved in acapella groups in China. When the team was just established, we had no professional guidance, equipment, rehearsal space, etc. We had to explore and adapt many things by ourselves."

"But during our four years, we received more and more invitations to perform, and we became an affiliate of the UNNC Art Troupe, and then we welcomed more and more new members."

"I think it's really important for me to develop hobbies, especially when I was exhausted, singing acapella recharged me. I had so much fun singing with the group members. Everyone was happy during every rehearsal."

Jinyu feels deeply that she did not have any other motive when participating in the acapella group – it was purely out of her passion. Additionally, this hobby made her stand out during the INSEAD interview, leaving a deep impression on the interviewers, and she finally got the offer.

Diverse experiences, not being afraid of trial and error
Jinyu's internship experience was diverse: doing cold calls in a domestic consulting company, participating in a strategic research project for the University of Amsterdam, and doing market analysis in a well-known market research company. In constantly exploring the business world, Jinyu discovered and confirmed her love for the consumer sector. "Finally, I got a summer internship at L'Oreal, a famous cosmetics company, based on my excellent ranking in business competitions and my understanding of marketing," Jinyu revealed.

"Undergraduate internships are all about finding out what you want to do, or at least what you don't want to do. Let's try more during undergraduate study. Also, I don't want to easily decide my career direction in the next few years or even decades because of my degree, certificates and internships, and those sunk costs," Jinyu explained. When asked about what she learned by participating in business competitions, Jinyu said that participating in business competitions was a perfect opportunity to understand all the aspects of an industry, show systematic thinking about an industry, and exercise teamwork skills.

Be grateful to those who supported you.
During her study at UNNC, many teachers provided excellent support to Zhang Jinyu. "One of my teachers was my second-year personal tutor – Peter Anderson. During my second year, I was very anxious and wondered if I should give up the path of finance and accounting. At that time, he gave me a lot of suggestions and encouraged me to pursue a direction I liked. I suggest that younger students speak to their tutors more. Whether it is growing or learning problems, they will give us suggestions. I also recommend that everyone use their subject tutors' officer hours to talk to them," Jinyu said. Another teacher she recalls is Dr Lin Huang. During the business competitions, Lin provided Jinyu with many suggestions and helped Jinyu successfully enter the national top 20 (1500+ teams in total). Jinyu is very grateful for the help given to her by the business school teachers.

In addition to her teachers, Jinyu's parents are her most prominent supporters, especially during her development. "My parents' greatest support is that they will not interfere with my decisions. Whether choosing a high school or a university, or what I generally do, I share everything with them, including my reasons for doing something, the possible consequences, etc. As long as I clearly express my ideas to them, they will be very supportive of me, so I will not be afraid to take a different path from others, which helps me to mature faster." Her parents' attitude of non-interference allowed Zhang Jinyu to realise what she wanted at a relatively early age and that she could make her own decisions instead of letting her parents decide everything. Jinyu said: "University is all about trial and error. Don't worry about running slower than others, because we never know when we will overcome. There is a saying, ‘don't always think about the local optimal solution, which is a victory in the small stage. The local optimal solution may not reach the global optimal solution, and the local optimal solution tends to inevitably lead to mediocrity.' This idea has been and still is very helpful to me."
"Resumes are a means, not an end. After four years of understanding, and trial and error, finally formed (at this stage) a logical self-consistency and reconciling with myself, which is what I am most grateful for. I think it is much more important to know what kind of person I want to be and how to create a rewarding life and a promising future within limited circumstances than it is to pursue periodic achievements."

Afterword  
At the end of the interview, talking about her biggest change at UNNC, Jinyu explained: "Being myself. I have changed from being a conformist and slightly self-concerned to a much more idealistic person. Compared with four years ago, my former self has changed from the 'outside' to 'inside', from pursuing external recognition and quantifiable excellence, to pursuing better inner values and thinking about the world. Now I pay more attention to my growth, experience and future possibilities. Life is not linear, but limitless."

title: 字节跳动、腾讯、德勤、欧莱雅等都来了！ 宁波诺丁汉大学联合近700家名企助力毕业生高质量就业
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC graduates favoured by top employers in the autumn recruitment.
秋意浓，冬将至。虽然近日气温骤降，宁波诺丁汉大学2022届毕业生系列招聘活动却正如火如荼。
字节跳动、哔哩哔哩、强生、欧莱雅、玛氏、德勤、宝洁、通用电气、联合利华等世界500强和国内外知名企业都来了，今年9-11月，宁诺秋招精彩不断！

小米通讯2022校园招聘宁诺专场宣讲会
KPMG在宁诺举办校招宣讲会
上周，宁诺在校内举办了小米通讯2022校园招聘专场宣讲会，向宁诺学子开放了涵盖软\硬件研发、产品、运营、设计、市场、销售、供应链等方向的岗位。
宣讲会上，小米人力资源部海外高校组的负责人李国民提到来宁波诺丁汉大学的契机，“小米在飞速发展的过程中，业务和生态越来越多元化、国际化。受全球疫情的影响，我们的海外工作受到了一些影响，愈发需要具有国际视野和多元教育背景的人才。”
他说，
“宁波诺丁汉大学是中国第一所中外合作大学，培养出来的学生具有国际视野和思辨精神，跨文化沟通能力和解决问题的能力突出，加上疫情前，我在做海外招聘时曾接触过分布在世界各地的宁诺校友，他们优秀的专业技能、应对挑战的能力给我留下了很深刻的印象，所以把宁诺作为此次校招的重点院校之一。”
李国民说，今年是首次跟宁诺合作，期待未来建立长期合作，进行更多校企互动。

其实，不止小米，在宁诺满满当当的秋招会日历上，可以看到国内外各大名企的名字。今年9-11月，宁波诺丁汉大学招生与就业发展办公室联合如字节跳动、哔哩哔哩、强生、欧莱雅、玛氏、德勤、宝洁、通用电气、联合利华等世界500强和国内外知名企业，安排了约60场线上线下企业招聘宣讲会，涵盖金融服务、快速消费品、互联网、汽车制造、房地产、航空航天、电子电气等各行各业，目前参与学生超过3500人次，系列活动受到来自学生和企业双方的一致好评。
宁诺2021年秋季校招日程表（部分），点击可查看大图


一直以来，宁波诺丁汉大学招生与就业发展办公室始终坚持“全程、全员、全方位、精准化”的就业指导方针，多样化实习服务为主线，系统化的生涯指导服务体系为支撑，启用“一生一策”动态管理就业服务模式，助力学生实现最优的个人发展。
今年，宁波诺丁汉大学进一步加强与名企的战略合作，凭借完善的就业信息平台，为企业-学生双向选择提供更加方便、精准的渠道。目前，已有华为、欧莱雅、联合利华、玛氏等近700家中外知名企业在宁诺就业信息平台注册，与学校开展长期合作。

中国银行、通商银行
在宁诺举办校招宣讲会

同时，宁波诺丁汉大学通过多样化实习服务提升学生就业竞争力，举办招聘会、实习比赛、国际组织实习、暑期实习项目、校友公益项目等多种类型的实习项目，为学生打造就业力发展平台。
此外，构建“以学生为本”的生涯指导服务体系，全面覆盖每个年级、每位学生，有效联动校内外教师、企业、校友资源，形成就业指导合力，开发线上线下多门精品课程，内容包括职业规划、自我探索、行业职业和实习求职申研等，精准投放给不同年级、专业的学生群体。
针对毕业生的升学需求，宁诺招生与发展就业办公室通过线上申研课程、线下一对一指导、校友学长分享等，为学生开拓名校申请之路；同时，积极与海外名校建立合作，把名校带到学生身边。


目前，宁波诺丁汉大学已累计向社会输送了近2万名本科、硕士、博士毕业生，他们勤勉踏实、勇于创新和敢于实践的品质受到全球企业和院校广泛青睐。根据今年1月发布的《宁诺2019/20学年就业质量报告》，2020届升学的本科毕业生超过30%被世界排名前10的顶尖学府录取，近60%被排名前50的名校录取，约87%被排名前100的院校录取。直接工作的本科毕业生约75%去往国有企业、政府机关、事业单位、世界 500 强或中外知名企业机构，如中石油、中国建设银行、字节跳动、华为、腾讯科技、联合利华、雀巢、尼尔森等。


宁诺2022届毕业生系列招聘活动火热进行中，更多企业校招信息及宣讲会安排，请关注“宁诺就业”微信公众号。

UNNC graduates favoured by top employers in the autumn recruitment

The 2022 graduate autumn jobs fair at University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) is in full swing. Last week, the 2022 Xiaomi Corporation Global Campus Recruitment was held on campus, with abundant positions including software and hardware development, product, operation, design, marketing, sales, and supply chain opened to UNNC students.
Martin Li, Overseas University Affairs Lead from HR Department of Xiaomi, announced during the recruitment presentation that Xiaomi's business and ecosystem have become increasingly diversified and international, and that due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, the overseas business urgently needs more talent with international vision and diverse educational background. He stated: “The distinction of UNNC alumni, whom I had met in work, left a deep impression on me. UNNC, therefore, is one of the key universities in our campus recruitment scheme." 
Besides Xiaomi, the Admission and Career Development Office (ACDO) of UNNC has been cooperating with world 500 or major domestic and international companies such as Bytedance, L’Oreal, Deloitte, P&G, General Electric and Unilever to organise a series of recruitment presentations both online and offline from September and November, covering industries including financial services, FMCG, internet, automobile manufacturing, real estate, and aerospace engineering. By far, over 3500 students have participated in the recruitment fairs. 
ACDO has been dedicated to providing students with comprehensive, professional, and tailored-made guidance, and diversified internship services. Despite the influence of the pandemic, it has provided career support of high quality with a new mode of “one student, one policy”, that seeks to ensure that graduates are able to achieve optimal personal development. 
This year, the University further enhances its strategic cooperation with over 700 well-known domestic and foreign companies to provide a convenient and accurate platform for enterprises and students through the comprehensive career system. ACDO also offers a series of high-quality internship services such as the Internship Fair, Golden Interns Award, international organisation internship, and Summer Placement Programme to help students improve their employability. 
Besides, career guidance services comprehensively cover each grade and each student, which can effectively link the resources of teachers, companies, and alumni inside and outside the University, forming a joint force for career guidance, and developing both online and offline quality courses, including professional channels such as career planning, self-exploration, industry occupations, and internships in all grades and majors in accordance with their aptitude. 
With diversified and professional internship programmes and career guidance provided by the University, UNNC graduates are highly competitive in employment and further study. According to UNNC 2019/20 Academic Year Careers and Employability Annual Report, over 30% of undergraduates who sought further education were admitted by world top 10 universities, approximately 60% by top 50 universities, and around 87% entered top 100 universities. About 75% of directly employed undergraduates went to state-owned enterprises, government agencies, public institutions, Fortune 500 companies and well-known domestic and international enterprises, such as Ministry of , Tencent, Nestle and Nielson.

title: 韩薇：助力中国企业出海，国际视野帮她在职场开疆拓土
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - From UNNC to Google - Wei Han’s journey to success.

10月，刚刚入职谷歌北京两个月的韩薇，已经跟手头上几位头部互联网企业客户做完了上一季度的复盘，正积极投入到下一季度的业务计划中。她戏谑自己是一个闲不住的主，这种在每个时期都秉持着积极努力的优质惯性，若追根溯源，母校宁波诺丁汉大学对韩薇影响最为深远。





韩薇





宁诺拓展了她的国际视野

2014年高考结束后，分数高出一本线不少的韩薇义无反顾地选择了宁诺的国际传播学。

“每个人都会有一个执着的梦想，当初我想出去看看，扩展自己的认知和视野。”
韩薇说，那时的综合考虑，她觉得宁诺是解锁这个梦想的最适合钥匙，事实证明，她的抉择是正确的。

宁诺采用了英国诺丁汉大学教学质量保障体系、共享英国诺丁汉大学网络和教学资源。入学后，韩薇真正感受到了英式教学的模式，在宁诺的学习经历，为她日后求学、工作打下了扎实的语言基础，更是全面锻炼了她的个人能力。

韩薇大三时，作为交换生求学英国诺丁汉大学，进一步拓展了她国际化视野，“既然有了广阔的平台，自己更加要努力，无论是学业还是实习都是对自己最好的提升。”韩薇说。



宁诺校友会是像灯塔一样的存在

“申研时，在几个offer面前，我选择了英国伦敦大学学院。初到异国他乡，肯定比较懵，而宁诺在英国的校友会真的对我帮助挺大。”韩薇说，这些学长学姐一般都已经在英国工作若干年了，他们会以自身的求职经历和心得给学弟学妹们做参考。韩薇也正是受到校友会一位学姐经历的启发，开始考虑跨专业求职 。
韩薇就读的专业中，不少毕业学子会去国内媒体单位或大型企划类公司，但有个跟韩薇就读相关专业的学姐，她建议韩薇无须局限于专科背景公司，可以尝试跨界找工作。
最后也是学姐的推荐，韩薇进入了英国美妆电商独角兽公司The Hut Group。通过自己的努力，韩薇还未毕业便开始了她的职业生涯。
在The Hut Group上班时与品牌合照
在曼彻斯特的韩薇
UNNC毕业照



任何时候都需怀揣执着之心

一个文科背景出身的学生，在英国的电商企业工作，似乎每个关键词都不太搭，可是只要你够努力，一切也没这么困难。

韩薇说，初入公司，只有自己的母语是中文，其他同组同事的母语都是英文，看上去起跑线就矮了一截，但她从不灰心，认真做好手头的工作，“以前在宁诺学习过多种数据分析工具，国际传播专业要求学生大量阅读，这为我学习和分析新事物的能力打下基础。国际化的学习环境，也帮助我很快融入了跨文化的工作氛围。”韩薇迅速适应了海外电商的工作节奏。

机会一直青睐有准备的人。每周一的工作会议上，都需要提交一份回顾报表，是熟悉公司业务的好机会，于是，韩薇主动揽下了这份制表，“压力肯定有，但我之前已经看过了其他人的制图案例，而且对公司的业务也有所了解，所以有备而战也还可以！”韩薇调皮地回忆道。当然，2年后，她成了他们之中最快升职的人员，她的销售业绩也让公司领导十分赞许。


就在一路顺风顺水时，韩薇却决定回国了。带着想为祖国事业而努力的热忱，和在国际舞台学习工作的经历，果不其然，韩薇回国投了几份简历，都抛来了橄榄枝。她最终选择了谷歌，入职谷歌的国际拓展客户经理，负责国内头部互联网企业的出海业务。

为何选这份职业呢？她说，自己还有点小小的英雄主义情结，希望通过自己的努力，把国内的好产品推广全球，为中国的优质企业贡献一点点的力量。


English version

From UNNC to Google - Wei Han’s journey to success

Having joined Google for two months, Wei Han, an alumna of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC), has actively engaged in the business plan for the last quarter of the year. Wei jokes that she’s not someone who likes to be idle, and always maintains a positive attitude in every task. This hard-working mentality stems from her time at UNNC. 
After Gaokao, Wei chose to take International Communications at UNNC, considering it a key to unlocking her dream of broadening her sight. The undergraduate experience was just as she thought - UNNC allowed her to receive a British-style education, giving her a solid foundation for study and work abroad in the future. 
In Year three, Wei studied abroad in UoN as an exchange student, which broadened her international vision. “Whether it was through academia or internships, I had plenty of ways to further improve myself,” she said.
In Wei’s choice of her further study and career, alumni connections helped her navigate her path - senior alumni would share their job-hunting experiences in the UK with the new students. “When I first arrived in the UK, it took me a while to fit in, but the UNNC alumni in the UK really helped me out a lot”, she said. Following their advice, she looked for work beyond her own degree, and ultimately found a job at The Hut Group, a British beauty e-commerce company. 
When Wei entered the company, she was the only non-native English speaker, but she was never discouraged. “I learned a variety of data analysis tools while studying at UNNC, and the course International Communications requires students to do massive reading, which lays a foundation for my ability to learn and analyse new things. The international learning environment also helped me integrate into the cross-cultural working atmosphere,” she quickly strived to adapt to the overseas working style.
Opportunities always favour the prepared mind. Wei recalls when she first joined her company, she took the initiative over the weekly report writing proactively - “there was a lot of pressure at first. But after observing other cases and getting familiar with the company rules, I found I was confident enough to get the job done!” Within two years, she became the fastest promoted employee among her batch, with her sales performance commended by the company.
Wei eventually decided to return to China and take on the role of international account manager at Google, responsible for the overseas business of leading domestic internet companies. She hopes to promote Chinese products through this position and make her own contribution to the development of China’s enterprises on the global stage.

title: 科研落地！宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院交出了一份“范文”
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC transfers research outcomes to innovative product.
最近，一笔笔桌面五轴机床订单“飞来”，为宁波诺丁汉大学先进制造中心迎来了“开门红”。据悉，这是该中心第一个正式被批准的商业化项目，其背后的历程凸显了宁波诺丁汉大学对“科研落地、教研相长”的重视和决心。

01
一个“偷懒”想法萌生的设计图
文中开头提到的“五轴机床”是精密度高且专门用于加工复杂曲面的机床，对国家的航空、航天、军工、精密器械、高端模具、高精医疗设备等行业发展有着举足轻重的作用。
宁诺先进智能制造研究团队的学科带头人李灏楠博士带领团队自主研发的“桌面五轴机床”是一款创新型产品，它一改传统机床往日的笨重、不易移动且费用昂贵等缺点，外型轻巧、可便携，体积较之前减少了40倍，受到国内众多高校科研院所的青睐。


有着如此创新魅力的产品是如何“诞生”的呢？李灏楠笑着打趣道：“为了偷懒！”原来，从事科研团队的学生们那会儿做实验在二楼，实际操作传统机床放置在一楼，所以每次做科研就看着他们上上下下爬楼梯，可体型如此大的机床挪不到二楼，于是萌生了设计轻便式机床的想法。而且，这与学校曾提议的制造中心需设计个性化设备的想法不谋而合，于是，李灏楠带领整个团队花费了一年多的时间，在不停地试错中，验证了桌面五轴机床的可行性，使得第一代桌面机床成功“出世”。
此后，团队不断地根据市场反馈对功能进行添加和删减，并考虑到批量生产的需求，对设备进行迭代升级。如今桌面机床到今年年底将产生第三代产品。中心已经接到了不少预订订单。

02
以研促教的探索性教学
目前，有着国际学术背景的先进制造中心，是宁诺在制造工艺基础研究、高端装备研发应用、高层次专业技术人才培养、国际学术合作交流的重要基地之一。中心已培养博士/硕士研究生47名，与国内哈尔滨工业大学、上海交通大学、华中科技大学等多家高校有着紧密的科研合作，国际上也拥有一定的知名度。


而对于李灏楠而言，他作为一名老师，更让他欣慰的是，这几年科研教研相辅相成的成果。
他说，以前跟学生们讲课即便借用很多视频和图片来解析理论上的知识点，但总是很难具体理解，而如今借用科研教学，学生们就会用已学的知识去探索，实际操作之后，发现问题，再带着目的性的求知去学习，这或许才是科研带给教学最大的内驱力。

航空系大三学生杨皓中在这个暑假就有深刻的领悟，他说，平常在上课时理解抽象的理论知识是一堂课的关键，如果单凭想象其实是远远不够的，而科研实践给予了很多沉浸式的体验，大大提升了自己的能力。
当然，李灏楠坦言，高校科研项目落地产业化，科研教研相融合教学，这些问题都需要更长的时间去探索，希望能让更多的高校科研工作者增加科技成果转化的信心以及获得教学实践的有力支点。 


UNNC transfers research outcomes to innovative product
The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) recently received a large number of orders of the five-axis machine tools that are being designed in its Advanced Manufacturing Centre (AMC). It is the first commercial project of the Centre officially approved. 
The five-axis machine tool is one of the innovative products designed by AMC which is led by Dr Haonan Li, Associate Professor in Advanced and Intelligent Manufacturing. The new product has changed the clunky appearance of the former model, creating a lightweight, portable model that is 40 times smaller than the original. Dr Li’s design has so far received favourable attention from various domestic universities and research institutions.  
So how did such a state-of-the-art innovative product come to fruition? Dr Li smiled and jokingly said, "because we were lazy!" It turned out that the students working in the research team were doing experiments on the second floor, and the machine tools were on the first floor and too heavy to be moved. Every time they had to do experiments, they would have to alternate between the two floors. Thus, the idea of designing lightweight machine tools came into being. 
This idea also coincided with the University’s proposal that encourages the manufacturing center to develop its own personalised equipment. As a result, Dr Li led his team for more than a year in bringing the first generation of the machine tools into being. The iteration of the scientific equipment has been remarkably fast. The team continuously adjust the functions of the tools according to market feedback and sales have been gradually rising. The third generation of machine tools will begin production at the end of the year.
At present, the AMC with international academic background is one of the most important bases for UNNC’s research into the manufacturing process, as well as high-end equipment research and development application, high-level professional and technical personnel training, and international academic cooperation and exchange. The Centre has cultivated 47 PhD and Master students, and has cooperated closely with renowned domestic universities such as Harbin University of Technology, Shanghai Jiaotong University, and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. The Centre is also increasingly recognised on the international stage. 
As a teacher, Dr Li takes pride in seeing the mutual development of scientific research and teaching in recent years and how they have benefited each other. He said that lectures would previously rely on a lot of video and image content to explain theoretical knowledge, but it would still be difficult for students to understand the specific details. Nowadays, with the help of research backed teaching practices, students are able to use knowledge they’ve learned to reassess questions and explore problems from a different perspective. This is perhaps the biggest driving force to teaching practices that scientific research has brought about. 
Mr Haozhong Yang, a year three student, came to a profound realisation on this over the summer vacation, and commented that the scientific research practices help to fuel student’s imagination by creating an immersive experience which will in turn improve their abilities.  
Dr Li admitted that surrounding the industrialisation of scientific research projects in universities and the development of scientific research backed teaching, there are much more to be explored. He hopes that university researchers will become increasingly confident in the transformation of technological achievements and develop a strongpoint in teaching practices.

title: 理工生修炼手册 | 克服听力障碍，大四专业课第一：看建筑才女孙亦然如何逆流而上，收获成长
content:
9月底，一个名为“何以为城”的展览在宁波鄞州印象城开幕。本次展览以宁波千年港城、水文化为切入点，结合宁波诺丁汉大学，宁波城市记忆实验室团队开展的宁波历史与城市记忆的研究，以“何以为城”为主题展开系列探讨，从历史过去、当下城市和未来想象出发，共同探讨未来城市的想象之美。

此次展览的成功举办，离不开宁波诺丁汉大学建筑学毕业生的孙亦然的策划和参与。今天，我们将和大家分享这位建筑专业毕业生在宁波诺丁汉大学理工学院不平凡的成长故事。




2021年7月，孙亦然以一等荣誉学位，大四专业课成绩排名第一的优秀表现毕业。于此同时,她的毕业设计还被提名了英国皇家建筑师协会主席奖。本科毕业后，凭借她优秀的学术表现和设计作品集，同时收到了伦敦大学学院和伦敦政治经济学院的录取通知书。但是，亦然并不急着开启她的下一段学习之旅，建筑设计专业来说，行业实践经验是非常重要的。因此，亦然在完成宁诺宁波城市记忆实验室的“何以为城”展览策划和执行工作之后，她将赴上海维迈科建集团，开始实习建筑师的工作。


2016年初入校时,全英文教学给患有轻度听力残疾的孙亦然带来巨大的挑战，且因身体，心态，能力等因素，她在大一时挂科并又重修了一年。亦然说：“那年的自我接受与调整离不开学校与老师的体贴关怀，例如宁诺Disability Support部门为有听力障碍的同学配备了助听耳麦以帮助学生更好的适应生活。” 

在上课的时候，建筑学的每位个授课老师都会带上特质的话筒，亦然的接收器中就会传来老师授课的清晰声音。在考试期间，学校也安排单独的听力考场，根据孙亦然的实际情况调整了考试节奏。除此之外，来自personal tutor（个人导师）与学院各个老师的关怀让孙亦然意识到自己其实并不是孤独的一个人。


从理工楼302到能源楼一楼的建筑设计工作室，亦然开始了自己的建筑专业学习之旅。在设计工作室奋斗的昼夜，在焦虑与迷茫的时光里，师长朋友的帮助与鼓励是孙亦然前行的源动力。回顾这段经历，亦然说多亏了学校，老师和同学们的关怀和帮助，才支持让她走过所有的不顺利，取得了今天的成绩。
来自多元文化背景的国际化师资，也为亦然带来了许多灵感。来自日本木匠世家的筱原宽之老师教会了孙亦然苛求完美、精益求精的匠人精神；在与Yat Ming Loo副教授交流的过程中，亦然对城市文化有了初步的了解，并完成了自己毕设的核心构思；作为孙亦然的personal tutor -- 建筑与建筑环境系系主任Ali Cheshmehzangi教授在课堂内外给了众多指点。

孙亦然说：“每一次tutorial都是一次得到反馈与帮助的机会，如何在与老师的沟通中利用tutorial改进自己的项目是建筑系学生必修的功课。” 除了老师帮助，室友与朋友的关怀也给了孙亦然源源不断的能量，每一次小组作业的观点争论、每一次评图前的挣扎、每一次deadline结束后的欣喜，良师益友们与亦然同行。三年studio的日夜就这样一晃而过，亦然凭借着自己的努力，完成了从吊车尾到年级第一的逆袭。

特别值得一提的是，亦然在大四上学期加入了宁诺宁波城市记忆实验室，在Yat Ming Loo副教授与几位博士生前辈的带领下，亦然参与了数次实验室的城市行走--学者研讨与策展活动，并且，为了能够将学生们的创作呈现出来，亦然特地在结束学业后依旧留在学校两个月，参与“何以为城”展览的策划与设计。
“宁诺宁波城市记忆实验室最大的特别之处是，老师鼓励我们把学习的范围从教室和studio扩展到了我们的日常的生活以及生活的城市，”亦然强调说，“我在城市行走与展览的参与中，加深了对建筑的理解和城市发展进程的认识。” 同时，亦然也鼓励大家不只是从课堂中学习，作为一名建筑专业的同学，课堂外对生活的关注与对城市的探索也同样重要。

亦然认为 “建筑不是一栋独立的建筑，更需要考虑所在地的历史、风土人情，人文与周围环境进行设计。”因此，亦然在毕业时申请了伦敦大学学院的城市研究专业，期待从城市的角度下继续学习建筑。

给学弟学妹的一些建议
亦然期望自己的经历能给迷茫或生活中不顺的朋友一些启发与鼓励，生活总有困难，希望大家能勇敢坚定的走下去。

Architecture graduate talked about her learning experience with the hearing impairment
Yiran Sun, a top graduate from Architecture programme this year, also one of the curator of the exhibition titled “What makes a city”, recently is going to start her journey as a professional architect in Shanghai.
 
Yiran graduated with the First Class degree in the July 2021 and she has been nominated for RIBA President’s Medal with her final year design project. She received offers from her dream schools University of College London and London School of Economics and Political Science.
 
With such excellent academic performance, surprisingly Yiran said, she had been experienced a dark period for almost a year. She was born with hearing impairments. When she entered the University of Nottingham Ningbo China and started the university learning in full English environment, it was a huge challenge for her—she was barely able to hear the lectures clearly and the speech of her classmates, even when in the small-sized workshop.
 
Obviously, she could not follow up the teaching progress and in the end of the first year, she decided to retake. Yiran at that time was very depressed until one day, she unintentionally knew that the university’s ‘Accessibility’ support to the students in need. Very quickly, she received a device to facilitate her study.
 
Before the start of each lecture or seminar, Yiran would pass the tailored microphone to the lecturer. The sound would be amplified through the radio signals. “The device made everything so clear and finally I could make a way to study the Architecture”, Yiran exclaimed.
 
More importantly, the caring from her personal tutor and other tutors made Yiran realise that she was not alone.
 
As an Architecture student, Yiran had spent much time learning in the design studio and she appreciated every seminar and enjoyed talking with academic staff from different cultural background. She learnt from Dr Hiroyuki Shinohara (previously working in the department as architecture course director) for the craftsman's spirit of getting perfect. She was also inspired by Dr Yat-Ming Loo, a Chinese Malaysian Architect and urban scholars for her final year design project and the study of urban memory. She would also like to extend her gratitude to Professor Ali Cheshmehzangi for sharing his career path and giving her advices as personal tutor.
 
Yiran was keen to seeking feedbacks from academic staff and she was also very willing to discuss the design idea with both students and staff. She also gained her understanding of the architecture.
 
"Architecture is not only about an independent building, but also needs to consider the history, culture and surrounding environment of the site to design. Therefore, I have also applied for the major of Urban Studies at University College London, expecting to continue my study of architecture from the perspective of cities. "
 
From October 2021, Yiran is going to officially work as an intern architect in Xframe Studio in Shanghai. Yiran sincerely hope that her experience could encourage more people to bravely face the challenges and walk through the dark side of the life.

title: 新楼新设施新服务！盘点宁诺校园新学期大变化
content:
新学期，万物于始。
眼尖的UNNCer应该已经注意到啦，
宁诺校园西南角的特创区
立起了一座高端大气的大楼。
没错，这就是备受期待的
宁波诺丁汉大学国际创新创业大楼！

为了给宁诺师生提供
更好的学习和生活体验，
每年暑假，
校园里都会有不同程度的变化。
这座拔地而起的新楼，
可以说是献给新学期的巨型礼物了。

那么，
新地标的里里外外是什么样的？
除了新楼，
校园里还有哪些设施和服务
进行了升级翻新？
请大家跟随我们的镜头，
一一打卡吧！

Some sharp-eyed UNNC students may have noticed the recent opening of the new and impressive building on campus after finishing construction over the summer vacation – The Innovation and Enterprise Building!
This is one of the series changes to occur on campus over the summer vacation in order to create a better study and work environment for both students and staff at UNNC. So, what does the new building look like? Have any other facilities and services been upgraded and refurbished on campus? Let’s check it out.

宁诺国际创新创业大楼
宁诺国际创新创业大楼的设计以鲨鱼的鳃裂为灵感，整体是一道优美的弧线，未来感十足。
The futuristic design of the Innovation and Enterprise Building (IEB) contains a beautiful arc with its exterior inspired to bear resemblance to the gill slits of a shark.

垂直绿化相结合

铝板、玻璃幕墙、

建筑立面：

Building design: aluminium plate, glass curtain wall, vertical greening


大楼与周围绿化景观完美融合，塑造了一个采光、通风、节能、水循环、屋顶绿化可持续发展的绿色生态多元化建筑。值得一提的是，大楼还获得了绿色建筑三星级设计评价标识。
IEB blends in perfectly with the surrounding natural landscape, creating an ecologically diverse environment with lighting, ventilation, energy conservation, water recycling and green roof technology. It is noteworthy that the building has obtained a Three-Stars certification of Green Building Evaluation Label. 


楼内功能涵盖商务接待、办公管理、会议培训、公共交流、轻餐饮等，功能的多元化为整座大楼营造出开放、包容、灵动的空间氛围。

The building includes spaces for business reception, routine operation, conferences, training, catering and so on. The diverse functions make an open, inclusive and flexible atmosphere for the building. 


TB&PB
为了提升师生的教学体验，已经为大家服务了15年之久的TB&PB教学楼在暑期进行了第一阶段的改造。

学校在两幢教学楼的中庭增加了空调的覆盖。PB采光顶更换为了更加节能环保的Low-E玻璃，同时安装了全自动侧窗，既实现了在不同气温下的通风调节，更加节能环保，同时还提升了安全防火性能。此外，两座教学楼新增了9间教室，更好地满足师生的教学、自习需求。

据悉，TB&PB教学楼未来还将进行一系列升级改造。
The University has added the air-conditioning systems to the courtyards of the Teaching Building (TB) and the Portland Building (PB); the roofing in PB has also been replaced with energy-efficient and environmentally friendly Low-E glass along with fully automatic side windows.
The two teaching buildings have also added 9 classrooms to better serve the teaching and self-study needs of staff and students on campus. 
These efforts are among the series of renovation work of the teaching buildings, aiming to improve the teaching and learning experience for both staff and students. 
TB&PB


体育馆
体育馆内的羽毛球馆、乒乓球馆和篮球馆新增了专业空调设备，全校师生的体育活动将有更加舒适的体验。
High-end air-conditioning equipment has been installed into the badminton, table tennis and basketball halls in the Sports Centre. Staff and students will now be able to have a more comfortable experience while working out on campus.


医务室和身心健康指导办公室
为更好、更方便地为学生服务，学校医务室和身心健康指导办公室搬至宿舍区23号楼，两者都以全新的面貌迎接大家。
University Clinic and Counselling Service have both been revamped and relocated to Building 23.


中国银行宁波诺丁汉大学支行
中国银行宁波诺丁汉大学支行在新学期开始营业，该支行结合宁诺与国际接轨的定位，为在校师生提供一站式、全方位、国际化的金融服务。师生办理和咨询业务，尤其是大家关注较多的购汇、跨境汇款等业务，将更加高效、方便。
今年6月，宁诺与中国银行宁波市分行签署战略合作协议，双方就智慧校园建设开展全面合作，本次正是智慧校园全面服务的第一步。


The Bank of China UNNC Sub-branch has opened for business and will provide all-round one-stop international financial services for staff and students on campus. Consulting services will also be provided, with particular attention paid to increasing the efficiency of foreign exchange and cross-border remittance services.
In June, UNNC has signed an agreement with Bank of China to roll out in-depth to establish a “Smart Campus”. The opening of sub-branch is the first step of the cooperation.
