title: 重磅预告丨诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院系列讲堂正式开课啦！
content:
Please scroll down for the English Version--
Nottingham Ningbo China Beacons of Excellence Lecture Series
宁波诺丁汉大学在过去的十六年成长中，逐步形成了特有和鲜明的国际化办学特色，取得了阶段性发展成绩。2018年，宁波诺丁汉大学正式开启以“卓越学术、精彩未来”为愿景，科研与教学并重的科研2.0版发展战略，已经启动并投入建设的诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院就是承载这一战略的重要平台。
诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院将围绕智能制造、绿色化学与能源、生命健康三大重点科研领域进行布局，汇聚全球科技创新资源，建立集创新研究、成果转化、技术转移、人才培养于一体的国际化科技创新综合平台。
诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院系列讲堂（以下简称“卓越灯塔“系列讲堂）旨在分享宁波诺丁汉大学在智能制造、绿色化学与能源、生命健康三大重点领域的科研成果，传播科学家精神，交流科研创新和知识转化的经验，培育下一代年轻科学家和工程师，为地方经济发展注入新的活力。
首期卓越灯塔系列讲堂将邀请马丁·波利亚科夫教授线上开讲，为大家带来题为《绿色化学前沿》的公开讲座。
20多年来，诺丁汉大学一直处于发展绿色和可持续化学的前沿。本次讲座将介绍诺丁汉在绿色化学方面的研究成果，展现我们是如何与工业界合作开发更清洁的工艺技术。讲座也将通过诺丁汉独一无二的碳中和实验室，向大家直观呈现可持续绿色化学是如何实现的。
Professor Sir Martyn Poliakoff CBE CChem FRS FREng HonFRSC FIChemE
英国皇家学会、皇家工程院两院院士
英国诺丁汉大学教授
大英帝国爵士
-
01
-
马丁.波利亚科夫教授，大英帝国爵士，是英国诺丁汉大学化学系教授。自1979年加入英国诺丁汉大学以来，深耕绿色化学领域，是全球绿色化学研究的领军人物之一。2011-2016年间，他担任英国皇家学会（英国科学院）副主席兼管对外事务。他还是英国皇家工程院院士。早在1998年，波利亚科夫教授应邀参加了中国首届绿色化学大会，并在会上带来了精彩的发言。除了担任中国化学学会荣誉会员以外，他在去年还获得了2019年中华人民共和国国际科学技术合作奖。
这位集众多高大上头衔于一身的波利亚科夫教授还是个知名“国际网红”，人称“爱因斯坦”教授（因爱因斯坦式的爆炸头形象深入人心）。他在全球最大的视频网站YouTube设立了个人频道---“Periodic videos”，拥有超过百万的粉丝。Martyn和他的团队通过制作化学元素视频，用风趣幽默的方式向网友们介绍并宣传一些有趣的化学知识，以此来推广和科普化学知识。

2020年11月13日晚上7点，让我们一起相约，对话绿色化学精英，听大佬分享他的科研故事。
接下来，我们也会给大家带来更多的精彩演讲，敬请期待！


//关于诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划//


“卓越灯塔”计划，是英国诺丁汉大学于2017年6月启动的一个重大项目，旨在集合诺丁汉大学的科研“优势兵力”，探索全球面临的关键问题并找出解决方案。
2019 年 5 月，宁波市人民政府与英国诺丁汉大学签订战略合作框架协议共建诺丁汉大学卓越灯塔计划（宁波）创新研究院。创新研究院围绕智能制造、绿色化学与能源、基于大数据的生命健康三大重点领域，大力引进英国诺丁汉大学 “卓越灯塔”计划重要国际科技创新与人才资源，发挥宁波诺丁汉大学立足宁波、面向国际的优势，按照“科技创新、人才培养、成果转化、产业发展”四位一体的合作模式，打造国内领先、国际一流的科技创新平台，为宁波“246”产业集群构建提供强大且持久的科技支撑，为健康生活、智慧便捷、绿色低碳的社会提供前瞻性的产业化技术。


Lecture series of Nottingham Ningbo China Beacons of Excellence Research and Innovation Institute
The Nottingham Ningbo China Beacons of Excellence Research and Innovation Institute is a comprehensive platform that integrates global scientific innovation resources, in order to achieve innovative research, knowledge transfer and talent cultivation.

The Institute primarily addresses three prominent issues – Smart Manufacturing, Green Chemicals and Energy, Life Science and Health Care, all of which are closely connected with local development goals.

Each of the three areas will have a dedicated research centre hosting leading scholars and researchers. New academic staff will be recruited from all over the world to work in the institute.

The Institute launches lecture series to share the latest research outcomes from these three key research areas in the University of Nottingham, bridge the young and senior scientist for better communication and exchange and also help to promote the science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) among the public.

The first session we invited Professor Sir Martyn Poliakoff to give a public lecture named “Frontiers of Green Chemistry” next Friday 13th November 2020.

The University of Nottingham has been at the forefront on Green and Sustainable Chemistry for over 20 years. This talk will introduce some research in Green Chemistry at our University, will explain how we have worked with industry to develop cleaner processes and will describe our unique Carbon Neutral Laboratories showing how chemistry can be carried out in a more sustainable way.

Sir Martyn Poliakoff is Research Professor of Chemistry at University of Nottingham UK where he has worked since 1979. He is one of the pioneers of Green Chemistry.  From 2011-16, he was Vice-President and Foreign Secretary of the Royal Society (the UK Academy of Sciences).  He is also a Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering.  Sir Martyn was a speaker at the first Chinese Conference on Green Chemistry in Hefei in 1998. He is an Honorary Fellow of the Chinese Chemical Society, and Winner of the 2019 International Science and Technology Cooperation Award of the People’s Republic of China.

title: 中外合作大学独家！宁诺同时拥有国家级一流本科课程和专业
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC awarded National Level First-Class Modules.

宁波诺丁汉大学“项目设计”、“营销管理学”两门课程成功入选首批国家级一流本科课程！昨天，随着教育部网站相关认定结果公示结束，宁诺理工学院和商学院的两门课程作为全国仅有的全英文课程跻身国家级一流本科课程榜单。

加上此前学校财务管理专业被评为国家级一流本科专业建设点（详情请点击：国家级！宁诺财务管理专业入选国家级一流本科专业建设点），宁诺已成为唯一一所同时拥有国家级一流本科课程和一流本科专业建设点的中外合作大学。
项目设计：
三校协同开发，中英双重质控

项目设计是化学工程与工艺、环境工程两个专业的大四必修课，由英国诺丁汉大学、宁波诺丁汉大学和马来西亚诺丁汉大学协同开展，在三校同时教授。三校课程负责人在教学过程中共同探讨课程改进方向与方法，并结合学生反馈、企业建议及行业工程师协会的要求，每年对课程内容设计、教授方式与成绩评定等方面进行综合评估与完善。

宁诺项目设计课程的教学准备、实施以及评估工作不仅严格遵循《大学质量手册》，还要符合英国教育质量监管局所制定的《高等教育质量规范》。在教学内容设计与发展方面，始终与行业工程师协会保持紧密联系，以行业动态引领教学内容。


课程以小班化教学、合作式学习为特点，通过一系列设计任务引导学生自主学习，并将所学知识进行创新性的应用，同时注重学生安全与环境可持续意识的培养。设计任务以小组合作的形式开展，培养学生团队协作、自主探索、综合考量与决策的能力。为强化学生的实践能力与经验，课程教学团队聘请了国内外业界专家，到学校举办不同主题的研讨会，让学生深入了解业界的最新工艺发展动态与安全生产管理制度。


这是一门综合性的课程，要求我们运用本科前三年学的所有东西，完成一整套工程设计流程，从而达到既定的经济、环境、产能等目标，对我们个人能力和团队协作的要求都很高。课程很具挑战性，但老师也会给予及时、充分的指导，启发我们一步步提升自己的设计。”
今年本科毕业、正在宁诺直博的吴心赟说。

课程由不同领域的专家学者联合授课，包括理工学院院长吴韬教授。课程负责人Philip Hall博士有25年的企业工作经验，10多年教学经验，教授过化学与环境系大部分现有课程，并从2015年起担任本课程的负责人。作为系主任，Philip Hall博士还负责制定学系的发展策略。

课程的师资队伍中还有两位在工业界拥有丰富工作经验的资深工程师——来自格利资公司大中华区的风险主管Jane Briggs女士以及在空气化工产品公司担任首席工程师的林蕾女士，她们为学生带来行业的最新动态以及职业发展分享。


营销管理学：
校企资源深度对接，
国内外商赛助力能力升级

此次入选国家级一流本科课程的另一门课程——营销管理学主要面向国际商务管理、国际商务与国际传播学、国际商务与语言、国际商务经济学的大三学生。

营销管理学课程开设已有13年，每年向本校及来自U21联盟的全球20多个国家和地区的交换生授课，是宁诺的重点课程之一。


课程强调学生能力培养，在真实的商业环境中迁移理论知识，引导学生将营销与其他领域知识相融合，提高跨学科解决实际问题的能力，培养创新型、复合型和应用型人才。教学过程中，教师以情境为载体、强调互动，鼓励学生通过分组讨论、辩论、角色扮演等形式深入实际案例，加深对知识的理解和技能的掌握。

课程积极开展校企合作，邀请国内外知名品牌的企业高管走进课堂，并通过与政府、企业的合作，让学生能够走进实地进行调研。课程与欧莱雅集团、索菲特集团、中国银行等行业领军企业合作，通过商业案例分析比赛等方式为学生创造实习和就业机会，提高学生的就业能力。同时，课程还实现了与诺丁汉卓越奖的深度合作，每年输送100多名优秀选手参加如欧莱雅品牌风暴大赛等国内外各大商赛。

课程的授课团队阵容强大，成员来自不同的国家和地区。商学院院长Martin Lockett教授曾在剑桥、牛津等一流学府长期任教，有着丰富的教学经验；课程负责人刘任远教授为商学院副院长身兼浙江省品牌学院院长，有15年任教经验，在市场营销学与创新学领域国际顶级期刊发表了多篇文章；系主任Balaji Makam教授提倡“互联网+教育”，他的新技术应用能力帮助团队进一步提高了教学效率。

“这学期的营销管理学由几名老师教授不同的模块，比如现在给我们上课的刘任远教授，他的企业经验非常丰富，会在课堂上结合以前工作的真实经历。他选择的案例紧跟热点、贴合现实，讲课风格也风趣幽默，课上经常是笑声一片。”国际商务管理专业学生季欣怡说。

UNNC awarded National Level First-Class Modules
 
6 November: Two UNNC undergraduate modules, Design Project and Marketing Management have been recognised by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China as the first batch of National Level First Class Undergraduate Modules.
 
Following the Finance, Accounting and Management BSc (Hons) awarded National Level First Class Courses last year, UNNC becomes the first and only Sino-foreign University to have both the national first-level course and modules.
 
Design Project is a compulsory module for Chemical Engineering and Environmental Engineering students. The curriculum was designed and developed jointly by UNNC, the University of Nottingham UK and the Malaysia campus, following the University’s Quality Manual and the regulations of the UK’s Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education. 
 
The module practices student autonomy, innovation, and teamwork, and enhances student awareness of safety and environmental sustainability. Moreover, for students to have a better understanding of the industry, the module often invites industry experts to lectures to address the latest developments. 
 
This course is taught by experts with diverse specialities, including Professor Tao Wu, Dean of the Faculty of Science and  Engineering, and Dr Philip Hall, Head of the department who has about 25 years’ industrial experience, as well as professional experts like Linda Lin and Jane Briggs, both holding senior positions in multi-national companies and having abundant practical experience here in China and abroad. 

“This keeps students up to date with information about the process technology development and safety practice currently taking place in the industry,” said Dr Hall.
 
Xinyun Wu, a UNNC graduate, said: “It’s a challenging module and requires us to complete an entire set of engineering design procedure to achieve certain economic, environmental and productivity goals. With thorough and in-time instructions from teaching staff, we can improve our designs step by step.”
 
The other module, Marketing Management, is a key module of UNNC and has been offered to domestic students and exchange students from U21 universities for 13 years. It helps students to apply theories to real business situations and to solve practical interdisciplinary problems. 
 
By introducing interactive teaching methods in class and cooperating with the government and leading enterprises such as L'Oréal, Sofitel Hotel, Bank of China, the module enhances students’ understanding through case analysis and improves student employability. Every year, more than 100 UNNC students participate in major business competitions such as the L'Oréal Brandstorm. 
 
The members of the teaching team are experienced scholars from different countries and regions. Professor Martin Lockett, Dean of the Nottingham University Business School China, has taught at Cambridge and Oxford University. Professor Martin J. Liu has published many articles in world-leading journals in the field of marketing and innovation and is also the Executive Dean of Zhejiang Provincial Branding Academy. Dr Balaji Makam, the Head of Department for Marketing and Management Systems, advocates "Internet+ Education” and brings the latest technologies into class. 
 
"Professor Liu often integrates his work experience into up-to-date case analysis and often makes the class filled with laughter”, said Xinyi Ji, a student of International Business Management.

title: 讲故事、谈学习、论人生 | 中国工程院院士杜祥琬与宁诺学子分享科学家精神
content:
2020年10月28日，“科创中国”院士鄞州行杜祥琬院士主题报告在宁波诺丁汉大学顺利展开。本次活动由宁波中物激光与光电技术研究所主办，得到宁波市科协和鄞州区科协的大力支持。宁波市科协副主席汤丹剑出席活动，鄞州区科协以及相关企业嘉宾共同出席。
宁波诺丁汉大学党委副书记、副校长沈伟其教授代表学校首先对杜祥琬院士及夫人毛剑琴教授一行表示热烈欢迎。随后沈校长向各位嘉宾介绍了本次“科创中国”院士鄞州行活动背景和意义，以及宁波诺丁汉大学的办学历史、学校概况和发展愿景。

宁波诺丁汉大学在过去的十六年时间中，凭借独特的优势，整合海内外优质教学与科研资源，在培养优秀人才、推动科研发展，助力地方升级等方面做出的突出贡献。
沈伟其副校长致辞
此次杜院士的报告以“讲故事、谈学习、论人生”为题。杜院士以资深科学家的科研经历，个人丰富的阅历和老一辈科学家们的生动事例，深入浅出地做了一场精彩报告，对在场的青年学子未来事业和人生道路的选择有所启迪。

杜祥琬院士做主题报告
杜院士回答同学提问


在主题报告后，宁波诺丁汉大学博士在读研究生仲家慧和我们分享了她的感想，她表示，自己目前跟随Vladimir Brusic教授从事免疫计算学领域的研究，虽然和杜院士的研究领域不同，但是聆听了杜院士的报告受益匪浅。

“杜院士从两弹一星、核物理的老一辈科学家们的‘老’故事出发，循循善诱，引领我们进入科研者的精神世界，启发了我们宁诺学子对于求学意义，人生价值的深刻理解。杜院士的话语如涓涓细流，缓缓但深刻的印在了我们的心里。”

杜祥琬院士简介
杜祥琬教授于1997年当选为中国工程院院士，2002年当选中国工程院副院长，2006年当选为俄罗斯国家工程科学院外籍院士。是中国科协荣委，空军首席院士顾问。曾主持我国核试验诊断理论和核武器中子学的精确化研究; 曾任国家863计划激光专家组首席科学家，是我国新型强激光研究的开创者之一，他还担任国家能源专家咨员会副主任和国家气候变化专家委员会主任，主持并参与了中国能源发展战略和应对气候变化的咨询研究工作。
On 28th October, as part of “Innovation China” Academician’s Yinzhou trip, a talk by Academician Du Xiangwan was successfully held at University of Nottingham Ningbo China. This event was organized by Ningbo Zhongwu Laser and Photoelectricity Technology Institution and supported by Ningbo Association for Science and Technology. Representatives from the government and industries attended this event.

Prof Weiqi Shen, Deputy Party Secretary and Vice Provost of UNNC hosted the talk and gave a brief introduction of UNNC.

The topic of Academician Du's report was “Stories, Learning and Life”, his wonderful report brought life enlightenment and thinking to the audience. Academician Du’s talk is based on his research experience as a senior scientist, his rich personal experience and vivid examples from the older generation of scientists. His talk inspired the young students presented. Academician Du also urged the undergraduate students to stick to your aim, choose a direction they are interested in and devote themselves to it.

Jiahui Zhong, a year 3 PhD students, shared some thoughts with us. She said that she is engaged in the research on immunocomputing with Professor Vladimir Brusic. Although it is different from Academician Du's field, she has benefited a lot from Academician Du's talk. She said: “Academician Du started with the stories of older generations of scientists in nuclear physics, he guided us into the spiritual world of the scientific researchers and inspired us to have a profound understanding of the significance of learning and the value of life. He’s words like a trickle, slowly but deeply impressed in each of our hearts.”

Introduction of Academician Du Xiangwan:
Du Xiangwan was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 1997, Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 2002, and foreign member of the Russian National Academy of Engineering in 2006. He is the Honorary Committee of China Association for Science and Technology and the chief academician consultant of the Air Force. He has been in charge of the research on the diagnostic theory of nuclear tests and the precise nucleology of nuclear weapons in China. He was once the chief scientist of the laser expert group of the National 863 Plan, and one of the pioneers of the new strong laser research in China. He also served as the Deputy Director of the National Energy Expert Advisory Council and the Director of the National Climate Change Expert Committee, moreover, he has been presided over and participated in the advisory and research work on China's energy development strategy and climate change response.

title: 开学一个月，宁诺跟我想象中不太一样……
陈烜祺：文武双全的热血宁诺少年
content:
Please scroll down for the English version -
UNNC graduate embraces multiculturalism.

陈烜祺是今年宁波诺丁汉计算机科学系的应届毕业生。本月底，他将正式入职华为，成为一名网络技术工程师。

采访他的时候，画风有些清奇。“老师，不如您采访我们专业去了卡耐基梅隆大学的大牛吧”，“老师，不止我一个去了华为，还有去了字节跳动的同学”。拥有超多牛人好友的陈烜祺，形容自己是甘当绿叶般的存在，特别平凡——“我成绩不算拔尖，没有获得过高额奖学金。”

那么听上去“平平无奇”的陈烜祺究竟是如何在就业市场顺利突围的呢？
文理兼修
陈烜祺说，进入华为的过程颇具戏剧性。今年三月，正在两手准备留学与就业的他收到华为人事部的短信，才想起来一年前投过一份暑期实习的简历，原以为石沉大海没想到还有转机。

第一轮面试时，考官问了他一些关于网络和岗位相关的技术问题，陈烜祺觉得难度不是很高，与正常考试差不多。不过，除了专业对口的问题，面试官还从“怎么看待英国脱欧”、“脱欧会对英国社会带来什么样的影响”等角度对他进行考察。

最后一轮面试中，面试官刚好从印度出差回来，而陈烜祺恰好曾跟着学生组织AIESEC的项目组去印度支教过一段时间。“我当时是利用暑假的时间去到印度的一个特殊教育学校支教，主要教授他们数学。这段经历让我切身感受到教育资源的稀缺，也近距离地观察了印度社会的贫富差距，形成了一些自己的思考。”面试过程中，他把自己对中印关系和印度发展的思考与面试官进行了分享和交流。两人谈得颇为愉快。


陈烜祺说，虽然学的是计算机，未来很可能会成为一名“码农”，但他从高中开始就对人文学科有浓厚的兴趣，曾自学完微观和宏观经济学，也非常关注国际关系与国际政治。“我觉得人不应该简单地按照专业划分为理科、文科、商科，人才的发展应该是复合型的。学习知识主要是为了解决问题或者达成某个目标，不会像考试、或者在校园里那么理想化。”

或许是这份文理兼修的气质，让陈烜祺从众多竞争者中脱颖而出，赢得了面试官的青睐。
运动达人
能够顺利进入华为，陈烜祺调侃自己还有一个重要的加分项——体魄强健。

他记得，刚刚进入大学的时候，在运动馆看到攀岩墙在装修，觉得十分不寻常。“这是在我们小城市没有见过的。第一次攀岩，还是前任执行校长为我做保护。”2016年，他又与校友共同完成了杭州马拉松项目。


今年，当疫情在全球多点暴发时，他第一时间报名了学联的志愿者，一个人肩扛手提，送货上门，给留在英国诺丁汉大学的同学们送去了健康包。
无论做什么工作，对体力、激情都会有比较高的要求。可能是面试官看我长得比较壮，加上看我一直参与攀岩和马拉松这些运动，觉得我是一个比较有激情的年轻人吧。”
乐于助人
拥有超好人缘的陈烜祺，其实在很多同学眼中也是一个很牛的人物。一位攀岩社的同学开玩笑：“我是看他的朋友圈学习经济学和时事政治的。” 据说大家有数码产品购买方面的问题，也都会请教他，因为他会非常认真地分析并给出最优选项。他还参与了三届湖南省招生宣讲，分享给学弟学妹第一手的经验。


按照计划，他会在加入华为后进行为期六个月左右的培训，之后或被派往海外分公司工作。“接受多元文化、具备包容力、尽力帮助别人是在学校潜移默化感受和学习到的，我想，这也是华为对员工的基本要求吧。”


离开大学，步入新的征程，陈烜祺谦虚地总结，
我觉得我是一个不那么出众，不那么夺目的平凡学生，但是我在大学度过了比较快乐和幸福的时光，做了一些公益，学到了很多东西，也帮助了一些人，做一些举手之劳的事情。


UNNC graduate embraces multiculturalism 

Xuanqi Chen is a UNNC graduate of Computer Science. Although self-described as “ordinary”, he succeeded in receiving an offer of employment from Huawei despite fierce competition and will begin his work soon. 

While recalling the process of obtaining the offer, Xuanqi said that the interview questions were much more holistic than a college examination. 

In addition to the professional field, the interviewers also asked him about his view on Brexit and how Brexit may affect British society. In the final round of interview, the interviewer had just returned from a business trip in India. Xuanqi has read widely in economics, finance and other fields, and had also previously held a volunteer post in India. Therefore, he impressed the interviewers with his own independent thinking based on his personal experience. 

“I think the development of talent should be interdisciplinary. Learning is problem-solving oriented and not limited to one’s field of major,” said Xuanqi. To him, there are many ways to obtain pure knowledge, and the most important thing in college life is to actually have a broad range of experiences. 

In his daily life, Xuanqi is a sincere and enthusiastic person. This January, noticing the signal of the pandemic, Xuanqi bought a number of masks and sent these masks to his hometown in Hunan Province through a charity organisation. Later he signed up as a volunteer of the Student Union to distribute the health kits to the students in the University of Nottingham. On many occasions, he has shown that he is a warm-hearted advice provider for friends and shares his experience with for prospective UNNC students. He is also active in sports and was the founder of the rock climbing club during his first year at UNNC. 

Xuanqi, who has already graduated this summer, still remembers when he was new at UNNC. He was surprised to find that the instructor of his first climbing session on campus was the Provost at that time. This experience gave him a taste of the multicultural environment which makes UNNC different from other universities. 

Xuanqi is likely to be assigned to an overseas branch of Huawei after six months’ training as planned. “To me, multiculturalism and inclusiveness are precious and subtle learnings from the experience during my undergraduate study. These may also be the basic requirements of international enterprise,” he said. “I do not think I am outstanding or dazzling, but I spent a happy time in the University, did something for public welfare, and learned a lot.”

title: 宁诺学子作为核心研发成员，让新冠检测试剂盒在发展中国家大范围使用
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - UNNC alumnus contributes to COVID-19 test development.

30分钟即可判断被检测者是否感染新冠病毒，并且无需配备专业实验室在社区即可推广应用。这是宁波诺丁汉大学毕业生虞烨炯所在团队的最新研究成果。近日他们还获得了英国皇家工程院院士特别贡献奖，团队研发的首款检测试剂盒也已经获得CE认证并上市销售。
虞烨炯

这个由牛津大学高等研究院 （苏州）院长、英国皇家工程院院士崔占峰教授和首席科学家黄巍教授领衔的团队，开发出了一种新冠病毒快速检测法。使用者只需要将鼻咽拭子或唾液样本放入检测管中并进行样本灭活和核酸检测，30分钟后即可通过简单的颜色变化读取结果。

虞烨炯从宁诺环境工程专业2012级毕业后，进入到牛津大学工程科学系全奖攻读博士，正是师从英国皇家工程院院士崔占峰教授。今年疫情暴发后，他就和团队一起着手开发新冠病毒快速检测法，主要负责蛋白及疫苗的常温储存及运输研究。

据他介绍，目前市面上大部分的蛋白和疫苗的运输都需要低温冷链来保持活性，因此，疫苗运输的设备要求高，花费昂贵。发展中国家，特别是在非洲、东南亚这样的高温热带地区，很难提供标准的冷链运输，许多生物产品在使用前就已经失去了活性。这样一来，对于人力和物力都造成了巨大的浪费，人们的健康安全也失去了保障。

而他的博士研究课题就是找到一种常温甚至较高温情况下保存生物制品的方式。在新冠病毒检测试剂盒的研发中，虞烨炯尝试将液态试剂干燥成固态的粉状试剂，保持活性的同时，也降低了运输的门槛，使得检测试剂盒在发展中国家可以大范围使用。

目前，该检测试剂盒已通过临床样本验证。首款产品由一家社会企业Oxsed Limited开发，已获得CE认证并上市销售。
虞烨炯则作为研发团队的核心成员，以技术顾问的身份，加入到该公司之中，把控检测试剂盒的开发与生产过程。

“大批量生产对于反应环节需要更严格的把控”，他坦言，自己没有在一线工作过，但对工厂的工业生产与流程设计非常熟悉，因此也可以“无缝对接“技术顾问这个新的身份。

“这离不开在宁诺打下的坚实的基础。宁诺开展的实验课及工程周让学生将学习的知识运用到实际应用中，并开发了主动学习及探索的能力。”他说，正是这些活动，让他找到自己的兴趣所在，并确定了攻读博士的想法。暑假期间，他还通过参加科研课题来提高自己的科研能力。“这些实践和科研经历，让我在申请直博的时候，顺利地通过了面试并转去生物医药方向。”

今年，虞烨炯即将完成自己的博士论文，他希望，自己可以继续在科研上深耕，也为人类的知识海洋增加点滴泉水。对于宁诺的学弟学妹们，他也表示，追随大流并不适合每一个学生，选择自己喜欢的专业，并且为之付出努力，一切都是值得的。

虞烨炯及其他宁诺学子在牛津
与理工学院院长吴韬教授合影

UNNC alumnus contributes to COVID-19 test development   
 
UNNC alumnus Yejiong Yu is a member of the Oxford rapid viral RNA test team, which was recently awarded the Royal Academy of Engineering's President's Special Awards for Pandemic Service for exceptional achievements in the fight against COVID-19. 

The team is led by Professor Zhanfeng Cui FREng and Professor Wei Huang of the Oxford Suzhou Centre for Advanced Research (OSCAR). Yejiong Yu is a graduate of Environmental Engineering. After graduating from UNNC in 2016, Yejiong chose to embark on his research career as a PhD candidate in the Institute of Biomedical Engineering, University of Oxford and studied under the guidance of Professor Cui. 

At the early stages of the pandemic, Yejiong and his research team members began working on a speedy test to identify carriers of COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2). Because Yejiong’s doctoral research has focused on storing and transporting biological products at room temperature or even higher, within a short period, they developed a test kit that can be stored and supplied without being refrigerated, and can provide a result within 30 minutes. 

This means the test kit is more economical and readily deployable in quantity and could be used with huge benefits in developing countries and even in communities in the developed world.  

The first product, Oxsed RaViD Direct, has received CE certification and is now commercially available. Yejiong was also invited to serve as a technical consultant to the manufacturer and participate in rolling out the product to meet the massive need around the globe.  

When speaking of his undergraduate study, Yejiong recalled that he appreciated the experience of applying knowledge to solve practical problems through various activities like Engineering Week and practical lab sessions.  

“The study experience at UNNC equipped me with cutting-edge knowledge as well as transferable skills,” he said. “More importantly, I had numerous opportunities to explore my interests. I soon figured out my passion and applied early for a PhD programme.”  

This year, Yejiong will complete his doctoral dissertation and he wishes to seek further development in research. As for suggestions for UNNC students, he encourages everyone to find their real passion and turn it into a reality with hard work.

title: 宁波诺丁汉大学中外校长在2020级新生开学典礼上致辞
content:
Welcome to UNNC
今天，宁波诺丁汉大学2020级新生开学典礼举行，杨福家校长和尼克·迈尔斯校长全英文致辞，寄语新生。
Please scroll down for the English version.
杨福家校长在2020级新生开学典礼上的致辞
同学们好，今天非常高兴能看到所有的新同学！你们现在已经是诺丁汉大家庭中的一员了。

我相信，在疫情的影响下，你们经历了许多挑战和变化。尽管现在是特殊时期，但我们仍能相聚在美丽的宁诺校园，这一切离不开你、你的家人以及学校全体成员的努力。

下面，我讲讲宁波诺丁汉大学是一所什么样的大学。只有知道我们是一所什么样的大学，大家才可以在这里更好地学习。

很多人都知道我们于2004年成立，是中国第一所中外合作大学。但在其他意义上，我们又是一所什么样的大学？

我是从复旦大学毕业的，我问大家，宁诺和复旦哪所大学更好？哪位同学能回答我？

（台下同学有的回答复旦，有的回答宁诺）


其实，是我问的问题不恰当，因为这个问题就好比在问：椅子和桌子，哪一个更好？但这是两个不同的物品，椅子应该和椅子比较，桌子应该和桌子比较。宁诺和复旦是不同类型的两所学校，无法直接作出比较。

给大家讲一个关于我教授的故事。他是国内一流的教授，当我还在复旦大学就读的时候，他是我的论文导师。有一次，他收到一所美国大学的邀请，这所大学名为史瓦兹摩尔（Swarthmore College）。复旦大学当时的校长知道后非常生气，对我导师说：“别忘了你是国内一流的教授，怎么能去这么小的学校？” 

后来，北京的一位熟人碰巧邀请我作为代表团的成员去拜访这所学校，我才了解到高等教育中，不同种类的院校扮演着不同的角色。我希望大家能了解宁诺是什么类型的大学，它不是像复旦这样的研究型大学，当然，这并不代表你在宁诺就不能做研究，只代表宁诺不是这种类型的大学。

其实，像史瓦兹摩尔这种类型的大学是非常重要的。在美国，最好的本科大学不是哈佛耶鲁，而是威廉姆斯（Williams College，美国顶级博雅院校之一），排名第二的是艾姆赫斯特（Amherst College，美国顶级博雅院校之一），而邀请我导师去的史瓦兹摩尔，位列第三。哈佛大学排名第8，耶鲁大学排名第10。我认为宁诺更像是史瓦兹摩尔这种类型的学校。


我有幸促成了宁波诺丁汉大学的创立，并相信宁诺会越来越好。

什么叫做“越来越好”？第一是要看进来的学生，越来越多优秀的学生想要来宁诺学习。第二是要看毕业生的能力，我们毕业生的升学就业去向越来越好。你们能来到宁诺，是幸运的，同时这也是我们的荣幸。我非常高兴在这里见到大家。

我推荐大家去读一本书——《博雅教育》。我写过很多书，但这本尤为特别。至今为止，这本书已经修订至第四版了，但不论是哪一版，里面都保留了一张照片。这张照片上是哈佛大学一个小小的校门，校门口刻着一句话：Enter to grow in wisdom（来这里是为增长智慧）。“智慧”比“知识”更重要，知识、书籍或许会被忘记，并且每个人都能获得，但智慧是让人受益终生的。许多人并不真正理解何为智慧，在这里也没有时间和给大家详细讲解，但我希望你们在宁诺都能增长智慧。我以前常说，你从书本或教室里学到的也许只会对现在有用，科技发展迅速，也许几年后这些知识就过时了，但智慧会一直伴随着你。

在宁诺，我们鼓励学生提问，并且近几年更加强调这一点了。当我在复旦工作时，即使是小班课，同学们也只敢问那些他们自认为困难的问题。但在宁诺，我们采用小班化教学，就是为了让教授能够和每位学生进行充分交流，倾听每一个问题。问得越多，学到的也越多。所有的创新都是从问题开始的，所以我希望大家多问问题，也希望看到大家和别人在一起交流，而不是独自闭门造车。大学是学生聚集的地方，你周围一定有很多人值得你去交流和学习。

复旦的校园里刻着孔子的一句话：博学而笃志，切问而近思。诺贝尔奖得主李政道曾说，他非常欣赏这句话里的两个字——“学”和“问”。学问学问，是学习问问题，而不是答问题。你们应该敢于问问题，提问，然后探索问题的答案，这个过程比上课更加重要。现在我问大家有没有问题，可能举手的人寥寥无几，但相信今后我再问大家有没有问题，会看到很多人举手。

最后，我想再向大家强调：没有问题就没有创新，所有重要的发现都诞生于问题。

谢谢大家。
It’s a great pleasure to welcome all the new students today! You are now a member of the Nottingham community! 
 
I believe all of you have experienced many challenges and changes this year, due to the pandemic. Despite this special period, we now come together on this beautiful campus, which would not be possible without the hard efforts of you, your family and all the members of University of Nottingham Ningbo China.   
 
Now, I would like to talk about what kind of university UNNC is. Only when we know what kind of university we are, we can learn better here. 

Many of you already know that UNNC was founded in 2004 and is the first Sino-foreign university in China. But what kind of university is UNNC? 
 
I graduated from Fudan University. Could you answer me which university is better, Fudan University or University of Nottingham Ningbo China? 

(Student’s Responses) 
 
I tell you frankly, I asked a “wrong” question. Just as I ask which one is better, a chair or a desk? They are different. A chair should be compared with another chair, and a desk should be compared with another desk. The University of Nottingham Ningbo China is totally different from Fudan University. They are not possible to compare with each other.  
 
Before I graduated from Fudan University, my professor, who guided me on how to write the thesis, was a national first-class professor.  
 
A few years ago, he was invited by Swarthmore College to teach. At that time, the President of Fudan University was very angry. "Don't forget you are a national first-class professor. How could you go to such a small college to teach?" he said.  
 
He didn’t know – as I didn’t at that time - that higher education is divided into research universities and liberal arts colleges. Different universities and colleges play different roles.  
 
My professor was invited by Swarthmore College. If we compare only with other undergraduate education institutes, it is ranked number three. The best is Williams College and second is Amherst, both in Boston. Harvard University ranks eighth and Yale tenth.  
 
I hope you understand to which our university belongs to, not research universities like Fudan. It does not mean that you cannot do research - of course yes, you can! But we are not in this category. 
 
Actually, this kind of university that I just mentioned is very important. I’m very proud that we established this university. I can also tell you that this university is getting better and better! 
 
What do you mean by better? Firstly, the students. More and more great students apply to enter this university. Secondly, you see how capable the graduates are. I can also tell you that the jobs they get are getting better and better. I think it’s your honour - also our honour - to have you here. 
 
I hope you understand not only what kind of university we are, but also what kind of things we provide.  
 
I recommend you read a book called Liberal Art Education (博雅教育). I’ve written many books, but this book is special. It’s been published four times. In this book, and in other books, there is a picture. At Harvard University, there is a small gate. If you look at the small gate there is one inscription saying, “enter to grow in wisdom”. Enter the college not for knowledge, but for wisdom! Knowledge, books, may be gone in a few years, and everybody can learn. But wisdom - you may use it forever.  
 
Some people don’t really understand what the meaning of wisdom is. I have no time to say more about what the wisdom is. You may go back and look up in the dictionary. I hope you could always increase your wisdom. It will be good for you all your life. What you learn from a book or from the classroom may be useful now. But as science develops so fast, a few years later, the same technology may not be as advanced. However, wisdom will be useful forever. So, I hope you put emphasis on how to increase your wisdom, which is meaningful. 
 
This university encourages all students to ask questions. We emphasise small class. When I was at Fudan University, what was important were the big classes and sessions. For a small class, only assistant professors were there to help with the difficulties students had. But at this university, we make small class as number one. Professors talk for maybe five minutes, then go around one table to another to ask students if they have questions. If you have more questions, you are a good student.  
 
If you think about inventions - all inventions come from questions. No question, no creation. So, asking questions and trying to answer the questions are very important.  
 
You can see that you are all in groups, not alone. If you like to be alone, just tell yourself that you shouldn’t need to go to university. University means many students and there are many people you can communicate with and learn from each other.  
 
At Fudan University, there was a big curved stone with the sentence. It’s difficult to translate into English, 博学而笃志，切问而近思. It was said by Confucius three thousand years ago. T.D. Lee (Zhengdao Li), the Nobel Prize winner, once said that he enjoyed the second words of each phrase. 博学 is 学 and 切问 is 问, 学问学问, 是我们问问题不是答问题. So I give you the advice that you should dare to ask questions, no matter it is correct or wrong.
 
So, I hope you enjoy your learning in UNNC and you are not alone. You have many schoolmates here to discuss things with. That’s something more important than classes. So, if you have any further questions, you are welcome to ask.  
 
Do you have questions now? You are still shy to ask questions. I think maybe a few years later when I ask the question again, there will be more people putting their hands up and saying yes. Let me repeat: no question, no invention. All important discoveries come from questions.  
 
Thank you so much.





尼克·迈尔斯校长在2020级新生开学典礼上的致辞
欢迎所有新同学来到美丽的宁波诺丁汉大学开启4年的大学之旅！希望大家已经安顿下来，开始适应新环境并且交到了新朋友。

同学们，我今天对你们所说的话与以往的新生欢迎辞有所不同，因为在新冠疫情的持续影响下，2020无疑是特殊的一年。疫情已导致全球数十万人死亡，无论是在办公室办公、在工厂工作、在学校学习，还是在像宁诺这样的大学就读，人们的日常生活方式都因此发生了改变，而这些改变有可能是永久的。

是的，很多事情都发生了变化，我们几乎每天都在面临新的挑战，不得不调整或彻底改变之前的行事方式，宁诺也不例外。

虽然有些措施可能看起来很麻烦，但我们清楚地知道，这些措施是为了保障你、你周围的同学、学校教职员工以及广大宁波社区的健康和安全。请永远不要忘记，病毒仍然存在，我们所有人都有责任去尽可能确保它在可控范围内。

正因如此，今天能在这里见到大家真是太好了。这不仅证明，让宁诺成为疫情后期首批重新开放的大学之一的努力是值得的，也证明了你们和父母的远见与决心。


由于世界上许多国家或地区仍处于封锁状态或在遭受严重的疫情，一些人对国际教育——宁诺提供的正是国际教育——的适用性和可行性产生了质疑，这点可以反映在出国留学的中国学生数量大幅下降上，同时，来中国学习的国际学生数量也出现了类似的减少。

由于疫情在世界许多地方仍然十分严重，所以这种下降是不可避免的。 

但，也只是暂时的。

一旦学生和家长认为出国旅游、留学足够安全时，他们会再次这样选择。

至于国际教育是否仍然可行——有些人甚至会问“国际教育是否还有价值”——我会坚定地回答，是的，而且现在比以往任何时候都有价值！

如果说我们从艰难的2020年学到了什么的话，那就是当我们齐心协力、朝同一方向努力实现共同目标时，我们就拥有了强大的力量。我们努力确保美丽校园成为一个安全的生活、工作和学习场所时是这样，世界各地的病毒学家、医学研究人员努力研发安全疫苗，以便生活能够恢复正常时也是这样。

而全球视野和跨境合作是解决当今世界许多重要问题（无论问题大小）的关键。

其实，除了新冠病毒，我们还面临着诸如环境、气候变化等许多重大挑战。

这些问题的解决方案往往诞生于像宁诺这样的地方——那些汇聚了全球视野、资源和影响力的国际合作机构。作为一名宁诺新生，你已经成为了这个故事、我们的故事中的重要部分。

我相信有一天，你一定会亲身体验到宁诺所提供的世界一流、真正全球化的教育所带来的益处。你也许会意识到，国际教育为你打开了一扇获得更多机会和惊喜体验的大门，而这种经历在其他地方难以遇到。


有一件事我每年都会提醒新生，你在这里接受的教育和过去所接受的教育相比会非常不同。

在宁诺的学习就像中国俗语说的那样，师傅领进门，修行靠个人。当然，你周围的老师和学者都是非常优秀的，他们都愿意并渴望将自己的知识和专业技能传授给你。你每天起床后，会来到的现代化的教室学习，你会用到一流的设施，比如美丽的新图书馆。

别让这样的机会从你身边溜走。今天来到宁诺，是你迈出的重要的第一步。然而，之后还有更多路要走——并且只有你自己才能走好。

最后，我确信当我在一年后欢迎下一批新生时，2020年的许多不确定因素都有望烟消云散，全球对话也将继续。如果我们仍然无法完全回到从前的正常状态，至少我们知道如何更好地面对新冠疫情带来的“新常规”。

但有一件事不会变——那就是国际教育的价值将丝毫不减！正是那些能透过不确定性迷雾看问题的人、那些一直欣赏它价值的人——比如你们和你们的父母——最终会在未来岁月里收获回报。

祝你们度过一个美好的新生适应周，然后记得努力学习。

谢谢大家。
Hello and a very warm welcome to all of you as you embark on your 4-year university adventure at our wonderful campus here in Ningbo! I hope that you’re settling in well, getting used to your new environment and already making new friends. 

However, my words today will differ from welcome addresses that I have given to new students like yourselves in the past. The reason for this is clear – 2020 has been a year like no other, due to the ongoing effects of the Covid-19 pandemic. COVID has led to hundreds of thousands of deaths all around the world and has changed - perhaps forever - the way that we fundamentally go about our day-to-day lives, whether that’s working in an office, or in a factory, studying at school or attending a university like ours.

Yes, a lot has changed and all of us have confronted new challenges on an almost daily basis and had to adjust or completely rework our daily methods or routines. We’ve certainly had to do that here at the UNNC.

Though some of this might seem troublesome, we should always be aware that these measures are in place to safeguard the health and safety of you, your classmates, university staff and the broader Ningbo community. Let us never forget that the virus is still out there, and we all bear some responsibility to keep it under control.

All that being said, it’s great to see you here today. It’s a testament not only to the efforts of many people who made UNNC one of the first institutions to reopen after COVID lockdown but also to the vision and determination of yourselves and your parents.

With many parts of the world still in lockdown or suffering very badly from the virus, some have questioned the practicality and viability of an international education like the one we provide here at UNNC. This has been reflected in the sizeable decline in the numbers of Chinese students going to study overseas and a similar reduction in the numbers of international students coming to study in China.

With the pandemic still active in many parts of the world, this drop off was inevitable. 

Yet this is all temporary. 

As soon as students and their parents feel comfortable enough to travel and study abroad again, they will!

And as to whether an international education is still viable – some would even add "valuable" – I would say: a firm yes, and now more than ever!

If there is anything that we’ve learned from this torrid year of 2020, it’s the power that we can wield when we all come together and pull in the same direction to achieve shared goals. This applies when attempting to ensure that our beautiful campus is a safe place to live, work and study. It applies just as much to all the medical researchers around the world who are presently attempting to provide a safe Covid-19 vaccine so that our lives can begin to return to a better kind of normality.

It is our international outlook and cross-border cooperation that - no matter how large or small - are key to solving so many of the fundamental problems in the world today. 

And not just COVID, but also the immense challenges that we face with the environment and climate change, to name but a few.

It all starts at places like UNNC – institutions that base their entire existence on their global outlook, connections, reach and influence. As new students here, you now become part of that story. Our story.

In time, I’m confident that you’ll come to appreciate all the benefits of the world-class, truly global education that UNNC has to offer. You may also come to realise that an international education opens the door to so many opportunities and exciting experiences that would be more difficult to come by at other institutions.

One thing I do like to remind freshers of every year is the difference between the education you’ve received in the past and what you’ll experience here. 

The main driver of your learning here at UNNC is yourself. To be sure, you will be surrounded by great teachers, lecturers and researchers – all of them eager and willing to pass on their knowledge and expertise. You’ll get up every day and go to study in our excellent lecture halls, and you’ll take advantage of our world-class facilities, such as our splendid new library that you may have already noticed.

Don’t let such opportunities pass you by. You’ve already made the important first step in joining us and being here today. Yet there are many more steps to take – and no-one can take them for you.

Finally, I’m sure that when I do make a similar welcome address in a year from now, much of the uncertainty that we’ve faced in 2020 will hopefully have evaporated, and the global conversation will have moved on. If we’ve not returned completely to our former normality, at least we will know how to better manage and deal with the “new normal” brought on by COVID-19.

But one thing will stay the same – the value of an international education will be undiminished! And it’s those who saw through the fog of uncertainty, those that always appreciated its value – people such as yourselves and your parents – that will ultimately reap the rewards in the years and decades ahead.

Have a great freshers' week – and then study hard.

Thank you.

content:

在2020这特殊的一年
宁波诺丁汉大学迎来了最特别的你们
你于这个夏天的结尾
踏入了位于泰康东路199号的大门
开始了属于自己的序章

All 2020 Freshers - welcome to UNNC! This is the start of a new chapter of your life. Before the academic courses start, you may also be curious about our UNNC campus. Let’s get familiar with the University. 


2020宁诺新生报到精彩瞬间


 UN  NC 

NO.01
入住“新家”
>>>>>>>>>>

你拖着沉重的行李和父母告别，刚走入校门，就有志愿者和工作人员接过大包小包，为你送到寝室楼。
When you arrive at the campus gate, our volunteers and staff help you with your luggage and lead you to the dormitory. 







滑动查看更多








滑动查看更多
踏入宿舍楼的大门，学长学姐帮你办完注册登记，发放了精美的新生礼盒。
这是你在UNNC收到的第一份礼物。 
In the students' dorm, volunteers are waiting for you. They help you complete the registration and give you the fresher's pack.  


“滴”的一声，门开了，里面是宽敞明亮的宿舍。你已经开始想象把它布置好之后的样子，这里将是你未来四年的小“家”。


NO.02
X Zone展览
>>>>>>>>>>

整理好宿舍，对一切都感到新奇的你决定去校园逛逛，不知不觉走到了生活区的中心——轮滑广场，这里正在举办X Zone展览。
The X zone exhibition is set up at the Rolling Square by the Students Union. It introduces you to the diverse activities at UNNC and your infinite possibilities.  







滑动查看更多
学生会的学姐向你介绍，在UNNC的生活充满着无限可能，可以打造自己喜欢的小世界，学校各部门和组织会为你的生活、学习提供贴心的帮助。临近分别，学姐还提醒你享受美食的同时不忘勤俭节约。
你似乎开始感受到了在这里生活的温暖点滴。

NO.03
U-dom展览
>>>>>>>>>>

顺着诺丁桥过去，就是宁诺的教学区了，你一眼就看到了崭新的图书馆。
等等，钟楼那边好像有一个漂亮的展览。







滑动查看更多
你走过印着校训的帷幕，看到了学术的莫比乌斯环。从这些字眼中，你开始对杨福家校长说的“博雅”有所认识。







滑动查看更多
翻转板上的活动照片和介绍，让你看到了学校组织社团多元活动的一角。







滑动查看更多
这是“自由”概念的视觉表达。在宁诺，你可以把你的想法变成实践，认识更好的自己。
In front of the Trend Building is the U-dom exhibition. It displays the academic life and numerous student organisations here at UNNC, letting you understand the liberal education of our university. Students are free to explore and turn their ideas into practice.  


NO.04
理工学院欢迎活动
>>>>>>>>>>

听说今天来报到的大多是理工学子，你迫不及待地走进理工楼，你未来的大作也许会在这里诞生哦！







滑动查看更多
酷炫的F1方程式赛车让你眼前一亮，学姐学长还展示了学生自制的互动机器人和乐高做的打地鼠机器。这就是理工独特的魅力吧，你想。
Walking into the Science and Engineering Building, there are Formula One, student-made interactive robots and LEGO whack-a-mole machinse displayed inside the building.  







滑动查看更多
理工楼的大厅里摆放着建筑系的毕业设计作品，让你心生向往。
In the lobby of the building, there are graduation projects from architecture students, which combine their personal styles and modern art.  







滑动查看更多
大厅里还有CELE（宁诺英语语言教学中心）团队的介绍，一位亲切的老师主动向你打招呼，介绍了接下来一年的相关课程，你已经开始期待未来的学习了！
There are also CELE teaching staff in the lobby, introducing the modules that students will be taking in their first year.

title: FoSE新生报到日 | 正式开启属于你的UNNC之旅
content:
Please scroll down for the English version


9月14日，2020级宁波诺丁汉大学新生报到啦！今年，理工学院的大一新生成为了宁诺新学期首批前来报到的萌新。从学校大门，教学楼再到宿舍区，整个校园都装扮上了迎新布景，钟楼前还有迎接新生的“U-dom Exhibition”布展，一路可见老师与学生志愿者们忙碌的身影。

理工学生联合会的志愿者们和学院的迎新团队早早地来到了理工楼，准备迎接新生们的到来。早上9点出头，第一位理工新生就结束了宿舍楼下的新生注册，来到了未来四年奋斗的大本营理工楼，迎接她的除了有热情的学生志愿者，更有超级拉风的Formula 1赛车。在学长学姐的介绍下，小萌新们对于他们未来会接受到的课程表示了强烈的兴趣。


“我的大学四年都会学什么？” “我应该怎么开启我在宁诺的学术生活？” “全英文授课听的懂吗？” 此时的理工萌新们也许还在迷惘他们在宁诺的学术生活，而在理工楼115教室举行的专业答疑会，真正解答了同学们心中的疑惑。

今年一共有超过700名新生加入宁诺理工学院的大家庭。这其中，我们遇到了一位来自湖北襄阳的新生方隽纶同学。今年年初，来势汹汹的新冠肺炎疫情没有打倒湖北，在中国人民团结一致的抗击与努力下，湖北和全国其他省份一起，成功打赢了这场疫情防控阻击战。对此，方同学也感触颇深。亲身经历了这场疫情，并且如愿来到了理想的学校，方同学感到由衷的开心。
方隽纶同学在宿舍的留影
他对未来的大学新生活充满了期待。选择了化工与制药大类的他也希望未来可以用自己学到的知识和技能，为工业生产带来新的突破，回报这个社会。

正如理工学院院长吴韬教授在今天下午的新生家长会中分享的，他希望每一个理工学子都可以在10年或者20年之后，成为行业内的领军人物，创造属于自己的美好未来！也希望所有大一同学能够感受到理工学院这个大家庭的温暖，开启属于你的宁诺新生活～


September 14th, Faculty of Science and Engineering welcomed the new class of FoSE students. This year, there are more than 700 students join our Faculty and start their academic life with us.
 
In the morning, student volunteers from SESA and Faculty welcome team have prepared to welcome new students. Student design projects from Architecture, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering are exhibited in the Sir Peter Mansfield Building. Moreover, Faculty academic staff also joined to welcome our freshmen and help to answer their every question about the programme.
 
This year, due to the COVID-19 epidemic, all the parents could not be able to enter the campus. Therefore, the Faculty organised an online Parents’ Forum. Professor Tao Wu, the Dean of Faculty of Science and Engineering, welcomed all new students and extended his sincere gratitude to them for choosing UNNC and FoSE. He introduced the highlight of FoSE and wish every FoSE students obtain the most advanced technology and knowledge from us and will be an industry leader in the future.
 
One of our new class of students Junlun Fang comes from Hubei Province. We can see the excitement on his face, after going through the epidemic and finally entering his dream school. He is very looking forward to starting a new journey with UNNC. He is also determined to use the knowledge he learnt in the UNNC and bring the revolutionary innovation to the industry.
 
We wish every one of you enjoy your life here.

title: DCL | 新生注册报到日流程说明
content:
注册报到日入校流程


亲爱的2020级新生及家长，
疫情期间，请大家依据学校防控要求按步骤有序进校：

第一步
请在规定下车区域下车，并配合志愿者进行随身行李消杀。

第二步
志愿者将发放新生所住相应寝室楼的行李贴。

如果您是自主运送行李，可以借用学校手推车。学校手推车数量有限，借用的手推车请务必及时归还原地。

如果您需要代运送行李服务，请在行李贴上填写好您的完整信息，并将行李贴贴在行李的明显位置，建议随身只拿力所能及的行李和贵重物品。您的行李将由行李运送团队统一运送到您所填写的寝室楼层的行李存放区域。完成现场注册的新生请直接在各自寝室楼层认领行李。领取行李时，请仔细根据编号认领。如果您的行李未能及时送到，请您联系您所在寝室楼的志愿者。
（行李贴样式）

第三步
请提前准备好新生本人有效二代身份证和宁波健康码（可扫描排队周围二维码进行现场注册），按地上黄色隔离线有序排队。

第四步
请在进门处配合安保人员和志愿者进行测温，亮码，刷身份证，核验无误后方可入校。

第五步
入校后，可以根据志愿者的引导前往寝室楼。
（图片中红心处为志愿者服务点）

Dear 2020 new students and parents,

Due to the special circumstances currently, please abide by the following requirements of university epidemic control and prevention policy to enter the campus:

Step 1
Please get off at the specified area and cooperate with volunteers to do the disinfection work;

Step 2 
The volunteers will distribute luggage stickers to the corresponding residence building where the new students live.

If you are carrying your luggage on your own, you can borrow trolley. However, the number of trolleys is limited. Please return in time.

If you need luggage service, please fill out the blank on the luggage sticker and paste it on the conspicuous place of your luggage. It is suggested to carry some luggage upon your capacity allows and take along the valuables with you. Your luggage will be sent to the luggage storage area on the dormitory floor you live. New students who have completed the on-site registration are requested to claim their luggage directly on their dormitory floor. Please claim your luggage according to the number carefully. If your luggage is not delivered in time, please contact the volunteers in your residence building.

Step 3
Please prepare your valid ID card and Ningbo health code (you can scan the QR code and complete the registration now). Please queue up in order patiently.

Step 4
Please do the temperature test, show health code and swipe ID card at the Gate spot cooperatively.

Step 5
After entering the university, you can go to the residence building according to the guidance of volunteers.


寝室楼下注册流程


第1步
凭新生注册单和有效二代居民身份证确认信息，并盖章.

第2步
领取小信封，签字并盖章。

第3步
完成新生适应周注册，并盖章。领取新生大礼包。

Step 1 
Please get your information confirmed with your registration form and ID card, and get the form stamped.

Step 2
Please collect your envelope, sign your name and get
the form stamped.

Step 3
Complete I-Week registration, and get the form stamped.

title: 宁诺为持有国外一流院校offer的中国籍学生开通国内就读渠道
content:
受全球新冠疫情影响，部分获得国外一流大学录取的中国学生将无法按预期出境并在国外开展学习。为践行中外合作大学办学的社会责任，经上级教育管理部门同意，宁波诺丁汉大学公布2020年秋季增额录取计划招生简章，向部分持有国外一流大学录取通知书的中国籍学生提供申请在宁波诺丁汉大学就读的机会。

如您已获得国外一流大学正式录取通知书且有意愿在宁诺进行学习并完成学业，请按照下方招生简章中的要求，于2020年9月20日前尽快提交相关申请资料。宁诺将对材料进行审核并对合格的申请者签发2020年秋季入学通知书。

I. 关于宁诺
宁波诺丁汉大学是中国第一所经教育部批准、具有独立法人资格和独立校园的中外合作大学，招收国内外本科生、硕士和博士。
学校亮点：
（请向下滑动查看全文）
•宁诺率先引进具有100多年办学历史的世界百强大学——英国诺丁汉大学的教学资源与质量保障体系。
•原汁原味地采用英国诺丁汉大学教学模式，实行小班化、全英文教学，注重培养学生的综合素质。
•共享英国诺丁汉大学网络与教学资源，师资由英诺选派或按照英诺学术标准全球选聘。
•具有浓厚的国际校园氛围，目前已有来自全球70多个国家和地区的约8000名学生和800余名教职员工。在校学生中有11%左右注册攻读学位的留学生（非语言类），外籍教师占比70%左右。
•接受国际权威机构的教学质量评估，是唯一获得英国高等教育质量保障署（QAA）认可的中国高校。
•专业设置和认证体系与国际接轨。宁诺商学院获EQUIS（欧洲质量提高体系）认证，工程类专业（除新增专业）全部获得国际专业协会认证。
•作为国际研究型大学U21成员之一，宁诺现与遍布40多个国家和地区的130余所海外一流院校建立了密切交流合作关系。
•宁诺至今已有16000多名毕业生走向世界，受到名校名企的广泛认可。在伦敦金融街顶级投行、全球四大会计师事务所、大型跨国公司、尖端技术实验室、各国顶尖名校，到处都能见到宁诺学子的身影。

title: 我回来了！意大利原经济发展部副部长米凯莱 · 杰拉奇回归宁诺授课
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - Former Italian Undersecretary returns to teach at UNNC.

今天，我们收到重磅消息：意大利前经济发展部副部长米凯莱·杰拉奇已经回到中国，目前正在隔离。新学期他将恢复在宁波诺丁汉大学的教职，作为金融学教授讲授一门新的选修课程——《中国与全球经济》。

杰拉奇于2012年加入宁诺，2018年曾被提名为意大利总理，后出任意大利经济发展部副部长，负责国际贸易与投资。任职期间，他曾领导意大利经济发展部的“中国特别工作组”，推动意大利加入“一带一路”倡议，并且作为主要官员起草了“一带一路”合作备忘录。今年疫情暴发后，他第一时间在意大利为中国加油，倡导意大利学习“中国经验”，助推中意携手抗疫。

杰拉奇教授在CCTV的采访中分享他的观点：中国的经济结构和体制有助于中国经济回暖。

将推动畅通专家学者
建言献策渠道
从巴黎飞抵上海，经历数小时的各项检验检疫抵达隔离点，杰拉奇的亲身感受是：“中国的抗疫措施是我见过最严格的！实际上，我几乎没有与任何人接触，除了穿着防护服的机场工作人员，直达到了隔离酒店。”

他说，此次横跨大洋选择回归，是因为他迫切希望推动专家学者与政府机构的交流，继续深化中国-意大利-一带一路合作。“就像在新型冠状病毒肺炎期间我们看到的那样，意大利医学专家来到中国交流信息，这是非常有益的合作。”

我在中国的十年一直致力于政策研究，我试图为中国的政策制定者提供建议，也为意大利和西方国家的政府提供帮助，但这并不容易。当我上任后，我成立了中国特别工作组，旨在研究中国经济及其挑战和机遇，以便我们的意大利企业能够更好地与中国开展经贸合作。我呼吁整个意大利学术界贡献他们的观点和分析。

现在我回到中国，我希望我的政府工作经历能帮助专家学者们，尤其是外籍专家学者，让他们的更多研究成果和意见建议能更广泛地被政府所倾听和接纳。

按照计划，在接下来的秋季学期，他将建立研究团队和专家网络，并在第二学期尽他所能将他们的政策研究成果提供给决策者。


将为学生带来独一无二的课程
此外，杰拉奇此次重归校园，还特别针对高年级学生开设了选修课程——《中国与全球经济》。他介绍，这门课程汇集了许多要素，学生将学习宏观经济，解读经济政策，甚至以政策制定者的视角来模拟政策制定。

每周，我会带领学生们关注世界各地影响中国和世界经济的新闻，例如中美贸易、货币政策、科技和5G，当然还有‘一带一路’。学生还将深入了解各国政府是如何做出经济决策的以及政策的局限性，包括为什么我认为意大利应该加入‘一带一路’。学生将听到第一手的故事。
杰拉奇说，遗憾的是，这门课只有一个学期，他觉得实在太短了。

他表示，教学一直是他的热情所在，他希望能够帮助学生们在知识的海洋中找到自己的价值。杰拉奇说，“我很荣幸也很高兴能回到我工作生活了六年的宁诺上课。我期待能够搭建起平台，让来自意大利、中国和世界其他地区的年轻朋友们能够展开真正广泛的合作。”


随着形势和政策变化，像杰拉奇一样因疫情无法回校工作的教师预计将在接下来的一个月内陆续到岗。早在疫情暴发之初，宁诺的许多教师就第一时间从世界各地千方百计赶回学校，三月底时就已经有80%的学术教师到岗，为线上线下教学做好准备。正是教师们的责任感和担当作为，使得宁诺成为疫情期间中外合作大学里唯一一所全面复学复课的大学。

今日恰逢教师节，我们也借此机会向全体宁诺教职工致以崇高的敬意。祝节日快乐！

Former Italian Undersecretary returns to teach at UNNC
 
Michele Geraci,  Former Undersecretary of State at the Italian Ministry of Economic Development, has returned to China and will resume his teaching post as Professor of Practice in Economic Policy at UNNC. In the upcoming fall term, he will teach a new module named China and the Global Economy. 
 
Michele first joined UNNC in 2012. He was appointed as Undersecretary of the Italian Ministry of Economic Development and took leave from UNNC in 2018. He was also nominated as a candidate for Prime Minister of Italy in 2018. During his tenure, Michele was one of the key officials drafting the framework of the Memorandum of Understanding and helped to push Italy to join China’s Belt and Road Initiative. Early in 2020, he urged the globe to “stand together” in the face of the pandemic and boosted international collaboration between China and Italy.  
 
While speaking of the motivation to return to China, Michele said that in his view the government needs to be in closer contact with academic institutions to get input from their research and policy advice, and he hopes to bridge this gap and be a channel.  
 
“I worked on practical and policy-oriented work during my ten years in China. I tried to feed not only into Chinese policymakers but also to the Italian and Western governments, but it was not easy. When I took on my role (as the Italian Under-Secretary for Economic Development), I also set up a working group aimed at studying the Chinese economy so that our Italian companies could be better placed to do business with their Chinese counterparts.  

Now, starting this semester, I invite all colleagues and students who are interested in offering their contributions to Italy's development and Italy-China relations to get in touch with me as soon as possible.” 
 
In addition to this, Michele decided to return to campus because teaching has always been one of his passions. He hopes that the new module China and the Global Economy will unite many diverse elements. 
 
“Every week we will look at news that impacts China and the world economy, for example, the US-China trade tensions, the role of the RMB in the international markets, technology, 5G and of course the Belt and Road, and why I decided that Italy join the Belt and Road. Students will get first-hand stories,” he said.   
 
Michele Geraci is one of the numerous academics that overcame various difficulties caused by COVID-19 and still decided to come back to campus.  

Despite the impact of the pandemic, UNNC academic teachers display a strong dedication and commitment. 
 
Happy Teacher’s Day!

title: 全球化大潮势不可挡——杨福家校长致2020级宁诺新生及家长
content:
Please scroll down for the English version - The irresistible trend of globalisation – To new students of 2020 and their parents.

首先，请允许我代表诺丁汉大学，英国的和宁波的，向2020级新生表示热烈的祝贺，欢迎你们成为诺丁汉全球大家庭中的一员！同时，非常感谢各位同学和家长，在这个特殊时期仍然选择信任宁波诺丁汉大学，把人生中宝贵的四年托付给我们, 为你们的选择点赞！

疫情给世界格局、国家关系、个人生活带来了很多不确定性，也让许多人对出国留学、国际交流、甚至国际化的教育充满疑虑。这一点，在今年中外合作机构和项目的招生现状中也有所反映。我非常理解，即使已经选择国际化教育的你们，心中也免不了忐忑。

但是，我认为恰恰是疫情，让我们看到人类的命运早已紧密相连。交流互鉴是文明发展的本质要求。如果你到网上搜索一下，你会发现习近平总书记近半年来在各种场合发言的主旋律都是“全球化大潮不可挡，融合大趋势未变”。面对严峻的全球性挑战，构建人类命运共同体是习近平总书记提出的“中国方案”。

所以，各位，选择宁波诺丁汉大学，你们很有远见！

这是大的背景。下面，我讲讲宁波诺丁汉大学是一所什么样的大学。只有知道我们是一所什么样的大学，大家才可以在这里更好地学习。

很多人都知道我们于2004年成立，是中国第一所中外合作大学——引进世界百强大学英国诺丁汉大学的优质教育资源，接受中国教育部和英国高等教育质量保障署的双重审查，以及国际专业协会认证，颁发英国诺丁汉大学的学位证书，培养国际化专业人才。但在其他意义上，我们又是一所什么样的大学？

在复旦时，我曾受邀去美国院校访问。我了解到，在美国，最好的博雅学院是威廉姆斯（Williams College），排名第二的是艾姆赫斯特（Amherst College），排名第三的是史瓦兹摩尔（Swarthmore College）。而被大家熟知的哈佛大学排名第8，耶鲁大学排名第10。

在英国，我有幸当了12年诺丁汉大学校长，走访了无数世界高校，逐渐懂得什么叫博雅教育。自然而然的，我也在思考这种优秀的教学体制可否移植到中国来。非常幸运的是，我促成了宁波诺丁汉大学的创立。

再回到这个问题，我们是一所什么样的大学？我们显然不是复旦这种研究型大学，我认为我们更像是史瓦兹摩尔学院或威廉姆斯学院。

我们保持了英国诺丁汉大学的精华，同时尽可能丰富“博”的内容；我们主张“做人第一、修业第二”；我们强调以学生为中心，以教书育人为本；我们提倡小班讨论式教育，没有不可以问的问题，没有不可以争论的答案；我们鼓励并协助同学们投身第二课堂，在学生社团、社会实践、公益活动、科研实习中找到火种。

宁波诺丁汉大学是开拓者。集合最好的教育理念和教育实践，培养真正的世界公民，是我们的初衷。我个人很不赞同把学生按分数差异分为一本、二本、三本。回想学校成立之初，我们的录取分数也并不很高，但是学生照样在这所别样的大学里成就了别样的精彩。这里有醉心科研的同学，去顶尖大学深造；有直接就业的同学，就职世界500强；有实干创业的同学，产品销往50多个国家和地区；有致力公益的同学，加入国际非政府组织；有不走寻常路的同学，到美国T台逐梦……

我在宁诺头两年收到的学生来信就超过了在复旦做校长6年收到的学生来信数量。而信中很关键的一句话就是：“学校改变了我们的一生。”

16年，我们日益精进，不追求规模发展，而是花功夫在教育质量上做到极致，精心耕耘这块博雅教育的试验田；16年，我们与宁波水乳交融、与中国脉搏紧密相连，搭建了一系列跨国合作的高能级平台；16年，我们不仅形成了植根中国、面向世界的成熟教育体系，还推进中英在教育、文化、经贸、科技、体育等各领域的广泛交流。

这次疫情期间，无论多么艰难，我们从未放松对教学质量的控制。80%多的学术教师在第一时间从世界各地千方百计赶回学校，为线上线下教学做好准备。诺丁汉大学三校充分发挥联动优势，使得我们能够率先平稳地恢复线下教学，成为中外合作大学里唯一一所全面复学复课的大学，展示了学校的担当和作为。

在刚刚过去的暑假，几十名导师自愿留校指导600多名自愿参与的学生提升专业技能、实操能力和就业竞争力，仅科研实习项目就有170余项。有这么好的平台，这么有责任心的老师，这么求知若渴的学生，我相信我们必定有美好的未来。

最后，再次欢迎所有新同学，希望你们喜欢这里，在学校有愉快的经历；希望你们主动探索，在发现这个世界的同时也慢慢发现自我。
人物名片

杨福家，1936年出生于上海，中国科学院院士，发展中国家科学院院士，中央文史研究馆馆员，中国科协前副主席，国家教育咨询委员会委员，国家教育考试指导委员会委员，宁波诺丁汉大学校长。曾任中国科学院上海原子核研究所所长（1987-2001）、复旦大学校长（1993-1999）、英国诺丁汉大学校长（2001-2012），是享誉世界的中国当代著名核物理学家和教育家。

The irresistible trend of globalisation – To new students of 2020 and their parents

First of all, on behalf of the University of Nottingham, please allow me to extend my warm congratulations to the class of 2024 and welcome you all as members of the global Nottingham community! I would also like to thank you and your parents, for choosing the University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC), despite this special period, and entrust us with these precious four years of your life!

The Covid-19 pandemic has brought much uncertainty to the world and impacted everyone’s personal life. It has also raised doubts among many about studying abroad, international exchange and even international education. This is reflected in the results of the Gaokao recruitment for Sino-foreign cooperative institutions and programmes this year. I understand very well that even if you have chosen international education, you may still feel uneasy.

But I think it is the pandemic that makes us see that the fate of mankind has long been closely interwoven. Exchange and mutual understanding are essential to the development of civilisation. If you search on the Internet, you will find that President Xi's speeches on various occasions over the past six months have emphasised the inevitable trend of globalisation. To build a community of a shared future for mankind in the face of the severe global challenges is the "China plan" put forward by President Xi.

So, everyone, you are visionary to choose UNNC!

Now, I would like to first introduce you to what kind of university UNNC is. Only when we know what kind of university we are, can we learn better here.

Many already know that UNNC was founded in 2004, and is the first Sino-foreign university in China. It introduces high-quality educational resources from the University of Nottingham, UK - one of the world's top 100 universities- and is subject to the double examination of the Ministry of Education of China and the British Quality Assurance Agency for Higher Education. UNNC holds the certification of international professional associations and issues the degree certificate of the University of Nottingham. But beyond this, what kind of university is UNNC?

While at Fudan University, I was once invited to visit some American colleges and universities. I first learned that in the United States the best liberal arts college is Williams College, second is Amherst College and third is Swarthmore College. Harvard University, one we are all familiar with, ranks eighth and Yale tenth.

I was lucky to serve as Chancellor of the University of Nottingham for 12 years and I have visited numerous universities around the world. I gradually realised what a liberal education was and I began to consider whether this excellent education system could be introduced to China. I was very excited to contribute to the establishment of the University of Nottingham Ningbo China.

Back to the question of which kind of university we are - I think we are not a research university like Fudan University, but we are more like Swarthmore or Williams College.

We maintain the essence of the University of Nottingham and enrich the content of "liberal" as much as possible. We advocate that one’s conduct is the foundation of everything, and learning comes second. We insist on the student-centred principles, regarding teaching and learning as the foundation of a university. We promote discussion-oriented teaching – there is no wrong question or indisputable answer. We encourage and support students to extend extracurricular activities, exploring their passions in student associations, social practices, public welfare activities, scientific research and so on.

UNNC is a pioneer. We intended to gather the best educational ideas and practices to cultivate real-world citizens. I disagree that students should be divided into batches according to their Gaokao scores. Looking back to the initial stages of the University, our admission scores were not very high, but students still enjoyed a wonderful undergraduate study and obtained diversified achievements. UNNC has students who are interested in scientific research and go to top universities for further study, and students who head to work in World Top 500 companies right after graduation. 

We have seen students that are practical and start their own businesses, whose products are sold to more than 50 countries and regions, or students who are committed to public welfare and join international NGOs. There have also been students who have distinctive passions and went off to pursue their dreams all around the world. 

Within my first two years at UNNC, I received more letters from students than I did during my six-year presidency in Fudan. One recurring theme in these letters is that "the University has changed my life". 

For 16 years, we have made great efforts, not in pursuing the greater scale of the University, but in unremittingly polishing the quality of education. In collaboration with the Ningbo Government and industry partners, we provide solutions to local challenges through world-class research and innovation. Over 16 years, we have formed a mature education system rooted in China whilst facing the world and promoted extensive exchanges between China and the UK in numerous fields, such as economy and trade, science and technology and culture.

During the ongoing pandemic, regardless of the difficulty, we have never compromised on our teaching quality. By March, more than 80% of our academic staff have managed to return to campus from all over the world to prepare for online and face-to-face teaching. With support from the UK and the Malaysia campus of the University of Nottingham, we became the only Sino-foreign university to fully resume face-to-face education. This, I think, amply demonstrates the responsibilities and capability of this university.

Over the summer vacation, dozens of academic staff voluntarily remained on campus to guide over 600 student participants in summer programmes to improve their professional skills, practical abilities and employment competitiveness. There were more than 170 scientific research internship projects alone. With such a good platform, such responsible lecturers and students eager for knowledge, I believe we will have a bright future.

Finally, welcome again to all our new students. I hope you like it here and have a pleasant experience at UNNC. I hope you take the initiative to explore and discover yourself while also discovering the world.


Professor Yang Fujia
President of University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC)

Professor Yang Fujia, whose family comes from Ningbo, is an eminent physicist and distinguished academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. He is Vice-Chairman of the Chinese Association for Science and Technology (CAST) and the Bohr Professor of Fudan University (where he is also a former president).

In 1991, he was promoted to the Chinese Academy of Science and the Science Academy of the Third World, and in 1998 was given an honorary professorship in physics by the American Vanderbilt University. 

Professor Yang is recognised as an outstanding university leader and has served as the executive director of the Union of International University Presidents' since 1996. He was the Chancellor of the University of Nottingham from 2001 to 2012.

title: 理工优秀校友专访 | 杨适嘉：永远怀揣着对世界的好奇心，是我工作学习的方法论
content:
please scroll down for the English version

2020年庚子年，一场突如其来的疫情影响了世界各地的人们。面对未来，我们想通过一些优秀学长学姐的个人经历，传递给在校师生一些坚韧的力量，让他们在漫长疫情的影响下找到继续奋斗的动力。而谁是能承载这些重要意义的封面人物呢？我们自然而然地想到了杨适嘉。

杨适嘉

2014届土木工程系

帝国理工学院结构工程

奥雅纳伦敦办公室结构工程师
杨适嘉，2014年毕业于宁诺土木工程系，毕业后前往帝国理工学院继续深造，学习结构工程，主修钢结构和钢混结构。目前在奥雅纳伦敦办公室担任土木结构工程师，主要工作内容是基于客户要求以及现场的实际环境来设计建筑结构并不断完善。


困难也可以是最有趣的地方
传统观念里，大家可能会认为女生学习土木工程会很困难，但杨适嘉是一个喜欢挑战困难、不安于舒适圈的人。从选定自己喜欢的专业，到决定到帝国理工继续深造，再到自己向奥雅纳官网提交简历到面试成功，杨适嘉一直活得很自洽。

“我挺喜欢我的工作的。每个项目的特点不同，困难也不同，当然这也是最有趣的地方。和大家一起沟通交流解决问题是让我很开心的事儿。”杨适嘉向来是个很乐观的人，但并非盲目乐观，而是即使面对困难也勇敢应对的乐观。近几年，很多对于土建行业的发展不报有期待，但是适嘉却从另辟蹊径，“这个行业的发展前景很难说，这个完全取决于市场以及个人。每个人的选择不同，也有不同的追求，但是我相信大家的选择都一定是让自己开心以及幸福的。”

对于一个结构工程师来说，行业的技术性很强，相比较于一味盯着升学学校的排名而言，适嘉更看重自己可以在课程里具体学到的知识和技能。对于行业的清楚认知，让适嘉在选择升学的学校时，也多了一份坚定。

对杨适嘉来说，所有曾令她迷茫惆怅的挫折，早已成了如今辅助事业的积淀。也正是她的踏实与负责任，赢得奥雅纳对她的认可。

保持好奇，用心过当下的每时每刻
杨适嘉身上有着踏实严谨的工作作风，也有着似乎与之相悖的另一面——一个少女横冲直撞的好奇心。“我认为做工程师需要对自己的工作负责的同时，也要保持自己的好奇心，一直学习新的知识。”

“每个人都应该带着勇气和自信去尝试自己热爱的事情，”她想告诉学弟学妹们，“大家应该尝试做自己喜欢的事，越早越好。”

问起杨适嘉的人生目标，她更愿意专注当下的生活，做好手头上的每一件小事。平常心做非凡事，或许就是她得以登上更大的舞台并绽放的秘诀。“我没有特定的人生目标，只是做好自己的同时抓住可能的机会。”

杨适嘉表示，家庭在她成长路上给予了莫大的帮助和鼓励。“我的家人一直以来都在支持以及尊重我的决定，给我充足的自由，从来没有试图改变我。”家庭是杨适嘉的避风港，也是她所有选择的力量来源。

严肃学习，保持责任感
对于杨适嘉而言，如果谈论UNNC给她带来最重要的“特殊技能”，那就是保持了早起的习惯。早起看似是一件简单的小事，十年如一日坚持却很难。或许是她把这份大学时期养成的坚毅带入到了工作当中，短短四年，杨适嘉就从毕业生工程师升到工程师，也有了更多机会，能在项目设计上有更大的影响力和参与度。“我很喜欢自己的工作和每天的挑战。”

保持谦逊，认真学习，踏实做事，是杨适嘉一直以来的坚持。“如果你想要成为结构工程师，请严肃对待学习中的所有理论，并保持负责任的心态对待自己做出的决定。”在她眼里，“成功”是努力的代名词，她从未停止过播种与耕耘，现在的绽放与芬芳，都是曾经付出的辛苦与汗水得来的。

“我把自己所有参与过的项目看作自己在这个世界上留下来的足迹，我觉得很有意义。”而那一个个倾注了好奇心与责任心所诞生的项目，便是杨适嘉人生漫漫旅程中当下阶段的凝结和沉淀。

杨
适

嘉

Always being curious about the world and 
enjoy the challenge in your life
Shijia Yang graduated from Department of Civil Engineering, UNNC in 2014. Following that, she went to Imperial College studying structural engineering. At present, she works as a structural engineer in Arup London office. Her main job is to design and improve the building structure based on the requirements of customers and the actual environment of the site.

Enjoy the challenge in your life

Traditionally, people may think that it will be difficult for a female student to study Civil Engineering, but Shijia Yang is a person who likes to challenge difficulties and is not satisfied with the comfort zone. From choosing a programme to study, to choosing an industry to work, Shijia keeps following her own heart.

“I quite like it as you experience the challenges every day. All the difficulties are different case by case. I like communicating with people and solve issues together.” Shijia Yang has always been a very optimistic girl, but not blindly optimistic. Rather, she knows clearly about the difficulties but still have the gut to challenge it. In recent years, the construction industry is experiencing a downturn and many Civil Engineering graduates choose to work in a totally different industry. Shijia never thinks so. She believe that people can have their own choice, but if you are good enough, you can still do well in one industry.

All the frustrations that once made her confused and frustrated have already become valuable experience to assist her career. It is precisely because of her steadiness and responsibility that she has won the recognition in the career.
 
Keep curious and cherish every moment

Shijia Yang has a rigorous work style, but also has a strong curiosity to explore things. "I think to be an engineer, you need to be responsible for your work, at the same time, you should also keep curious and keep learning new knowledge all the time".

When talking about Yang's life goal, she is more willing to focus on the present life and do well in every little thing at hand, which may be the secret of her getting on the bigger stage and blooming. Yang also said that her family had given her great support and encouragement in her growth. "My family has always supported and respected my every decision." It can be said that family is Shijia Yang's shelter and the source of strength for all her choices.
 
Study seriously and keep a sense of responsibility

When asked about the most important skill that UNNC brings to her, Shijia Yang thinks that is to help her develop the habit of getting up early. Getting up early seems to be a simple little thing, but it's hard to persist. Her persistence also works in her career development. In just four years, Shijia was promoted from a graduate engineer to an engineer. She also had more opportunities to have greater influence and participation in project design.

Shijia Yang has always insisted on being modest, studying hard and doing things rigorously. She believes that "success" is the pronoun of hard work. She has never stopped sowing and cultivating. Now the blooming and fragrance are all from the hard work and sweat that she has paid.

She encourages UNNCer “Everyone has a different life and you can try what you want, be brave and confident. I take all the buildings I took part in as the evidence that I was there for the contribution. The buildings are the footprint I left in this world. If you want to be a structural engineer, please keep being serious about all the theory in study and be responsible for the decision you made.”

title: 2020级宁诺萌新，来校报到前可别忘了这几件事
content:
UNNC 新生快乐指南
Freshman Guide

以下内容针对宁波诺丁汉大学2020年国内本科新生，港澳台及国际新生入学安排请参考录取通知书及学校官方发送的通知邮件。
If you are a new student from overseas or HK, Macao, Taiwan, please find your admission arrangement in your letter of admission or the notification emails sent by the University. 

目前，还有部分地区的新生录取通知书正在邮寄中，请暂未收到的同学不要着急。
学校每天更新录取结果及通知书邮寄进度，点击下方链接可查看录取结果及通知书邮寄进度。
宁波诺丁汉大学2020高考录取结果查询及通知书邮寄进程（2020-08-26更新）

(一)
2020年国内本科新生注册
1. 网上预注册
网上预注册现已开放，截止时间为2020年9月13日。新生请务必在规定时间内完成网上预注册，否则将影响正常入学，及校内各项服务和设施的使用。
网上预注册包括三步骤： 
第一步，激活IT账号，登录学校邮箱。
第二步，上传照片申请校园卡。 
第三步，在MyNottingham上进行注册。

关于网上预注册，如有问题请发送邮件至 NewStudentsWelcome@nottingham.edu.cn 咨询。

2. 网上选寝 
1) 2020年国内本科新生自主选寝系统将于2020年8月31日上午10点正式开启。 
•个人信息填写：2020年8月31日10:00-2020年9月1日24:00 
•自主选寝：2020年9月2日10:00-2020年9月3日24:00 
•打印新生注册单：2020年9月2日10:00-2020年9月16日24:00 
2) 网上自主选寝链接：https://sams.nottingham.edu.cn
用户名为考生本人身份证号码，密码为身份证号码后6位，首次登陆后请及时修改登陆密码。 
3) 注意事项： 
a. 在规定时间内没有完成自主选寝的，系统随机分配寝室，但这种情况下将无法自行下载打印注册单。 
b. 请严格按照自主选寝须知进行操作。


(二)
新生报到
1. 具体信息
时间：2020年9月14日—9月16日  08:30-12:00，13:00-17:00 
地点：各寝室楼楼下
（13#/14#/15#/19#/23#） 
具体报到时间：因疫情原因，2020级国内高考本科新生按照学院专业进行分批次报到。 
理工学院新生：2020年9月14日报到 
商学院新生：2020年9月15日报到 
人文社科学院新生：2020年9月16日报到 
流程： 
1) 凭新生注册单、有效二代居民身份证到对应注册点刷本人二代有效身份证确认信息，领取小信封并签字,小信封内含学生卡(卡已开通公寓楼前厅和房间门禁)、发票等。 
2) 完成I-week注册
3) 至各寝室楼楼下(13#/14#/15#/19#/23#)办理寝室入住手续 
注意事项： 
1)新生如需查询所属学院信息，请登录https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/en/Faculties/
2)延后报到：未在规定时间来校报到的同学，请凭新生注册单、录取通知单和有效二代居民身份证到公寓楼前台办理寝室入住手续。


(三)
行囊必备物品
1.   录取通知书、证件卡片等
• 宁波诺丁汉大学录取通知书 
• 中华人民共和国二代居民身份证，及正反面复印件3份
• 学校寄发的中国银行卡 
• 新生注册单（网上自主选寝完成之后可自行打印） 

2. 党团组织关系转接及材料
•党组织关系转入：
1）浙江省生源网上转接, 接收党组织抬头为: 中共宁波诺丁汉大学委员会。
2）非浙江省生源需要开具盖有转出单位党组织公章的党组织关系介绍信, 接收党组织抬头为: 中共宁波市委组织部，去向填写：中共宁波诺丁汉大学委员会。介绍信由本人在报到时直接递 交各学院辅导员处。 
•党组织材料建议与学籍档案共同寄送，也可选择自带（请确保寄送或自带的档案资料封条完整，无拆封痕迹）。凡自带党员材料的新生, 请妥善保管, 待入校后交由辅导员入库存档。本科生新生党组织关系转接咨询电话：0574-88180000-8294。 
•团组织关系转接分线上操作与线下寄送，其中： 
线上操作：请在“智慧团建”上完成团组织关系的转接，转入的路径为“团浙江省委—团宁波市委—宁波诺丁汉大学团委—本科生临时团总支—本科生临时团支部”，待新生报到后，按照辅导员通知，继续进行准确的调整划分。 
线下寄送：团组织档案材料建议同高中学籍档案共同寄送，也可选择自带。请确保寄送或自带的档案资料封条完整，无拆封痕迹，档案封面需标明有无团组织材料，请提前与高中确认是否档案中有团组织档案。请注意：团员证作为共青团员身份的凭证，由本人保管，不作为团组织材料里面的一部分。 

3. 高中学籍档案
高中学籍档案自带的同学, 请务必保管好自己的学籍档案材料(请勿私自拆封)，报到后由各自 辅导员统一安排收取。
高中学籍档案邮寄的同学，请与所毕业的高中确认档案材料是否已经寄出。 
邮寄地址: 浙江省宁波市鄞州高教园区泰康东路199号宁波诺丁汉大学学生事务与发展中心，雷老师收。邮编315100，联系电话：0574-88180000 转分机号1397。 

4. 户口迁移
公安机关提倡和鼓励新生入学时不迁移户口。另根据公安部门指导意见，我校不办理2+2专 业学生的户籍迁移手续。 
•如要将户口迁至学校集体户口，请准备：户口迁移证原件（户口迁移证左上角用铅笔写上身高、血型、行政班级、联系电话）、身份证复印件1张（证件正面和反面信息复印在同 一面上）。 
•户口迁移材料请入学后自行交到Portland Building 108安保前台办公室。材料提交截止时间为 2020 年 09 月 30 日，逾期无法受理。 
•户口迁往地址：浙江省宁波市鄞州区学府路 71 号。（地址不能为：宁波诺丁汉大学或浙江省宁波市鄞州高教园区泰康东路199号。） 
•学校户口专线：0574-8818 0783。也可以直接咨询学校辖区文华派出所：0574-88154655。 

5. 床上用品
根据教育部要求，学校不统一配备学生床上用品，请自带或就近购买。

6. 正装
新生必须携带正装，出席开学典礼及其他正式场合。男生为西服套装、皮鞋或衬衫、皮鞋；女生为西服套装、不露趾皮鞋或修身连衣裙、不露趾皮鞋。 

7. 新生体检
为确保检查结果的准确及避免重复检查，体检时请不要穿带有任何饰品（包括金属、 塑料、亮片等）的上衣。女生不要穿裙子，在X光检查前请先脱掉文胸及金属配件。


(四)
为全英文学习做准备

为了帮助新生更好、更快地适应开学后的全英文学习环境，宁诺英语语言教学中心（CELE）准备了一系列线上课程，欢迎同学们在来校前了解学习，信息如下：
•学术英语课程：
https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/toolkits/play_18421#resume=1
•一年级整体信息介绍，请扫码关注CELE公众号：CELE_UNNC


(五)
新生活动
1. 辅导员见面会
时间：2020年9月10日 14:00-15:30 
形式：线上
参加方式届时将通过DCL官方微信平台公布，请大家扫描下方二维码进行关注。

2. 9月14日-9月20日：
新生报到、新生适应周（I-Week）


(六)
你可能会用到的联系方式

• 学校总机：0574-8818 0000 
• 学生事务与发展中心（Department of Campus Life）高中学籍档案专线: 0574-88180000 转分机号1397 
• 组织关系转接：0574-88180000转分机号8294
• 户口专线：0574-8818 0783
• 学费专线：0574-88180000-7603
• 学生公寓部专线：0574-8818 0820 / 8818 0811
• 新生校园卡专线 (The Hub) 电话 : +86 574 8818 0000 转分机号8062 
邮箱 : thehub@nottingham.edu.cn 
微信公众号 : TheHub_UNNC 
• CELE学术事务办公室（CPSO） 
CPSO 将在第一年为学生提供学术事务相关的服务和支持，包括回答学生咨询，发布一年级信息，教务安排，接受转专业申请等。 
邮箱：CPSO@nottingham.edu.cn
电话：0574-8818000-8664
微信公众号：CELE_UNNC
• 新生请假
因故不能按时报到者，请事先写邮件向 CPSO和大一辅导员团队请假，并提供相关证明材料，请假时间请勿超过两周。未请假或者请假逾期的，除因不可抗力等正当事由以外，视为放弃入学资格。 
请假邮箱： 
CPSO@nottingham.edu.cn；celestudentaffairs@nottingham.edu.cn

https://careers.nottingham.edu.cn/，选择“Student”，使用学生个人的校内账号密码登录，账号即学号，密码即身份证后6位，登陆后即可获得全面的就业留学一体化服务系统，如招聘会和岗位信息、一对一咨询预约服务和就业留学讲座等。请务必于10月底前登录系统，完成注册。

title: 2020 中国大陆新生网上自主选寝流程
content:
高考录取已然结束
录取通知书也马不停蹄奔赴在路上
除了每一位新生都需要进行的网上预注册
网上自主选寝也是不可缺少的一部分




日程安排


2020年国内高考本科新生自主选寝系统将于2020年8月31日上午10点正式开启。
1. 2020年8月31日10:00—2020年9月1日24:00，个人信息填写；
2. 2020年9月2日10:00—2020年9月3日24:00，网上自主选寝；
3. 2020年9月2日10:00—2020年9月16日24:00，打印新生注册单。

2020年国内硕士研究新生自主选寝系统将于2020年8月31日上午10点正式开启。
1. 2020年8月31日10:00—2020年9月1日24:00，个人信息填写；
2. 2020年9月2日10:00—2020年9月3日24:00，网上自主选寝；
3. 2020年9月2日10:00—2020年9月16日24:00，打印新生注册单。

2020年国内博士研究新生自主选寝系统将于2020年8月31日上午10点正式开启。
1. 2020年8月31日10:00—2020年9月1日24:00，个人信息填写；
2. 2020年9月1日10:00—2020年9月1日24:00，网上自主选寝；
3. 2020年9月1日10:00—2020年9月16日24:00，打印新生注册单。

特别注意：
高考受疫情延迟一个月，录取通知书寄送时间有先后，为保证选寝公平顺利进行，2020高考学生自主选寝与学费不挂钩。建议收到录取通知书后，尽快缴清学费。


Schedule


Online Self-dorm Selection System for 2020 Gaokao students will start from August 31, 2020 10 o’clock.

1. Fill in Personal Information: 10:00 August 31, 2020— 24:00 September 1, 2020；
2. Online Self-dorm Selection: 10:00 September 1, 2020— 24:00 September 3, 2020;
3. Print out Registration Form: 10:00 September 2, 2020— 24:00 September 16, 2020.

Online Self-dorm Selection System for 2020 Home PGT students will start from August 31, 2020 10 o’clock.

1. Fill in Personal Information: 10:00 August 31, 2020— 24:00 September 1, 2020；
2. Online Self-dorm Selection: 10:00 September 1, 2020— 24:00 September 3, 2020;
3. Print out Registration Form: 10:00 September 2, 2020— 24:00 September 16, 2020.

Online Self-dorm Selection System for 2020 Home PGR students will start from August 31, 2020 10 o’clock.

1. Fill in Personal Information: 10:00 August 31, 2020— 24:00 September 1, 2020；
2. Online Self-dorm Selection: 10:00 September 1, 2020— 24:00 September 1, 2020;
3. Print out Registration Form: 10:00 September 1, 2020— 24:00 September 16, 2020.

Notice：
2020 Gaokao exam was delayed one month due to the epidemic which means students will receive offers in different time. In order to ensure the fairness, the dorm selection for 2020 Gaokao Students will not related to tuition fees. However, it is recommended to pay off the tuition fee soon after receiving the offer.



自主选寝系统登陆


宁波诺丁汉大学新生自主选寝系统的地址为：https://sams.nottingham.edu.cn

该地址已经印刷在新生入学须知上，学生收到后，按照须知上给定的链接地址和用户名(新生18位身份证号码)和密码（对应身份证号码后六位，建议登录系统后及时修改密码）登录新生选寝系统系统。

图：系统登录（新生可在登陆界面，下载阅读《新生预注册须知》。

登录系统后会看到如下图所示的注册流程界面，系统将会显示您的缴费状况，以及各个步骤的操作说明和注意事项，在操作前请先了解操作说明和注意事项。

图：注册流程

网上自主选寝流程中包括的“个人信息填写”，“网上自主选寝”和“打印新生注册单”三个步骤，三个步骤之间具有先后顺序。首先完成个人信息填写，其次是完成自主选寝（提前缴清学费），最后完成打印新生注册单，步骤缺一不可，需严格按照先后顺序完成。

对于初次登陆系统，为了您的个人信息的安全，建议您修改初始密码。如果对于系统的操作不熟悉，建议查看在线帮助。


Self-dorm Selection System



Website: https://sams.nottingham.edu.cn
Username: National ID number
Password: National ID last 6 numbers

The self-dorm selection includes three steps: Filling in personal information, online dorm selection and Printing New Student Registration form. The steps are all indispensable and students must completed in strict accordance with the sequence.
For the security of your personal information, it is recommended that you change the initial password at first time. If you are not familiar with the operation of the system, it is recommended to read the instruction.


具体操作流程
Step 1: 个人信息编辑

由于学生信息量很大，所以分成四步骤来完成，顶部的进度导航将显示您当前填写的页面处于哪一个步骤。

图：个人信息进度导航

第一步：确认高考的信息，核对上述高考信息
图：确认高考信息

请仔细核对您的高考信息，如果发现和自身实际情况有出入，可以根据页面提示，致电或者点击页面右下方的“我要反馈”，进行在线反馈。
图：问题反馈

确认高考信息后点击“下一步”，进入第二步个人信息填写页面，对于个人信息未填写或者存在错误的进行填写或者修改。


注：按照学校关于学生注册的规定，以下信息中的必填项必须真实无误地填写。

第二步：填写并确认个人信息
图：填写个人的基本信息


第三步：填写教育经历
个人信息填写完成后点击“下一步”，进入第三步个人教育信息填写页面，依次填写初中到高中的教育经历。
图：填写个人教育经历

第四步：填写家庭信息
填写完个人教育经历后点击“下一步”，进入第四步家庭信息填写页面。页面包括个人的家庭地址以及家庭成员的信息，如果需要添加多个家庭成员，点击“添加其他家庭成员”进行添加，最多只能添加四个。
图：填写个人的家庭信息（请注意图中标记的必填项一定要准确无误的填写）


填写完家庭信息后点击“确认修改”，即可完成个人信息填写的步骤，系统会提示您已经完成个人信息填写。
图：个人信息注册后信息提示

点击“返回首页”返回到预注册首页。

Step 2：网上自主选寝

只有完成以上步骤才可以进行选寝。网上选寝按钮会在指定的时间段内开放。如果您完成“个人信息编辑”后，还没有到选寝开放时间请耐心等待，请注意选寝开放的时间段，以免错过。

如果您需要完成缴费但还未缴费，注册系统会在首页中提示您。

如果您已完成所有规定步骤，请在系统自动开启“网上自主选寝”功能后，点击“选寝”按钮，接下来会进入填写个人特征信息页面。为了您能够找到理想的室友，请认真填写这部分内容。
图：填写个人特征页面

填写完毕后点击“下一步”，系统会自动根据您的性别和所在行政班列出指定的房源。

图：宿舍楼选择

如果您想了解该寝室楼的实际情况请点击“点击了解寝室设置详情”。可以查看到相应的寝室楼信息。

了解了寝室楼设置情况后，点击“开始预订”,页面会自动分层列出各寝室。每个寝室后面的数字标明了该寝室是几人间，如果该寝室已经被选择且人数满了或者不符合学校的选寝规则，将不会在列表中显示。所以越迟选择，可以选择的宿舍也就越少。请各位同学在选寝功能开放后及时进行选寝操作。

图：选择寝室号

点击可以选择的寝室，将会显示该寝室的平面图以及所有可以选择的床位。您可以根据您的情况选择相应的床位。
图：选择床位进行预订

对于已被预订的床位，则会显示该同学的个人特征信息。

对于可以预订的床位，点击“预订”，进入床位确认界面。点击“确认”，则预订成功。

注：
1. 如果预订后进行修改，该页面将会显示您剩余的可修改次数；
2. 在选寝系统开启后，将会有大量学生同时进行预订寝室的操作，此时会出现一个空闲床位被多人同时选择的情况。如果您操作比较慢，在确认时，系统可能会提示该床位已经被选择。如果出现这种情况，建议返回寝室界面重新进行选择。
图：确认预订床位信息

title: 2020 中国大陆新生网上预注册
content:
Note: This online registration guide is for 2020 new domestic students only. If you are a new international or Hong Kong, Macao & Taiwan student, your registration guide will be sent to your registered email address. 


高考录取已然结束
录取通知书也马不停蹄奔赴在路上
在正式入学之前
每一位新生都需要在网上进行预注册

Chinese Gaokao is over.
And the letter of admission is also on the way.
Before formal admission,
Every new student need to register online.


新生网上预注册开放时间为8月10日—9月13日。
国内新生请务必在规定时间内完成网上预注册，否则将影响正常入学，及校内各项服务和设施的使用。

Online Pre-registration opens from 10th Aug, 2020 to 13th Sept. 2020.
You need to complete online pre-registration within the specified time, otherwise it will affect the admission, and the function of all campus services and facilities.

网上预注册包括三步骤：
第一步，激活IT账号：
激活IT账号，登录学校邮箱。学校邮箱是同学们学习生活的重要工具，是学生与学校各部门沟通的首要渠道。通过邮箱进入个性化学生系统MyNottingham，使用校园内的Wi-Fi等。

Step 1：Activate your IT account
Activate your IT account and log into university mailbox. University mailbox is an important tool for students to study and live in UNNC. It is also the primary channel for students to communicate with all university departments and tutors.


1.激活你的IT账号
点击UNNC IT Accounts 
(itaccounts.nottingham.edu.cn)打开账号管理 系统，在“新用户”（New Users）一栏下面，找到“所有学生”（All Students）选项。我们建议您使用最新版的微软IE / Edge，谷歌Chrome或苹果Safari浏览器。

2. 在如下界面中输入您的姓氏（汉语拼音）、生日（DD/MM/YY，格式为日/月/年），和学号（Surname, DOB, and Student ID）。

3. 勾选同意Code of Practice, 然后点击继续。

4. 成功登录之后，系统会显示您的用户名、初始密码以及您的学校邮箱地址。（注意：初始密码是系统自动生成的，您需要在后续步骤中重新设置为您的个人密码。此页面的信息建议手机拍照，屏幕截图，或者用笔记下来，后面步骤会用到。）

5. 点击继续按钮（Continue）后将跳转至以下登陆界面，使用刚才记下的用户名和初始密码进行登陆。

6. 成功登录之后，请在这下一步中设置安全问题及相应答案，然后点击提交。

7. 请选择左侧栏中的修改密码（Change Password）来设置的您的个人密码。（请设置一个较为复杂的密码并牢记在心，密码长度最少8位，并且要同时包含至少一个大写字母(A-Z)，一个小写字母(a-z)，一个数字(0-9)和一个特殊字符(如@，!，%，#等)。密码中不要包括您的用户名或者全名连续超过2个字母以上。）

8. IT账户激活成功以后，系统需要约30分钟时间来同步数据，然后就可以登录学校的邮箱了。


第二步，上传照片申请校园卡(国内高考新生无需自行上传照片，高考照片将会用于校园卡和学生证制作)：
校园卡作为学生身份证明，用于考试、图书馆服务、打印机、和寝室生活等领域。若未按要求申请校园卡，你将无法正常使用学校设施。

Step 2：Upload pictures and apply for Student ID Card (Gaokao entry students do not need to upload pictures themselves since their Gaokao pictures will be used for Student ID card and Student Booklet)

Your Student ID Card will be used as student identification in the fields of examinations, library services, printers and living areas, etc. If you do not apply as required, you cannot use the university facilities normally.


1. 访问UNNC ID Card 
(universitycard.nottingham.edu.cn)，输入用户名和密码登录。（注意：在这一步中，用户名是您的学号（例如：2012XXXX），密码是您的生日（格式：DDMMYY，例如：25091997。）

2. 登录以后，请根据屏幕上的指示上传照片，并点击确认（Confirm）。注意：照片必须是护照形式的本人近照（白色背景），尺寸约300×400像素，并且是JPG格式。照片大小最好不超过100KB，如果照片格式不符合要求会被系统自动裁剪。

3. 如果照片成功上传，您将会看到如下页面。


第三步，在MyNottingham上进行注册：
登录MyNottingham系统完成个人信息注册，正式成为一名UNNC学生。

Step 3：Register on Mynottingham
Log on My Nottingham and fill in your personal information. Then you are officially an UNNCer.



关于网上预注册，如有问题，请发送邮件至 NewStudentsWelcome@nottingham.edu.cn
校园大使将为您在线解答。
更多信息，请关注宁波诺丁汉大学官网以及DCL官方微信（微信号：UNNC_DCL）.

If you have any questions related to pre-registration, please send email to 
NewStudentsWelcome@nottingham.edu.cn. 
Campus Ambassador will answer online.
You can also follow DCL WeChat (ID: UNNC_DCL) for following information.
